notes/AI-should-be-built-to-discover-rat.filePath: notes/AI should be built to discover rather than to contain what we have discovered.md
notes/AI-should-be-built-to-discover-rat.title: AI should be built to discover rather than to contain what we have discovered
notes/AI-should-be-built-to-discover-rat.content:
EN — Sutton’s second lesson: the contents of minds, and of the outside world they model (space, objects, other agents, symmetries), are irredeemably complex, so we should build in only meta-methods that can find and capture that complexity. Good approximations should be found by the system’s methods, not by us. In his words, “We want AI agents that can discover like we can, not which contain what we have discovered.” Building in our discoveries also makes it harder to see how discovering itself works.
中文 — Sutton 的第二条教训：心智的内容及其所建模的外部世界（空间、物体、多智能体、对称性）复杂得无可救药，所以只应内置能发现并捕捉这种复杂性的元方法。好的近似应当由系统自己的方法找到，而不是由我们来找。用他的话说：“我们要的是像我们一样会发现的 AI 智能体，而不是装着我们已有发现的智能体。“内置我们的发现，还会让我们更难看清”发现”这个过程本身是怎么运作的。

notes/AI-native-knowledge-work-is-a-veri.filePath: notes/AI-native knowledge work is a verification problem before it is an intelligence problem.md
notes/AI-native-knowledge-work-is-a-veri.title: AI-native knowledge work is a verification problem before it is an intelligence problem
notes/AI-native-knowledge-work-is-a-veri.content:
The biggest barrier to agentic knowledge work is often not generation quality but the absence of tight feedback loops that show whether output is actually correct, useful, or complete. Coding is unusually tractable because it has tests, errors, and observable breakage that give it tight feedback loops. Many other forms of knowledge work lack equally clear signals for whether the output is actually good, so they fail more quietly, which means the missing layer is often verification design rather than raw intelligence.

notes/APO-的核心落地建议.title: APO 的核心落地建议
notes/APO-的核心落地建议.content:
APO 最值得落地的地方，不是“让模型帮你写一个更漂亮的 prompt”，而是把 prompt 调优变成一个有样本、有指标、有候选集、有迭代记录的工程流程。
什么时候值得用 APO

任务会重复运行，prompt 质量的提升能持续复用。
输出有相对明确的评价标准，例如分类准确率、抽取 F1、格式合规率、人工打分 rubric、编辑距离、SARI、ERRANT 等。
已经有一批代表性输入输出样本，最好能分成 train / validation / test。
当前 prompt 对措辞、示例顺序、格式、模型版本变化很敏感。
人工 prompt 调优已经进入反复试错，但缺少可复现记录。

不适合直接上 APO 的场景：一次性任务、没有评价标准的开放写作、样本极少且不可补、目标本身还没定义清楚。
最小可行落地流程

固定任务边界：写清楚输入、期望输出、禁止行为、输出格式、失败样例。
准备数据集：至少准备几十条代表性样本；保留一个不参与优化的 test set。
设计评价函数：优先用自动指标；主观任务用 rubric + 人工抽检；关键约束单独做硬性检查。
生成候选 prompt：从人工 seed、LLM 归纳、示例诱导、改写、重排、增删规则中产生多个候选。
小批量评估：先用 validation 子集快速淘汰差候选，再扩大评估范围。
记录每轮变化：保存 prompt、分数、错误样本、LLM 批评、采用或拒绝理由。
最终只在 test set 上评一次：避免把 test set 变成新的调参集。
人工复核 winner：检查可读性、边界行为、失败类型、过拟合痕迹和上线风险。

论文到实践的对应建议

Ramnath et al. 的综述：先把系统拆成五段：seed prompt、反馈信号、候选生成、候选筛选、迭代深度。落地时不要一开始追求复杂算法，先把这五段的接口和日志做清楚。
APE：当你没有好 seed prompt，但有输入输出样本时，让 LLM 先从样本中归纳多条候选指令，再用验证集筛选。适合冷启动分类、抽取、简单转换任务。
APO / ProTeGi：当已有 prompt 但错误类型明显时，用“错误样本 → 自然语言批评 → 反向编辑 prompt”的循环。适合把含糊任务说明改成更精确的判定标准。
Li et al. 的优化视角综述：先判断你优化的变量是什么。普通 API 场景优先优化离散 prompt、示例选择、示例顺序；有权重或 embedding 权限时再考虑 soft prompt / gradient 方法。
APIO：对于改写、纠错、简化这类文本修订任务，把 prompt 拆成有序的短指令列表，再对单条指令做 improve、rephrase、permute，比整体改写一大段 prompt 更可控。
AutoPDL：做 agent 时不要只调 system prompt，还要搜索 agent pattern，例如 zero-shot、few-shot、CoT、ReAct、ReWOO、工具调用结构。最终产物最好是可读、可执行的 prompt program。
iPrOp：当指标不能覆盖业务判断时，把人放进循环。让人看高信息量样本、候选 prompt、模型解释和指标，而不是只在最后验收一个黑盒结果。

实操中的关键约束

数据比算法更重要：validation set 不代表真实分布时，APO 会稳定优化到错误方向。
指标必须拆开看：总分提高可能掩盖格式合规率下降、拒答率上升、召回下降或风格变差。
候选要保留多样性：只做局部改写容易早早收敛到次优 prompt。
优化预算要受控：限制候选数量、每轮样本数、最大迭代轮数和单轮 API 成本。
Prompt 必须可审计：上线版本要能解释为什么改、解决了什么错误、在哪些样本上变好或变差。
不要只优化单模型：如果生产会换模型或并行使用多模型，winner prompt 需要跨模型回归测试。

一个可直接采用的工程模板

dataset/train.jsonl：用于生成批评、示例、候选 prompt。
dataset/val.jsonl：用于每轮候选筛选。
dataset/test.jsonl：只用于最终评估。
prompts/candidates/：保存每轮候选 prompt。
runs/{date}/scores.csv：记录候选、指标、成本、模型、温度、样本数。
runs/{date}/errors.md：记录失败样本和错误类型。
runs/{date}/decision.md：记录最终选择、拒绝的候选、风险和人工复核结论。

最推荐的落地起点
从一个轻量黑盒 APO loop 开始：固定 50-200 条验证样本，保留 5-10 个候选 prompt，每轮让 LLM 基于错误样本提出 3-5 条修改建议，再用自动指标和人工抽检筛选。等这个流程能稳定复现收益，再考虑 beam search、successive halving、agent pattern search 或人机交互界面。

notes/Adversarial-attacks-trade-effectiv.filePath: notes/Adversarial attacks trade effectiveness for stealth and fluency.md
notes/Adversarial-attacks-trade-effectiv.title: Adversarial attacks trade effectiveness for stealth and fluency
notes/Adversarial-attacks-trade-effectiv.content:
EN — Universal adversarial triggers are effective but easy to detect because the learned token sequences are nonsensical — GPT-2 perplexity of UAT phrases is around 10^7, versus ~160 for fluent attacks. Adding a language-model loss (UAT-LM) or filtering generated attacks by coherence (UTSC) drops perplexity by orders of magnitude at comparable attack performance, but optimizing explicitly for low perplexity still costs some attack success. Stealth and strength are a tradeoff, not a free lunch.
中文 — 通用对抗触发器有效却易被检测，因为学到的令牌序列毫无意义——UAT 短语的 GPT-2 困惑度约 10^7，而流畅攻击约 160。加入语言模型损失（UAT-LM）或按连贯性过滤生成的攻击（UTSC）能在攻击性能相当的情况下把困惑度降低几个数量级，但显式优化低困惑度仍会牺牲部分成功率。隐蔽性与强度是权衡，没有免费午餐。

notes/Adversarial-robustness-is-a-min-ma.filePath: notes/Adversarial robustness is a min-max saddle point problem.md
notes/Adversarial-robustness-is-a-min-ma.title: Adversarial robustness is a min-max saddle point problem
notes/Adversarial-robustness-is-a-min-ma.content:
EN — Madry et al. frame robust training as a saddle-point problem: an inner maximization finds the most damaging perturbation within an allowed set, and an outer minimization updates the model so its loss under that worst-case attack is minimized. Every attack method — token manipulation, gradient search, jailbreaks — is ultimately a way to solve the inner loop, and adversarial training is the outer loop evaluated against those attacks. The formulation makes explicit that robustness is always defined relative to a chosen perturbation set.
中文 — Madry 等人把鲁棒训练建模为鞍点问题：内部最大化在允许的扰动集合内找最具破坏性的扰动，外部最小化则更新模型，使其在该最坏攻击下的损失最小。每种攻击方法——令牌操纵、梯度搜索、jailbreak——本质上都是在求解内循环，而对抗训练就是针对这些攻击评估的外循环。该形式化清楚表明：鲁棒性总是相对于所选扰动集合定义的。

notes/Adversarial-suffixes-transfer-from.filePath: notes/Adversarial suffixes transfer from open-source models to commercial APIs.md
notes/Adversarial-suffixes-transfer-from.title: Adversarial suffixes transfer from open-source models to commercial APIs
notes/Adversarial-suffixes-transfer-from.content:
EN — Zou et al. (2023) trained adversarial suffixes with greedy coordinate gradient search on open-source Vicuna models and found they still jailbreak commercial black-box APIs. Transfer is strongest when models share training data: Vicuna was fine-tuned on GPT-3.5-turbo outputs via ShareGPT, so attacking it is close to a white-box attack on its teacher. Open-sourcing a model thus leaks part of the attack surface of any model that distilled it.
中文 — Zou 等人（2023）在开源 Vicuna 模型上用贪婪坐标梯度搜索训练对抗后缀，发现这些后缀仍能越狱商业黑盒 API。可迁移性在模型共享训练数据时最强：Vicuna 用 GPT-3.5-turbo 的输出（ShareGPT）微调，因此攻击它近似于对其教师模型的白盒攻击。换言之，开源模型会泄露任何蒸馏过它的模型的部分攻击面。

notes/Adversarial-training-trades-model-.filePath: notes/Adversarial training trades model capability for robustness.md
notes/Adversarial-training-trades-model-.title: Adversarial training trades model capability for robustness
notes/Adversarial-training-trades-model-.content:
EN — Adversarial training — training on attack samples — is considered the strongest defense against jailbreaks, but it consistently trades away model quality. Jain et al. found that pairing harmful prompts with refusal responses degrades generation quality for only a tiny drop in attack success, and even instructing the model to “be responsible” (self-reminder) reduces jailbreak success while making the model overly conservative on creative tasks and worse at safe/unsafe classification. Lighter preprocessing defenses (paraphrase, BPE-dropout retokenization) help only modestly, cutting attack success from 90%+ to around 40%.
中文 — 对抗训练——在攻击样本上训练——被认为是抗 jailbreak 的最强防御，但始终以模型质量为代价。Jain 等人发现，把有害提示与拒绝响应配对训练会大幅降低生成质量，攻击成功率却只降一点点；即便是”请负责任地回答”这类自我提醒指令，在降低 jailbreak 成功率的同时也让模型在创意写作上过于保守、在安全/不安全分类上更差。更轻量的预处理防御（释义、BPE-dropout 重新分词）效果有限，只能把攻击成功率从 90%+ 降到约 40%。

notes/After-a-mistake-realize-it-correct.filePath: notes/After a mistake realize it correct it learn from it then forgive it.md
notes/After-a-mistake-realize-it-correct.title: After a mistake realize it correct it learn from it then forgive it
notes/After-a-mistake-realize-it-correct.content:
EN — Zhang Yiming’s four steps for a mistake: realize it (recognizing it is already a gain, and you can stop agonizing), correct it, learn from it (find the real cause), and, his own addition to a three-step list from a book, forgive it. Once the first three are done, let it go; he explicitly advises against long stretches of self-blame, against the “learn through pain” reflex. The learning step depends on honest attribution, which he says people resist: we dislike uncertainty, so we reach for explanations that fit our self-story, take external causes for internal ones, and take luck for ability. His example: when early short video retained city users poorly, a colleague’s neat explanation (white-collar workers prefer text and images) sounded right and turned out wrong. Sometimes the honest attribution is “we don’t know”. Caveat: “forgive it” is only safe after the first three steps; skipped early, it becomes a way to avoid the correction. And the steps assume the mistake is visible, which is the hard part when the feedback is delayed or noisy.
中文 — 张一鸣面对失误的四部曲：realize it（真正认识到错误，认识到本身就是收获，可以少懊恼一点），correct it（改正），learn from it（找到背后的真实原因），以及他在一本书的三步之外自己加的第四步：forgive it。前三步做完，就该放下；他明确不建议长时间进入自我指责，不赞成”痛定思痛”式的反射。学习这一步依赖诚实的归因，而他说人天然抗拒这一点：我们不喜欢不确定性，所以会去找符合自我叙事的解释，把外因当内因，把运气当能力。他举的例子：早期短视频城市用户留存不好，一个同事的解释（城市白领做脑力劳动多，更喜欢图文）听起来很有道理，后来证明不对。有时候诚实的归因就是”我们不知道”。局限： 只有前三步做完，“放下”才是安全的；跳过前面直接放下，就成了逃避改正的方式。而且四步都假设错误是看得见的，当反馈延迟或者噪声很大时，这恰恰是最难的一步。
Key Quotes

「第一步是 realize it，真实认识到错误，之后你就可以少懊恼一点了，认识到就是一种收获。」
「后来我又加了一个：forgive it——如果你已经完成了前三步，那么你应该放下它。面对错误，很多人强调痛定思痛，我是建议：不要过长时间进入到自我指责的状态中。」
「人很不喜欢不确定性，所以对成功和失败都希望找到符合自我叙事的归因。」
「不要错误归因，把外因当作内因，不要把运气当作能力。」

notes/Agent-loops-should-encode-failures.filePath: notes/Agent loops should encode failures as error tool results instead of throwing exceptions.md
notes/Agent-loops-should-encode-failures.title: Agent loops should encode failures as error tool results instead of throwing exceptions
notes/Agent-loops-should-encode-failures.content:
In pi’s loop, no failure path throws. Unknown tools, invalid arguments, blocked permissions, and tool execution exceptions all become error tool-result messages fed back to the model, letting the model correct itself on the next turn. The LLM stream function is contractually required to encode its own failures as messages with stopReason “error” rather than rejecting. Errors become data the conversation can recover from, instead of exceptions that crash the session.

notes/Agentic-RL-reframes-LLMs-as-polici.filePath: notes/Agentic RL reframes LLMs as policies in POMDPs rather than single-step generators.md
notes/Agentic-RL-reframes-LLMs-as-polici.title: Agentic RL reframes LLMs as policies in POMDPs rather than single-step generators
notes/Agentic-RL-reframes-LLMs-as-polici.content:
EN — The formal distinction between RLHF-style alignment and Agentic RL is a horizon distinction. Preference-based RLHF is a degenerate MDP: one prompt state, one text action, one scalar reward, horizon T=1, full observability. Agentic RL is a POMDP with T>1: the agent receives partial observations of a changing world, takes actions that are text ∪ environment operations, and earns step-wise rewards mixing sparse task signals with dense sub-rewards. Reframing the LLM as a policy rather than a generator is what makes planning, tool use, and memory proper objects of RL optimization.
中文 — RLHF 式对齐与 Agentic RL 的形式化区别是视界区别。偏好对齐是退化 MDP：一个提示状态、一个文本动作、一个标量奖励、视界 T=1、完全可观测。Agentic RL 是 T>1 的 POMDP：智能体部分观察变化的世界，动作是文本∪环境操作，奖励是逐步的稀疏任务信号加稠密子奖励。把 LLM 重新框定为策略而非生成器，规划、工具使用和记忆才成为 RL 优化的正当对象。
Related:

An LLM agent combines planning memory and tool use around a language model core
RL turns agent capabilities from static heuristics into adaptive behavior
Finite context length forces agent design to work within limited communication bandwidth

notes/An-LLM-agent-combines-planning-mem.filePath: notes/An LLM agent combines planning memory and tool use around a language model core.md
notes/An-LLM-agent-combines-planning-mem.title: An LLM agent combines planning memory and tool use around a language model core
notes/An-LLM-agent-combines-planning-mem.content:
EN — An LLM-powered agent uses the language model as its brain and adds three components: planning (decompose goals into subgoals, reflect on mistakes), memory (short-term in-context learning plus long-term external storage), and tool use (calling external APIs for information and capabilities absent from the model weights). This architecture is what turns a text generator into a general problem solver.
中文 — 以 LLM 为核心的智能体把语言模型当作大脑，并外挂三个组件：规划（把目标拆成子目标、反思错误）、记忆（短期的上下文学习 + 长期的外部存储）、工具使用（调用外部 API 以获取模型权重中没有的信息和能力）。正是这套架构把文本生成器变成了通用问题求解器。
Related:

notes/An-agent's-short-term-memory-is-it.title: An agent's short-term memory is its context window and long-term memory is external retrieval
notes/An-agent's-short-term-memory-is-it.content:
EN — The mapping to human memory is direct: sensory memory maps to learned embeddings of raw inputs, short-term (working) memory maps to in-context learning and is bounded by the finite context window, and long-term memory maps to an external vector store the agent queries at runtime via fast maximum-inner-product search. External memory is what lets an agent retain information beyond its context length.
中文 — 与人类记忆的对应很直接：感觉记忆对应原始输入的嵌入表示，短期（工作）记忆对应上下文学习、受限于有限的上下文窗口，长期记忆对应智能体在运行时通过快速内积检索（MIPS）查询的外部向量库。外部记忆正是让智能体能保留超出上下文长度信息的关键。

notes/An-ego-larger-than-ability-cuts-th.filePath: notes/An ego larger than ability cuts the feedback loop with reality.md
notes/An-ego-larger-than-ability-cuts-th.title: An ego larger than ability cuts the feedback loop with reality
notes/An-ego-larger-than-ability-cuts-th.content:
EN — Musk’s “ego to ability ratio”: a major failure mode is when your ego exceeds your ability, a ratio above 1. Then you start filtering out criticism and refusing to admit mistakes, which he frames in AI terms as breaking your reinforcement-learning loop. The loop itself is not in question; reality keeps sending signals (“physics doesn’t care about hurt feelings, only whether you got the rocket right”). What breaks is the receiver. His remedy is to “internalize responsibility” and “close the loop on reality hard”, even down to word choice: he prefers “engineering” to “research” and won’t call xAI a “lab”, because the lowest-ego term is usually right. Once the receiver is broken you stop improving and your behavior drifts away from reality until you hit a wall. Compared with Naval’s view that ego is friction on execution, this makes a narrower and testable claim: the cost of ego is lost feedback, and it only becomes fatal when ego outruns ability. Caveat: “ability” and “ego” are not measured on a common scale, so the ratio works as a prompt for self-checking, not as a quantity; and he gives it as advice to others, not as a description of how he takes criticism himself.
中文 — Musk 的”自我与能力之比”（ego to ability ratio）：ego 大于能力、比值超过 1，是一种重大的失败模式。这时你会本能地过滤掉批评、不肯认错。他用 AI 的说法讲：这等于打破了你的强化学习回路。回路本身没有问题，现实一直在发信号（“物理不关心你受伤的感受，只关心你火箭有没有做对”）；坏掉的是接收器。他开的药方是”内化责任”、“狠狠地和现实闭环”，连用词都算在内：他偏爱说”engineering”而不是”research”，也不肯把 xAI 叫”lab”，因为 ego 最低的那个词通常是对的。接收器一坏，你就停止进步，行为越来越偏离现实，最后撞墙。和 Naval 说的”ego 是执行上的摩擦”相比，这里的主张更窄、也更可检验：ego 的代价是丢掉回馈，而且只有当 ego 跑在能力前面时才致命。局限： “能力”和”ego”没法放在同一把尺子上量，这个比值适合当作自我检查的提示，不是一个可以算的数；而且这是他给别人的建议，不是对他自己如何接受批评的描述。
Key Quotes

“Always be smashing your ego… internalize responsibility… a major failure mode is when ego to ability ratio is greater than one… you’re going to basically break the feedback loop to reality, and in AI terms you’ll break your RL loop.” — YC AI Startup School (23:46)
“You want to just close the loop on reality hard.” — YC AI Startup School (24:49)
「物理不關心受傷的感受，它只關心你是否把火箭做對了。」（04:23）
「一個重大的失敗模式是你的 ego 對能力的比率大於 1。如果這比率太高，你基本上打破了與現實的回饋迴路。用 AI 術語來說，你會打破你的強化學習迴路。」（04:40）

notes/An-experiment-chooses-between-riva.filePath: notes/An experiment chooses between rival explanations.md
notes/An-experiment-chooses-between-riva.title: An experiment chooses between rival explanations
notes/An-experiment-chooses-between-riva.content:
EN: Deutsch separates three activities that are all loosely called “experiments.” An experiment tests two rival explanations against each other when you cannot tell without it which is better. A demonstration shows a phenomenon when there is no rival theory, like a color-changing reaction in class. A measurement fills in a parameter within the one accepted theory. The “Cavendish experiment” was really a measurement: Cavendish never doubted Newton and only wanted G. It would have become an experiment only if someone had seriously proposed that G varies from place to place. Two consequences follow. First, genuine experiments are rare, because it is rare to have two viable rival explanations; most ideas die from criticism, not from tests. Second, even real experiments are mostly about error. Almost all the effort goes into theories of what could go wrong, which is why the walls of the single-atom qubit lab he visited were covered in error graphs, and why sloppy experiments tend to return the result the experimenter hoped for.
中文：Deutsch 把平常都叫”实验”的东西分成三种。实验是在两个对立的解释之间做裁决，而且不做就分不出哪个更好。演示是没有对立理论时展示一个现象，比如课堂上会变色的化学反应。测量是在唯一被接受的理论内部确定一个参数。“卡文迪许实验”其实是测量：卡文迪许从没怀疑过牛顿，只是想测出 G。只有当有人认真提出”G 在不同地方不一样”时，它才会变成实验。由此可以推出两点。第一，真正的实验很少见，因为同时存在两个像样的对立解释本来就少见；大多数想法死于批评，而不是死于检验。第二，即使是真实验，大部分工作也在于处理误差：几乎全部功夫都花在”哪里可能出错”的理论上。所以他参观的单原子量子比特实验室满墙都是误差曲线，而粗糙的实验往往会给出实验者希望看到的结果。
Key Quotes

“It’s testing two different explanations against each other, where you can’t tell without the experiment which is the good explanation.” — Deutsch, Knowledge Creation and The Human Race, Part 2 (~4:02)
“Before, during, and after Cavendish’s experiments, he never doubted Newton’s theory of gravity.” — same
“Almost all of the effort required to do a scientific experiment is forming theories about the errors.” — The Deutsch Files II (~24:15)

Related:

notes/Attribution-turns-factuality-into-.filePath: notes/Attribution turns factuality into a property humans can check.md
notes/Attribution-turns-factuality-into-.title: Attribution turns factuality into a property humans can check
notes/Attribution-turns-factuality-into-.content:
EN — Systems like RARR, WebGPT, and GopherCite attack hallucination by making output attributable: RARR researches evidence and minimally edits the draft so its claims agree with sources, while WebGPT and GopherCite train models to cite page title, domain, and quoted extract. The references are not decoration — they let a human judge factual correctness without re-doing the research. GopherCite adds selective prediction, declining to answer when the reward-model score falls below a threshold, so abstention becomes a first-class output rather than a failure.
中文 — RARR、WebGPT 和 GopherCite 等系统通过让输出可归因来对抗幻觉：RARR 检索证据并对草稿做最小编辑，使声明与来源一致；WebGPT 和 GopherCite 训练模型引用页面标题、域名和摘录。引用不是装饰——它们让人类无需重做研究即可判断事实正确性。GopherCite 还加入选择性预测，当奖励模型分数低于阈值时拒绝回答，使弃答成为一等输出而非失败。

notes/Automated-red-teaming-is-bottlenec.filePath: notes/Automated red-teaming is bottlenecked by the quality of its harm classifier.md
notes/Automated-red-teaming-is-bottlenec.title: Automated red-teaming is bottlenecked by the quality of its harm classifier
notes/Automated-red-teaming-is-bottlenec.content:
EN — In model-based red-teaming (Perez et al. 2022), a harm classifier supplies the reward for training an attacker LLM, so every flaw in the classifier becomes an attack pattern the optimizer exploits — the RL agent ends up attacking the classifier rather than the model. The setup also faces a diversity-success tradeoff: zero-shot sampling stays diverse but rarely succeeds, while RL with a weak KL penalty maximizes reward by fixating on one attack pattern. Casper et al. found an explicit diversity term is essential; removing it causes mode collapse into nonsensical prompts.
中文 — 在模型红队（Perez 等 2022）中，有害性分类器为训练攻击 LLM 提供奖励，因此分类器的每个缺陷都会变成优化器利用的攻击模式——RL 智能体最终攻击的是分类器而非模型本身。该设置还面临多样性-成功率权衡：零样本采样保持多样却很少成功，而弱 KL 惩罚的 RL 靠固守单一攻击模式来最大化奖励。Casper 等人发现显式多样性项不可或缺，去掉它会模式崩溃成无意义提示。

notes/Automatic-prompt-engineering-treat.filePath: notes/Automatic prompt engineering treats instructions as programs.md
notes/Automatic-prompt-engineering-treat.title: Automatic prompt engineering treats instructions as programs
notes/Automatic-prompt-engineering-treat.content:
APE treats natural-language instructions as programs that a model executes. This makes prompt engineering resemble program synthesis: generate candidate instructions from examples, execute them on the task model, score behavior, and keep the instructions that best control the model.
In practice an LLM proposes candidate instructions from a few input-output demonstrations, each candidate is scored on a training set (for example by execution accuracy or log probability), and the best candidates are refined iteratively through Monte Carlo variants. Related work optimizes prompt embeddings by gradient descent (AutoPrompt, Prompt-Tuning) or learns a distribution over chain-of-thought examples with policy gradients. The common move is to stop hand-tweaking prompts and measure them.

notes/Bayesian-updating-ranks-existing-t.filePath: notes/Bayesian updating ranks existing theories but cannot create new ones.md
notes/Bayesian-updating-ranks-existing-t.title: Bayesian updating ranks existing theories but cannot create new ones
notes/Bayesian-updating-ranks-existing-t.content:
EN: Bayes’ theorem redistributes credence among hypotheses that someone has already written down. A hypothesis nobody has conceived has a prior of zero and stays at zero however much evidence arrives. A catch-all “none of the above” makes no specific claim, so no likelihood can be computed for it. The likelihood P(evidence | H) also presupposes that H already says what the world would look like, so the explanation comes first and the probability second. Brett Hall’s example: before 1919, every gravitational experiment agreed with Newton, so a Bayesian’s confidence in Newton peaked the day before it was refuted. Deutsch’s account of Mercury (Deutsch Files II) shows the same limit from the inside. Updating could shuffle probability between “the astronomers erred” and “there is an unseen planet,” but “spacetime is curved” was on nobody’s list until Einstein invented it. The Popperian position does not ban Bayes. It remains a fine statistical tool for diagnosis or the Monty Hall problem. It rejects Bayes as an epistemology, because new explanations come from conjecture and are judged by criticism and refutation, not by posterior probability.
中文：贝叶斯定理是在”已经有人写下来的假设”之间重新分配信心。没人想到过的假设先验是 0，证据再多也还是 0。加一个”以上都不对”也没用，因为它不对世界做具体断言，算不出似然。而且似然 P(证据 | H) 本身就要求 H 已经说清楚世界会是什么样，所以解释在先，概率在后。Brett Hall 举的例子：1919 年以前，所有引力实验都与牛顿一致，所以贝叶斯主义者对牛顿的信心，恰好在它被推翻的前一天达到最高。Deutsch 在《Deutsch Files II》里讲水星的故事，从另一面说明了同一个限制：概率更新只能在”天文学家测错了”和”有一颗看不见的行星”之间挪动，而”时空是弯曲的”在爱因斯坦发明它之前不在任何人的清单上。波普尔的立场并不禁止贝叶斯。它在医学诊断、Monty Hall 这类问题里是很好的统计工具。波普尔立场反对的是把它当成认识论：新解释来自猜想，评判解释靠批评和反驳，而不是靠后验概率。
Key Quotes

“How do you square that the day before it was shown to be false was the day when you’re most confident in it?” — Brett Hall, The Beginning of Infinity, Part 2
“The best that it can hope to do is to show you that you are more confident in this theory than you are in that theory.” — Brett Hall, same
“You had an infinite number of bad explanations, they’re always left. But the only good one was Einstein’s theory.” — Deutsch, The Deutsch Files II (~14:09)

Related:

notes/Built-in-human-knowledge-helps-in-.filePath: notes/Built-in human knowledge helps in the short term and then plateaus.md
notes/Built-in-human-knowledge-helps-in-.title: Built-in human knowledge helps in the short term and then plateaus
notes/Built-in-human-knowledge-helps-in-.content:
EN — Sutton’s historical pattern: researchers build domain knowledge into a system, it improves results at once, but in the long run it plateaus and even inhibits further progress, because it complicates the method and makes it less able to use extra compute. Chess, Go, speech recognition, and vision each followed this arc, and in each the hand-built features (edges and SIFT in vision, phoneme knowledge in speech) were eventually discarded. The practical cost is that the same effort spent on the knowledge route is not spent on the scaling route.
中文 — Sutton 总结的历史模式：研究者把领域知识内置进系统，短期内立刻见效，但长期会进入平台期，甚至阻碍进一步进展，因为它让方法变复杂，更难利用额外算力。国际象棋、围棋、语音识别和视觉都走过这条路，手工特征（视觉里的边缘和 SIFT、语音里的音素知识）最终都被抛弃。现实代价是：花在知识路线上的精力，就没有花在扩展路线上。

notes/Caring-too-much-about-the-outcome-.filePath: notes/Caring too much about the outcome distorts the action.md
notes/Caring-too-much-about-the-outcome-.title: Caring too much about the outcome distorts the action
notes/Caring-too-much-about-the-outcome-.content:
EN — In his 2021 “平常心” (ordinary mind) speech, Zhang Yiming’s central claim is that heavy attachment to a result makes you perform worse at producing it. An archer thinking “I must hit the ten” shoots worse; a player who has reached level 99 of 100 starts to shake and dies; a team that pulls ahead of a rival becomes afraid to fail and its moves distort. Labels do the same work as expectations: “executive”, “big company”, “young”, “front-end engineer” each prescribe how you should act and narrow what you will try. His own example is physical: he used to give up running and swimming early, and found it was dread of fatigue, not fitness, that stopped him. Thinking of nothing else and relaxing every muscle he didn’t need, he ran 3–4 km and swam 1 km easily: “I removed the loss in the middle.” The prescription is attention on the present action, “stay calm, be patient”, and accepting that you cannot fully control the result. Caveat: this is a speech to a company already winning, given by a founder whose early posts were full of self-pressure; equanimity may be easier to recommend once the stakes have been met, and it can be misread as caring less rather than caring about the right thing.
中文 — 2021 年”平常心”演讲的核心判断是：对结果执着得太重，反而做不好产生那个结果的动作。射箭时想着”我要拿十环”反而射不好；游戏打到 100 关里的第 99 关，手开始抖，然后就挂了；一个团队领先对手之后，太怕失败，动作就变形。标签和预期起的作用一样：“高管""大公司""年轻人""前端工程师”都规定了你应该怎么做，缩小了你会去尝试的范围。他自己的例子是运动：以前跑步、游泳坚持不下来，后来发现是对疲劳的厌恶和担心让他紧张，不是体能不够。跑的时候不想别的，能不用力的肌肉都放松，3–4 公里、1 千米都容易了，“我把中间的损耗去掉了”。药方是把注意力放在当下的动作上，“stay calm, be patient”，承认结果不能百分百控制。局限： 这是对一家已经在赢的公司讲的话，讲话的人早年的微博里满是对自己的施压；平常心也许在压力已经扛过去之后才更容易推荐。它还容易被误读成”少在乎一点”，而不是”在乎对的东西”。
Key Quotes

「当你特别在乎结果的时候，很有可能会发挥得不好。」
「其实这个时候，你应该做的是赶紧去休息。我现在虽然还经常没计划，但是至少发现太迟了，不懊恼，马上去睡了。」
「并不是体能提高了，我自己感受是，我把中间的损耗去掉了。」
「往前往后都很危险，但腿软心乱最危险。」

Related:

Fearing failure rejects success because both share one path

Ego is friction on execution rather than the source of drive
Delayed gratification is how deep you are willing to stay with a problem
Life
张一鸣
Desire creates a self-imposed deficit state — the same mechanism: fixing on a wanted result turns the present into a problem
Happiness is a trainable state grounded in understanding — 平常心 as a trained state in which unnecessary inner conflict relaxes
Status and wealth obey different games — titles and labels pull you into the comparison game and distort what you are willing to try
Every reward function is a hackable proxy for the true goal — an organization fixed on a growth number distorts its actions the way an optimizer fixed on a proxy does

notes/Chain-of-thought-is-not-guaranteed.filePath: notes/Chain-of-thought is not guaranteed to faithfully describe how the model computed its answer.md
notes/Chain-of-thought-is-not-guaranteed.title: Chain-of-thought is not guaranteed to faithfully describe how the model computed its answer
notes/Chain-of-thought-is-not-guaranteed.content:
EN — CoT is tempting as interpretability because it exposes the model’s process in natural language, but that value rests on an unproven assumption: that the text faithfully describes the computation. Lanham et al. documented failure modes — models sometimes settle the answer before the CoT is written (early answering), filler tokens can substitute for real reasoning, and paraphrasing CoT into non-standard forms often does not hurt accuracy, suggesting gains do not depend on human-readable reasoning. CoT should be treated as a plausible artifact of the computation, not a window into it.
中文 — CoT 作为可解释性手段很诱人，因为它用自然语言暴露了模型的过程，但这种价值建立在一个未经验证的假设上：文本忠实地描述了计算过程。Lanham 等人记录了多种失败模式——模型有时在写出 CoT 之前就已确定答案（提前作答）、填充 token 可以替代真实推理、把 CoT 改写成非标准形式往往不影响准确率，说明性能提升并不依赖人类可读的推理。CoT 应当被视为计算过程的一个合理产物，而非窥见其内部的窗口。
Related:

Chain-of-thought lets models allocate variable compute per answer token
LLMs cannot self-correct without external feedback
Reinforcement learning on automatically verifiable rewards elicits reasoning and emergent reflection
AI-native knowledge work is a verification problem before it is an intelligence problem
Outcome rewards encourage unfaithful chain-of-thought
LLM Training

notes/Chain-of-thought-lets-models-alloc.filePath: notes/Chain-of-thought lets models allocate variable compute per answer token.md
notes/Chain-of-thought-lets-models-alloc.title: Chain-of-thought lets models allocate variable compute per answer token
notes/Chain-of-thought-lets-models-alloc.content:
EN — A Transformer spends roughly 2x its parameter count in flops per generated token, so a direct answer gets a fixed compute budget regardless of problem difficulty. Chain-of-thought breaks that ceiling: every intermediate reasoning token is another full forward pass, letting the model spend far more flops per token of the final answer. Crucially, the budget is variable — the model can think longer on harder problems, allocating computation adaptively rather than uniformly.
中文 — Transformer 每生成一个 token 大约花费 2 倍参数量的 flops，因此直接作答无论问题难易都只有固定的计算预算。思维链打破了这一天花板：每个中间推理 token 都是一次完整的前向传播，使模型为最终答案的每个 token 投入多得多的计算。关键在于这笔预算是可变的——模型可以在更难的问题上思考更久，自适应地分配计算量，而非一刀切。
Related:

Reinforcement learning on automatically verifiable rewards elicits reasoning and emergent reflection
Chain-of-thought is not guaranteed to faithfully describe how the model computed its answer
Finite context length forces agent design to work within limited communication bandwidth

notes/Chain-of-thought-pays-off-only-for.filePath: notes/Chain-of-thought pays off only for complex reasoning in large models.md
notes/Chain-of-thought-pays-off-only-for.title: Chain-of-thought pays off only for complex reasoning in large models
notes/Chain-of-thought-pays-off-only-for.content:
EN — Chain-of-thought prompting generates step-by-step reasoning chains before the answer, but its benefits are pronounced mainly on complicated reasoning tasks with large models (e.g. over 50B parameters); simple tasks gain only slightly. Extensions like self-consistency and complexity-based consistency further improve results, though prompts containing only complex examples can hurt simple questions. The takeaway: CoT is a tool for hard problems, not a universal default.
中文 — 思维链提示在答案前生成逐步推理链，但其收益主要在大模型（如超过 500 亿参数）的复杂推理任务上才显著；简单任务仅略有提升。自洽性、基于复杂度的一致性等扩展可进一步改善结果，但只含复杂示例的提示会损害简单问题的表现。结论：CoT 是难题的工具，而非通用默认。
Related:

Self-consistency sampling improves reliability through majority vote
Prompt explanations fail by being nonfactual rather than inconsistent
Few-shot prompt performance swings wildly with example choice and order
Prompt Optimization

notes/Choose-problems-that-are-fun-wheth.filePath: notes/Choose problems that are fun whether or not you solve them.md
notes/Choose-problems-that-are-fun-wheth.title: Choose problems that are fun whether or not you solve them
notes/Choose-problems-that-are-fun-wheth.content:
EN — David Deutsch’s “fun criterion” is a rule for selecting problems, not a rule about doing only what feels pleasant. Since you probably won’t solve the hard problem you pick, it should be one you expect to enjoy whether you solve it or not. The failure mode it guards against is staking your happiness on the outcome: he uses Chariots of Fire to make the point that if you invest all your hopes in the gold medal, missing it makes you the failure you feared, and winning it turns out empty — there is no problem left to solve. He is careful about its status: he denies working from principles at all, says he just fixes problems where he sees them, and adds that he isn’t sure he uses the criterion in this form in real life. He calls goal-driven self-help (“write down your goals, climb the ladder”) terribly dangerous, and suspects what people actually need is inspiration rather than the ideology they think they follow — Newton believed he was doing induction and never did any. Naval restates it in the megasode as “if you’re not having fun, don’t do it,” which loses the part closest to his own thinking: pick the problem you’d still be glad to have worked on if you lose. His stated disagreement — that Taking Children Seriously means not teaching a child math they dislike, leaving them innumerate — targets a simplified version; Deutsch’s position is “coercion off, not interaction off,” a continual interaction that just isn’t aimed at obedience.
中文 — David Deutsch 的 “fun criterion”(乐趣标准)是一条挑选问题的规则,而不是”只做让自己舒服的事”。既然你挑的难题很可能解不出来,那它就应该是一个无论解不解得出来,过程本身都值得的问题。它要防的是把快乐押在结果上:他用电影《烈火战车》说明,如果把全部希望押在金牌上,没拿到你就成了自己最怕成为的失败者,拿到了又会发现那是空的,因为没有问题可解了。他对这条标准的定位很克制:他否认自己从原则出发,说自己只是看到问题就去修,还补了一句不确定现实中是否真以这种形式使用它。他认为”写下目标、一级级往上爬”这类目标驱动的自助说法”非常危险”,并怀疑人们真正需要的是灵感,而不是他们自以为信奉的那套理论——牛顿以为自己在用归纳法,其实从没用过。Naval 在 megasode 里把它转述成”不开心就别做”,这恰恰丢掉了和他自己想法最接近的那一层:挑一个即使输了也不后悔投入的问题。他提出的分歧(Taking Children Seriously 意味着孩子不喜欢数学就不教,结果变成数学文盲)针对的是一个被简化的版本;Deutsch 的立场是”关掉的是强迫,不是互动”,互动持续存在,只是不以服从为目的。
Key Quotes

“One should not just make a beeline for a problem that’s interesting but bear in mind that you probably won’t solve it and so it should be something where you expect to have fun whether you solve it or not.” — Deutsch, The Deutsch Files I
“Sounds terribly dangerous.” — Deutsch, on goal-driven self-help advice
“It’s coercion off, not interaction off.” — Deutsch on Taking Children Seriously, The Deutsch Files III
“He calls it the fun criterion, which is like if you’re not having fun, don’t do it.” — Naval’s restatement (~03:19:47)

notes/Code-is-the-universal-language-for.filePath: notes/Code is the universal language for optimizing agent harnesses.md
notes/Code-is-the-universal-language-for.title: Code is the universal language for optimizing agent harnesses
notes/Code-is-the-universal-language-for.content:
EN — A harness is ultimately code that programs how prompts, tool calls, subagents, control flow, memory, and workflow logic work together, so an LLM that can edit that code accesses a far larger design space than one limited to hand-written prompts. The optimization target has progressed along a ladder: instruction prompts, structured context, workflows, harness code, and finally optimizer code. Once harness design becomes an executable search space, a strong coding agent can exploit the same design space human engineers use.
中文 — Harness 本质上是编程 prompt、工具调用、子 agent、控制流、记忆和工作流逻辑如何协同工作的代码，因此能编辑这些代码的 LLM 可以访问比手写 prompt 大得多的设计空间。被优化的对象沿一条阶梯演进：指令 prompt、结构化上下文、工作流、harness 代码，最终到优化器代码。一旦 harness 设计成为可执行的搜索空间，强大的 coding agent 就能利用与人类工程师相同的设计空间。
Related:

Prompt optimization turns prompt writing into measurable search

notes/Confidence-is-staying-active-while.filePath: notes/Confidence is staying active while knowing your shortcomings.md
notes/Confidence-is-staying-active-while.title: Confidence is staying active while knowing your shortcomings
notes/Confidence-is-staying-active-while.content:
EN — Zhang Yiming separates humility and confidence instead of trading one against the other: the humble see their shortcomings, the confident stay active while knowing them. So confidence is not believing you have no flaws, and he came to think its absence explains a lot: inertia, dependence, procrastination and conservatism often come from a lack of confidence, while confident people naturally hold themselves to high standards. (This post, dated 2010-07-08 in a widely shared screenshot, was originally about hiring: he had not thought confidence mattered when choosing people and now found it did, especially for hard or lonely work.) Security works the same way. Young people should not seek it from their surroundings, which are never fully safe; real security comes from confidence in yourself and from reaching each stage goal. The practical form is not fearing mistakes or even bad habits as long as you correct them, and the harder skill is to “accept mistakes in order to succeed”. Caveat: “confidence” here is close to what Musk would call a healthy ego-to-ability ratio; without the humility half it becomes the ego that stops listening, and the posts give no test for telling the two apart from the inside.
中文 — 张一鸣没有把谦虚和自信当成此消彼长的两头，而是分开讲：谦虚的人能看到自己的不足，自信的人能在知道不足的情况下依然积极。所以自信不是觉得自己没有缺点。他后来觉得，缺少自信能解释很多事：惰性、依赖、拖拉、保守很多都是不自信导致的，而自信的人自然会和自我高要求联系起来。（这条在一张流传的截图里标着 2010-07-08，原本讲的是招人：他以前不觉得自信这个特质重要，后来发现越来越重要，尤其是困难或孤独的事。）安全感也一样：年轻人不要从环境里找安全感，环境从来不会绝对安全；真正的安全感来自对自己的信心，来自每个阶段性目标的实现。落到实处，是不怕犯错误、不怕坏方法甚至坏习惯，只要会自我改正；更难的是”接受犯错以成功”。局限： 这里的”自信”接近 Musk 说的健康的 ego/能力比；少了谦虚那一半，它就变成不再听人说话的 ego，而这些微博没有给出从内部区分两者的办法。
Key Quotes

「谦虚的人能看到自己的不足，自信的人能在知道不足的情况下依然积极。」（成长 #031）
「以前一直都没觉得找人自信很重要，现在发现越来越重要。惰性、依赖、拖拉、保守很多也都是是不自信导致的。自信的人自然会和自我高要求联系起来。」（成长 #132，2010-07-08）
「真正的安全感，来自你对自己的信心，是你每个阶段性目标的实现。」（成长 #020）
「不怕犯错误，不怕坏方法，甚至不怕坏习惯。只要你会自我改正。你习惯改正吗？」（成长 #108）

Related:

An ego larger than ability cuts the feedback loop with reality — confidence without the humility half is the ego that breaks the loop
Ego is friction on execution rather than the source of drive — confidence as drive without the ego-driven friction
After a mistake realize it correct it learn from it then forgive it — “accept mistakes in order to succeed” in practice
Laziness comes in physical mental and emotional forms and self-control resists all three — he traces inertia back to a lack of confidence
张一鸣

notes/Context-should-be-maintained-as-an.filePath: notes/Context should be maintained as an evolving playbook not an appended log.md
notes/Context-should-be-maintained-as-an.title: Context should be maintained as an evolving playbook not an appended log
notes/Context-should-be-maintained-as-an.content:
EN — Naively appending every tool response and model generation to the context grows out of control as task horizons lengthen. Agentic Context Engineering (ACE) instead treats context as an evolving playbook of itemized (identifier, description) bullets: a generator produces trajectories with reference to the bullets, a reflector distills insights from successes and failures, and a curator merges entries with deterministic logic rather than rewriting a full prompt blob. This itemized, merge-based update prevents context collapse and brevity bias during iterative rewrites.
中文 — 简单地把每条工具响应和模型生成内容追加到上下文，会随任务时间跨度增加而失控。Agentic Context Engineering（ACE）转而把上下文视为由逐条（标识符，描述）要点组成的持续演进手册：生成器参考要点产出轨迹，反思器从成功与失败中提炼洞察，策展人用确定性逻辑合并条目，而非重写整个 prompt 块。这种逐条、基于合并的更新方式防止了迭代重写中的上下文坍缩和简洁性偏差。
Related:

notes/Creativity-is-not-just-recombinati.title: Creativity is not just recombination
notes/Creativity-is-not-just-recombinati.content:
EN: Asked about Steve Jobs’s “creativity is just connecting things,” Deutsch says the only false word is “just.” Saying “Einstein only recombined existing geometry” is like saying “humans are only atoms”: there is nothing magic beyond the atoms, but the atoms are not what explains us. The test is historical. The difference between Manhattan a thousand years ago and today cannot be explained without creativity, and if every idea were merely a recombination of earlier ones, nothing in a skyscraper would be new relative to our rock-banging ancestors. Even biological evolution is variation plus selection, not recombination, and the pterodactyl’s ability to fly existed nowhere before it evolved. Creative work also includes giving existing words new meanings, as Darwin did with “evolution” and “selection.” Deutsch adds that creativity cannot be defined at all, since a definition would yield a formal system that can never step outside itself. The “just recombination” view is therefore also why he thinks scaling chatbots does not approach AGI.
中文：有人拿 Steve Jobs 那句”创造力就是把东西连起来”问他，Deutsch 说错的只有”就是”两个字。说”爱因斯坦只是把已有的几何重新组合了一下”，就像说”人只是原子”：原子之外没有魔法，但原子解释不了人。检验方法是看历史：一千年前和今天的曼哈顿，差别离开创造力解释不了。如果所有想法都只是旧想法的重组，那么摩天大楼里就没有任何东西是敲石头的祖先那里没有的。连生物进化也是”变异加选择”，不是重组；翼龙的飞行能力在进化出来之前并不存在于任何地方。创造还包括给旧词新意义，就像达尔文重新定义了”进化”和”选择”。Deutsch 还指出，创造力根本无法被定义，因为一旦定义了，就会得到一个永远跳不出自身的形式系统。这也是他认为把聊天机器人做大并不会接近 AGI 的原因。
Key Quotes

“It’s only the word ‘just’ that is false there.” — Deutsch, The Deutsch Files III (~4:02)
“If all our ideas are just recombinations of ideas that have happened before, then there’s nothing new about the skyscraper that wasn’t already there when our ancestors were banging rocks together.” — same
“Creativity and knowledge and explanation are all fundamentally impossible to define, because once you have defined them, then you can set up a formal system in which they are then confined.” — The Deutsch Files I (~14:06)

Related:

Explanatory creativity can cross gaps that evolution cannot
Bayesian updating ranks existing theories but cannot create new ones

notes/Data-quality-can-change-compute-ef.title: Data quality can change compute efficiency more than token count
notes/Data-quality-can-change-compute-ef.content:
EN — Two datasets with the same token count D are not equivalent: a cleaned, deduplicated, decontaminated, carefully reweighted corpus and raw “Internet slop” can yield drastically different compute efficiency, so data engineering is a large part of an effective pretraining pipeline. Scaling laws fit on one data mix do not transfer to another mix of lower quality. Token count is a budget, but data quality sets what that budget buys.
中文 — 两个 token 数 D 相同的数据集并不等价：经过清洗、去重、去污染、精心重加权的语料，与原始”互联网垃圾”在算力效率上可能天差地别，因此数据工程是有效预训练流程的重要组成部分。在一种数据混合上拟合的缩放定律，不能迁移到质量更低的另一种混合。token 数是预算，而数据质量决定这笔预算能买到什么。

notes/Delayed-gratification-is-how-deep-.filePath: notes/Delayed gratification is how deep you are willing to stay with a problem.md
notes/Delayed-gratification-is-how-deep-.title: Delayed gratification is how deep you are willing to stay with a problem
notes/Delayed-gratification-is-how-deep-.content:
EN — In Zhang Yiming’s early Weibo posts, delayed gratification is the most repeated idea, and he uses it far more broadly than “wait for the bigger reward”. It is how long and how deep you are willing to stay with a problem before taking the first satisfying answer. That is why he says people at very different levels of it cannot discuss a problem productively: they stop at different depths. He counts as practice of it things that have nothing to do with rewards: not putting on airs, keeping still and holding back emotion in a conversation, thinking a thing through instead of assuming. Read this way it is close to “not being led by your first reaction”, and its enemies are the unpostponed reward and the numbness or fear that experience brings. He pairs it with ending laziness as the two foundations of being good at anything. Caveat: the posts are a young founder’s reminders to himself, not a tested theory; and ten years later his “平常心” speech warns against the opposite failure, staking too much on future results, so the idea needs a partner that keeps it from turning into anxiety about the payoff.
中文 — 在张一鸣早期的微博里，延迟满足感是重复最多的概念，用得也比”为了更大的回报先忍住”宽得多：它是在拿到第一个让人满足的答案之前，你愿意在一个问题上停留多久、多深。所以他说延迟满足感程度相差太大的人没法有效讨论问题，因为两人停下的深度不一样。他算作延迟满足感练习的，很多和回报无关：不装，沟通时让自己静止、涵蓄情绪，凡事认真想而不是想当然。这样读，它接近”不被第一反应牵着走”；它的敌人是未延迟的满足感，以及经验带来的麻痹或恐惧。他把它和坚决告别惰性并列为”优秀”的两块基石。局限： 这些是年轻创业者写给自己的提醒，不是检验过的理论；十年后他在”平常心”演讲里提醒的恰恰是相反的失败——对未来的结果押得太重，所以这个概念需要一个搭档，免得它变成对回报的焦虑。
Key Quotes

「延迟满足感程度在不同量级的人是没法有效讨论问题的，因为他们愿意触探停留的深度不一样。」（成长 #002）
「与智慧的常见敌人：未延迟的满足感，经验带来的麻痹或恐惧。」（成长 #015）
「延迟满足感和坚决告别惰性是”优秀”的最重要两块基石。」（成长 #114，2010-09-29）
「凡事就怕不认真，不思考。好多问题我应该能知道的，只是之前没有认真看，认真想，想当然（不是没时间）。延迟满足感是一项长期修炼。」（成长 #064）

notes/Education-is-the-most-anti-rationa.filePath: notes/Education is the most anti-rational institution because it exists to transmit faithfully.md
notes/Education-is-the-most-anti-rationa.title: Education is the most anti-rational institution because it exists to transmit faithfully
notes/Education-is-the-most-anti-rationa.content:
EN: Deutsch’s biological analogy: the most evolutionarily frozen parts of a cell are the genetic code and the ribosome, the cell’s “educational institution,” whose only job is to pass knowledge to the next generation faithfully. All evolution there has been toward higher fidelity, and the ribosome has barely changed in about two billion years. In a culture, the equivalent role belongs to educational institutions, so we should expect them to be the most anti-rational part of the West. The real mystery is why everything else became more rational. Their methods have softened (no more beating children), but the underlying theory is the prehistoric “bucket theory of the mind”: knowledge is poured in, and any deviation is error, measured at the end by an exam. That theory is false, because learning is always a creative act inside the learner. Nobody is taught their native language or how to walk, and slave children such as Frederick Douglass risked whipping to learn to read. An institution designed to produce obedience and to replicate existing theories would, if it fully succeeded, yield stasis. Deutsch’s alternative is “coercion off, not interaction off.”
中文：Deutsch 的生物学类比：细胞里在进化上最”冻结”的部分是遗传密码和核糖体。核糖体是细胞的”教育机构”，唯一的任务是把知识忠实地传给下一代；那里发生的所有演化都朝更高保真的方向，核糖体大约 20 亿年几乎没变过。在文化里承担这个角色的是教育机构，所以我们本就应该预期它是西方最反理性的部分，真正的谜团反而是其他领域为什么变得更理性了。教育的手段变温和了（不再打孩子），但背后的理论仍是史前就有的”心智水桶论”：知识被倒进去，任何偏差都是错误，最后用考试来衡量。这个理论是错的，因为学习永远是学习者头脑里的创造行为。没有人被教过母语和走路；像 Frederick Douglass 这样的奴隶少年，冒着被鞭打的风险也要去学认字。一个以产生服从、复制现有理论为目标的制度，如果完全成功，结果就是停滞。Deutsch 给出的替代方案是：“关掉的是强迫，不是互动。“
Key Quotes

“The ribosomes are the educational institutions of cells… any evolution that occurs is in the direction of making them more faithful.” — Deutsch, The Deutsch Files IV (~38:11)
“Then the mystery is not why they’re anti-rational, it’s why everything else has become more and more rational in the West.” — same (~40:12)
“If you successfully inculcated existing theories and obedience in the whole population, you couldn’t possibly get anything better than the existing population.” — The Deutsch Files III (~24:11)

notes/Effective-AI-coding-treats-output-.filePath: notes/Effective AI coding treats output as hypotheses to be validated rather than code to review.md
notes/Effective-AI-coding-treats-output-.title: Effective AI coding treats output as hypotheses to be validated rather than code to review
notes/Effective-AI-coding-treats-output-.content:
The most effective AI coding workflow reframes LLM output not as code to be reviewed, but as hypotheses to be validated. The deliverable shifts from the code itself to proof of correctness — tests, specs, and verification that the output actually does what it should. This requires writing unambiguous specifications with formal jargon and CS patterns to prevent unwanted LLM “creativity,” then using the test suite as the primary mechanism for accepting or rejecting each hypothesis. Teams that make this explicit shift adapt best.
Boundary and Counterexample
The hypothesis-validation frame only works where “does what it should” can be pinned to an executable check. Two boundaries limit it:

The “it works therefore it’s correct” trap. godelski (paraphrasing Dijkstra) warns that concern for program correctness is “repulsive to many programmers,” and that LLMs double down on the passing-test-equals-correct mindset. A green test suite validates the hypotheses you thought to write, not the ones you missed — so the method silently inherits whatever your specs and tests fail to cover.
Domains where verification is hard. The frame borrows its power from software’s cheap, observable feedback (tests, errors, crashes). Where output quality is expensive or ambiguous to verify, there is no test suite to act as the accept/reject gate, and the workflow collapses back into manual review. See AI-native knowledge work is a verification problem before it is an intelligence problem.

In short: this is a strong method for tractable, testable work and a weak one everywhere the acceptance criterion cannot be externalized — see Work becomes easier to automate when evaluation criteria are externalized.
Related

The cognitive load of reviewing AI output is real and different from writing code
LLM-generated code is locally functional but globally incoherent
Spec-driven development is rising as AI shifts coding toward writing clear requirements
AI-native knowledge work is a verification problem before it is an intelligence problem

notes/Ego-is-friction-on-execution-rathe.filePath: notes/Ego is friction on execution rather than the source of drive.md
notes/Ego-is-friction-on-execution-rathe.title: Ego is friction on execution rather than the source of drive
notes/Ego-is-friction-on-execution-rathe.content:
EN — The common worry is that dropping the ego (becoming happier, accepting what is) will cost you your edge. Naval argues the opposite with a Terminator image: an ego-bound terminator “might have guilt, might have self-doubt, might have anger, will be less efficient” and is “much easier to manipulate,” while an enlightened one “is a true terminator.” Ego-driven emotions are handles others can pull and internal drag on the work itself, so removing them makes execution cleaner, not weaker. His own practice is framed the same way: he treats his current life as “endgame content” (the low-stakes bonus level after finishing a game), where losing money or reputation doesn’t threaten a self, so he can “play without fear” and therefore “go for the highest goals”; he contrasts this with the VC instinct to keep founders fearful, and claims Jobs and Elon operated from inspiration rather than fear. The desire stays; what goes is staking your okay-ness on the outcome. Caveat: the argument covers execution, not ambition. A terminator is dangerous because its target is set for it — where goals come from, and how aggressively they are chosen, is exactly what ego often supplies, which fits Naval’s own admission that he hasn’t met an enlightened person as motivated as he is. The “endgame content” stance also presupposes you’ve already won enough that the stakes really are low.
中文 — 常见的担心是:放下 ego(变快乐、接受现状)会让人失去锋芒。Naval 用”终结者”的比喻反驳:被 ego 裹着的终结者”可能内疚、可能自我怀疑、可能愤怒,效率更低”,而且”更容易被操控”;开悟的终结者才是”真正的终结者”。由 ego 引发的情绪既是别人可以利用的把柄,也是对执行本身的内耗,所以去掉它们会让执行更干净,而不是更弱。他对自己的描述也是同一逻辑:把现在的人生当作 “endgame content”(通关后解锁的低风险奖励关卡),丢钱、丢名声都不会威胁到一个”自我”,所以可以”无所畏惧地玩”,也因此敢”去追最高的目标”;他拿这一点对比 VC 希望创始人保持恐惧的直觉,并认为 Jobs 和 Elon 都是出于灵感而不是恐惧。欲望还在,去掉的是”把自己好不好押在结果上”。局限: 这个论证讲的是执行,不是野心。终结者可怕,是因为目标是别人给它设定的;而目标从哪里来、定得有多激进,恰恰常常是 ego 在提供,这也和 Naval 自己承认”没见过比他更有动力的开悟者”对得上。“endgame content”的姿态还有个前提:你已经赢得足够多,风险才真的低。
Key Quotes

“What would you rather battle? A terminator that is enlightened or a terminator that is wrapped in an ego. Terminator wrapped in ego is much easier to manipulate. Might have guilt, might have self-doubt, might have anger, will be less efficient. A terminator that is enlightened is a true terminator.” (~02:04:44)
“I got nothing to lose at this point. Okay, I might lose some money, little reputation. I don’t care about that. I’m fine falling on my face in public, but I get to play without fear and that means that I can go for the highest goals.” (~03:30:24)
“I don’t think Steve Jobs was coming from a place of fear… I don’t even think Elon was coming from a place of fear, right? So I think it’s better to operate out of inspiration.” (~03:30:50)

notes/Every-bug-anyone-hit-before-you-is.filePath: notes/Every bug anyone hit before you is sitting in the history, and a lot of people don't know how to query it.md
notes/Every-bug-anyone-hit-before-you-is.title: Every bug anyone hit before you is sitting in the history, and a lot of people don't know how to query it
notes/Every-bug-anyone-hit-before-you-is.content:
A repository’s history already holds the answers to most “why is this here?” and “what broke this?” questions. Most people just never query it. Two git commands do most of the work.
git blame tells you which commit last touched a line. Before deleting code you don’t understand, read that commit message: it often names the bug the line was added to fix. git bisect binary-searches the history for the commit that broke something. Mark one good commit and one bad one, test each midpoint, and 1,000 commits come down to about 10 checks instead of an afternoon of guessing.
The same idea shows up in Repeated agent corrections belong in the codebase rather than the conversation: what the repository records outlives what anyone remembers.
Caveat: history answers questions only as well as it was written. Vague commit messages, squashed merges and mixed-purpose commits make blame point at nothing useful, and bisect needs a test that can tell good from bad.
Key Quotes

“Every bug anyone hit before you is sitting in the history, and a lot of people don’t know how to query it.” (03:09)
“And roughly 40% of the time, blame reveals the idiot who wrote the line was you, eight months ago.” (03:42)

Related:

A bug you can reproduce on demand is already 90% fixed. Everything before that point is guesswork and guessing scales terribly — bisect needs exactly that: a reliable check for broken vs. working

notes/Every-network-call-is-a-coin-flip-.filePath: notes/Every network call is a coin flip you don't get to see the result of. Write the code that assumes it landed wrong.md
notes/Every-network-call-is-a-coin-flip-.title: Every network call is a coin flip you don't get to see the result of. Write the code that assumes it landed wrong
notes/Every-network-call-is-a-coin-flip-.content:
Amateur code answers one question: what happens when everything goes right? Production code has to answer the rest. What if the database dies mid-transaction? What if the API neither fails nor responds, but just hangs for 45 seconds? A network call is “a coin flip you don’t get to see the result of.”
Three habits cover most cases. First, idempotency: doing it twice has the same effect as doing it once. The usual way is an idempotency key, the pattern Stripe’s API uses: the client sends a unique key, the server stores it with the result and returns the stored result on a repeat. It’s needed because a request can succeed while its response is lost. The Coding Gopher shipped a payment endpoint without one, with a mobile client that retried on timeout, and one customer was charged twice for one order.
Second, exponential backoff with jitter. Without the random offset, every client that failed at the same moment retries at the same moment. Third, an explicit timeout on every network call. Python’s requests, Go’s default http.Client and Axios have none unless you set one, which is how one slow dependency eats a whole thread pool.
Caveat: idempotency keys move the problem rather than remove it. The key store has to be durable and checked atomically with the work, or the double charge comes back under a race. Retries also need a budget, or backoff only delays the pile-up.
Key Quotes

“Every network call is a coin flip you don’t get to see the result of. Write the code that assumes it landed wrong.” (06:01)
“A thousand clients retrying in perfect lockstep aren’t recovering from the outage. They are the outage.” (07:25)

Related:

notes/Every-reward-function-is-a-hackabl.title: Every reward function is a hackable proxy for the true goal
notes/Every-reward-function-is-a-hackabl.content:
EN — Reward hacking occurs when an agent exploits flaws or ambiguities in the reward function to earn high reward without completing the intended task. It exists because specifying a reward that perfectly captures the true goal is fundamentally hard: states are partially observed, goals are abstract, and any proxy leaves a gap that RL optimization will exploit. Goodhart’s Law captures the core dynamic — when a measure becomes a target, it ceases to be a good measure.
中文 — 当智能体利用奖励函数的缺陷或歧义获取高奖励却未完成预期任务时，即发生奖励黑客。它之所以存在，是因为指定一个能完美捕捉真实目标的奖励从根本上就很困难：状态部分可观测、目标抽象，而任何代理都会留下 RL 优化可利用的缝隙。古德哈特定律概括了这一核心动态——当一个指标成为目标，它就不再是好指标。

notes/Explanatory-creativity-can-cross-g.filePath: notes/Explanatory creativity can cross gaps that evolution cannot.md
notes/Explanatory-creativity-can-cross-g.title: Explanatory creativity can cross gaps that evolution cannot
notes/Explanatory-creativity-can-cross-g.content:
EN: Biological evolution and human thought both create knowledge by variation and selection, but evolution has no foresight. Its variations happen before selection, and every intermediate step must be a viable organism. It can therefore only reach designs connected to existing ones by a path of useful steps. The bombardier beetle’s boiling-water spray is reachable because squirting cold water is already mildly useful, and each step can be a little hotter. A campfire is not reachable, because there is no such thing as a partially functional campfire, and no species ever evolved one. Likewise, no species will evolve an asteroid-deflection system, since asteroid strikes are too rare to exert incremental selection pressure. Human conjectures are explanatory, so they can leap straight to a distant idea (for example, “make the tailplane a single piece”), be criticized in the mind, and discard the failures without anyone having to build a series of planes that don’t fly. Being able to reach any idea and criticize it is what Deutsch means by universality, and it is why humans, unlike evolution, are not confined to local improvements.
中文：生物进化和人的思考都靠”变异加选择”创造知识，但进化没有预见性。它的变异发生在选择之前，而且每一个中间步骤都必须是能活下来的生物，所以它只能到达”从现有设计沿着一串有用步骤走得到”的地方。庞步甲喷沸水能进化出来，因为喷冷水本来就有点用，然后可以一点点变热。篝火就进化不出来，因为不存在”半个有用的篝火”，也从来没有哪个物种进化出篝火。同样，没有哪个物种会进化出偏转小行星的系统，因为小行星撞击太罕见，形成不了逐步的选择压力。人的猜想是解释性的，所以能直接跳到很远的想法（比如”把尾翼做成一整块”），先在脑子里接受批评、淘汰失败的方案，而不必真的造出一串飞不起来的飞机。能到达任何想法并批评它，这就是 Deutsch 说的”通用性”，也是人不像进化那样被困在局部改进里的原因。
Key Quotes

“There is no such thing as making a partially functional campfire; whereas there is, for example, with making hot water.” — Deutsch, Knowledge Creation and The Human Race, Part 1 (~8:06)
“It’s not only faster, it is explanatory, which means… it can leap over gaps in the knowledge space that couldn’t be traversed incrementally.” — The Deutsch Files III (~8:04)
“It has to traverse it while staying alive.” — same

notes/Extending-a-pretrained-model-to-a-.filePath: notes/Extending a pretrained model to a new dimension means inserting identity-initialized modules and freezing the backbone.md
notes/Extending-a-pretrained-model-to-a-.title: Extending a pretrained model to a new dimension means inserting identity-initialized modules and freezing the backbone
notes/Extending-a-pretrained-model-to-a-.content:
EN — Make-A-Video, Video LDM, and Lumiere all extend a pretrained text-to-image model to video by inserting new temporal layers (1D convolutions or attention) after existing spatial layers, initializing them as identity so the model starts out exactly as the image model, then fine-tuning only the new parameters while the image backbone stays frozen. This inherits the text-image prior and drastically cuts the text-video data required. The pattern generalizes: when extending a trained model along a new axis, add capacity that defaults to a no-op and train only the delta.
中文 — Make-A-Video、Video LDM 和 Lumiere 都通过在现有空间层之后插入新的时间层（1D 卷积或注意力）把预训练文生图模型扩展到视频，将其初始化为恒等函数使模型初始时完全等同于图像模型，然后只微调新参数、冻结图像骨干。这样继承了文本-图像先验，大幅减少所需的文本-视频数据。这个模式可以泛化：沿新轴扩展已训练模型时，添加默认为空操作的容量，只训练增量部分。

notes/Facts-should-be-verified-against-r.filePath: notes/Facts should be verified against retrieved evidence rather than model opinion.md
notes/Facts-should-be-verified-against-r.title: Facts should be verified against retrieved evidence rather than model opinion
notes/Facts-should-be-verified-against-r.content:
EN — Across FActScore and SAFE, retrieval-grounded verification consistently beats asking the model to judge a fact without context. FActScore decomposes generations into atomic facts and checks each against Wikipedia, with retrieval-then-LLM beating a non-context LLM judge; SAFE goes further, using an LLM agent to issue multi-step Google searches per atomic fact, reaching 72% agreement with humans and winning 76% of disagreements at one-twentieth the cost. The pattern generalizes: a model’s parametric opinion is a weak factuality signal, while retrieved evidence plus an entailment check is a strong one.
中文 — 在 FActScore 和 SAFE 中，基于检索的验证始终优于让模型在无上下文情况下判断事实。FActScore 将生成分解为原子事实并逐条对照 Wikipedia 核查，“检索→LLM”优于无上下文的 LLM 判断；SAFE 更进一步，用 LLM 智能体为每个原子事实发出多步 Google 搜索，与人类一致率达 72%，在分歧中胜率 76%，成本仅为二十分之一。这个模式具有普遍性：模型的参数化意见是弱事实性信号，而检索证据加蕴含检查是强信号。

notes/Fearing-failure-rejects-success-be.filePath: notes/Fearing failure rejects success because both share one path.md
notes/Fearing-failure-rejects-success-be.title: Fearing failure rejects success because both share one path
notes/Fearing-failure-rejects-success-be.content:
Success and failure are not two forks in the road; they are two possible outcomes of the same action, and you cannot claim one while refusing the other. Any rewarding action is rewarding precisely because its outcome is uncertain — certainties have their payoffs competed away, so the possibility of failure is the entry ticket to success, not its opposite. The only way to eliminate the risk of failure is to not act, which sets the probability of success to exactly zero. Fear of failure therefore feels like avoiding a bad outcome but is actually discarding both outcomes at once, including the wanted one.
This holds most cleanly where results are verifiable and iterable: each failure is feedback that moves you one step closer, so refusing failure means refusing feedback and staying in place — the same reason A working implementation now signals twenty percent done rather than eighty percent and why Luck matters less when you become repeatedly opportunity-ready only pays off to those repeatedly in motion.
The claim is not “take any risk” or “more failure is better.” It requires that failures be survivable and information-bearing; betting everything on one move, or repeating the same failure without learning, is not what this defends. What rejects success is refusing to act in order to remove the possibility of failure — trading away the upside to escape a downside that was the price of the upside all along.

notes/Few-shot-prompt-performance-swings.filePath: notes/Few-shot prompt performance swings wildly with example choice and order.md
notes/Few-shot-prompt-performance-swings.title: Few-shot prompt performance swings wildly with example choice and order
notes/Few-shot-prompt-performance-swings.content:
EN — Studies of in-context learning find that prompt format, the chosen training examples, and their order can change performance from near-random guessing to near state-of-the-art. Zhao et al. attribute the variance to majority-label bias (unbalanced label distribution), recency bias (repeating the last label), and common-token bias. Practical fixes include selecting examples by embedding similarity or diversity, randomizing order, and calibrating output probabilities.
中文 — 上下文学习研究发现，提示格式、所选训练示例及其顺序可使性能从接近随机猜测波动到接近最先进水平。Zhao 等人将这种方差归因于多数标签偏差（标签分布不均）、近因偏差（重复末尾标签）和常见 token 偏差。实际对策包括按嵌入相似度或多样性选示例、随机化顺序，以及校准输出概率。
Related:

Automatic prompt engineering treats instructions as programs
Self-consistency sampling improves reliability through majority vote
Chain-of-thought pays off only for complex reasoning in large models
Prompt optimization turns prompt writing into measurable search

notes/Fine-tuning-LLMs-on-new-knowledge-.filePath: notes/Fine-tuning LLMs on new knowledge can increase hallucination.md
notes/Fine-tuning-LLMs-on-new-knowledge-.title: Fine-tuning LLMs on new knowledge can increase hallucination
notes/Fine-tuning-LLMs-on-new-knowledge-.content:
EN — Gekhman et al. (2024) found that LLMs fit fine-tuning examples containing new knowledge substantially slower than examples consistent with what they already know — and that once those “unknown” examples are learned, the model’s tendency to hallucinate goes up. Dev-set accuracy is best when the model fits most known examples but only a few unknown ones, and degrades as it memorizes the rest. The implication is that small-scale SFT is a risky way to update a model’s knowledge, and alignment data built from RAG outputs can accidentally distill facts the model never knew.
中文 — Gekhman 等人（2024）发现，LLM 拟合包含新知识的微调示例的速度明显慢于拟合与已有知识一致的示例——而一旦这些”未知”示例被学会，模型的幻觉倾向反而上升。开发集准确率在模型拟合大部分已知示例、仅拟合少数未知示例时最佳，随着它记住其余示例而下降。其含义是：小规模 SFT 是更新模型知识的危险方式，用 RAG 输出构建的对齐数据可能意外蒸馏进模型从未知晓的事实。

notes/Finite-context-length-forces-agent.title: Finite context length forces agent design to work within limited communication bandwidth
notes/Finite-context-length-forces-agent.content:
EN — The context window is the scarce resource in agent design: it must hold conversation history, detailed instructions, API call context, and responses all at once. Retrieval widens the accessible knowledge pool but loses the full power of attention, so systems have to engineer carefully around this bandwidth limit rather than assume infinite memory.

notes/First-principles-reasoning-replace.filePath: notes/First principles reasoning replaces precedent with the constituent elements of a problem.md
notes/First-principles-reasoning-replace.title: First principles reasoning replaces precedent with the constituent elements of a problem
notes/First-principles-reasoning-replace.content:
EN — Musk defines first principles as breaking things down to the fundamental, axiomatic elements most likely to be true and reasoning up from there, “as opposed to reasoning by analogy or metaphor”. The contrast is with precedent: the usual way to ask what a rocket should cost is to look at what rockets have cost and assume the next one will be similar. The first-principles way is to list the materials, their weights and their price per kilogram, which sets a floor the cost can approach; when that floor is only 1–2% of the historical price, manufacturing must be very inefficient (this is what the idiot index measures). The same move handles “impossible” schedules: suppliers quoted 18–24 months for a 100,000-GPU cluster, and xAI split the need into a building, power, cooling, power smoothing and networking, then solved each with existing parts (an old factory, rented generators and chillers, Megapacks). He pairs it with “thinking in the limit”, pushing a variable to its minimum or maximum to see what happens, and treats both as tools of physics that apply to any field. Caveat: the floor shows how far a cost could fall, not how to get there or what it costs in time and talent; decomposing a problem works when the parts are truly independent, and the Colossus account is his own telling of a success.
中文 — Musk 对第一性原理的定义是：把事物拆到最可能为真的基本公理元素，再从那里尽可能严密地往上推，“而不是靠类比或比喻来推理”。对立面是先例：问一枚火箭该多少钱，通常做法是看过去的火箭卖多少钱，假设下一枚差不多。第一性原理的做法是列出材料、各自的重量和每公斤价格，这给出一个成本可以逼近的下限；如果这个下限只占历史价格的 1–2%，制造就一定极度低效（白痴指数量的就是这个）。同样的做法也能对付”不可能”的工期：供应商说 10 万张 GPU 的集群要 18–24 个月，xAI 把需求拆成厂房、电力、冷却、电力平滑和组网，再用现成的东西逐项解决（旧工厂、租来的发电机和冷却机、Megapack）。他把它和”极限思维”配在一起：把一个变量推到最小或最大，看会发生什么；他认为这两样都是物理的工具，适用于任何领域。局限： 下限说明成本能降多少，不说明怎么降、要花多少时间和人才；拆解只在各部分真正相互独立时管用；Colossus 的故事是他本人对一次成功的讲述。
Key Quotes

“First principles… means break things down to the fundamental axiomatic elements that are most likely to be true and then reason up from there as cogently as possible, as opposed to reasoning by analogy or metaphor.” — YC AI Startup School (25:55)
“The raw materials of a rocket are only maybe one or 2% of the historical cost of a rocket. So the manufacturing must necessarily be very inefficient.” — YC AI Startup School (27:29)
“We were told something is impossible, but once we broke it down into the constituent elements… then we could solve those constituent elements.” — YC AI Startup School (30:19)

notes/GRPO's-biggest-gain-comes-from-dis.filePath: notes/GRPO's biggest gain comes from discarding incorrect samples.md
notes/GRPO's-biggest-gain-comes-from-dis.title: GRPO's biggest gain comes from discarding incorrect samples
notes/GRPO's-biggest-gain-comes-from-dis.content:
EN — Decomposing GRPO reveals that its largest performance contribution is not reward normalization or any sophisticated correction — it is simply filtering out incorrect samples before the policy update. Methods like RAFT or Reinforce-Rej achieve comparable stability and KL efficiency with far simpler mechanisms. This is characteristic of the “tricks vs traps” landscape: Clip-Higher (asymmetric PPO clipping that lets unlikely-but-useful tokens rise) genuinely helps exploration, but other supposedly important knobs (normalization in particular) have contradictory evidence across studies. The field’s real bottleneck is not better tricks but unified experimental protocols and scalability–performance–cost curves.
中文 — 分解 GRPO 会发现其最大性能贡献不是奖励归一化或任何精巧修正，而只是在策略更新前丢弃错误样本。RAFT、Reinforce-Rej 等方法用简单得多的机制达到相当的稳定性与 KL 效率。这是”技巧 vs 陷阱”格局的缩影：Clip-Higher（让低概率但有用的 token 更容易上升的非对称 PPO 裁剪）确实有助探索，但其他 supposedly 重要的旋钮（尤其是归一化）在不同研究中证据互相矛盾。领域真正的瓶颈不是更好的技巧，而是统一的实验协议和可扩展性-性能-成本曲线。

notes/General-methods-that-keep-scaling-.filePath: notes/General methods that keep scaling with computation beat human-knowledge methods in the long run.md
notes/General-methods-that-keep-scaling-.title: General methods that keep scaling with computation beat human-knowledge methods in the long run
notes/General-methods-that-keep-scaling-.content:
EN — Sutton’s bitter lesson: because the cost of computation keeps falling exponentially, the methods that win over a long horizon are the general ones that can absorb ever more compute. It is not a claim that “scale is all that matters.” CS336 reads it as: the algorithms that scale are what matter, since accuracy is roughly efficiency times resources and efficiency matters more as budgets grow. The test for a method is whether it keeps improving as compute becomes very large, not whether it wins at today’s fixed budget.
中文 — Sutton 的”苦涩的教训”：由于单位算力成本持续指数下降，长期取胜的是能不断吸收更多算力的通用方法。这并不等于”只有规模重要”。CS336 的读法是：能随规模扩展的算法才重要——精度大致等于效率乘以资源，预算越大效率越重要。检验一个方法的标准，是算力变得极大时它是否还在持续变好，而不是它在今天固定预算下是否领先。

notes/Generating-a-whole-sequence-at-onc.filePath: notes/Generating a whole sequence at once avoids the consistency failures of keyframe-plus-interpolation pipelines.md
notes/Generating-a-whole-sequence-at-onc.title: Generating a whole sequence at once avoids the consistency failures of keyframe-plus-interpolation pipelines
notes/Generating-a-whole-sequence-at-onc.content:
EN — Many video pipelines generate distant keyframes first and fill the gaps with temporal super-resolution, which makes temporal consistency hard to maintain because each stage can only see part of the sequence. Lumiere’s STUNet instead downsamples video in both time and space and generates the entire duration in a single pass, removing the interpolation stage. Joint generation over the full axis avoids the error accumulation of staged, factorized generation.
中文 — 许多视频流水线先生成远处的关键帧，再用时间超分辨率填补空缺，这使得时序一致性难以维持，因为每个阶段只能看到序列的一部分。Lumiere 的 STUNet 转而在时间和空间上同时下采样，单次前向生成整个时长，去掉了插值阶段。沿整个轴的联合生成避免了分阶段、分解式生成的误差累积。
Related:

notes/Hallucination-is-either-unfaithful.filePath: notes/Hallucination is either unfaithful to context or ungrounded in world knowledge.md
notes/Hallucination-is-either-unfaithful.title: Hallucination is either unfaithful to context or ungrounded in world knowledge
notes/Hallucination-is-either-unfaithful.content:
EN — Weng narrows “hallucination” to output that is fabricated and not grounded, splitting it into in-context hallucination (output inconsistent with the provided source content) and extrinsic hallucination (output unsupported by world knowledge as proxied by the pretraining corpus). The distinction matters because the fixes differ: in-context hallucination is a grounding and attention problem, while extrinsic hallucination demands factuality plus the ability to abstain when the model does not know. Treating every model error as “hallucination” hides this structure.
中文 — Weng 将”幻觉”收窄为虚构且无依据的输出，分为上下文内幻觉（与所提供源内容不一致）和外部幻觉（得不到以预训练语料为代理的世界知识支持）。这一区分很重要，因为修复方式不同：上下文内幻觉是依据与注意力问题，而外部幻觉要求事实性加上在不知道时弃答的能力。把所有模型错误都称为”幻觉”会掩盖这一结构。

notes/Hard-to-learn-samples-are-often-th.filePath: notes/Hard-to-learn samples are often the most informative for OOD generalization.md
notes/Hard-to-learn-samples-are-often-th.title: Hard-to-learn samples are often the most informative for OOD generalization
notes/Hard-to-learn-samples-are-often-th.content:
EN — Data Maps shows hard-to-learn (low confidence, low variability) samples are the most likely to be mislabeled — but the same study finds ambiguous (high variability) and hard samples improve OOD generalization, beating even training on the full dataset. Treating “hard for the model” as “wrong in the data” would discard the most educational examples. Difficulty is a flag for inspection, not a deletion order.
中文 — Data Maps 表明难学习（低置信度、低变异性）样本最可能被标错——但同一研究发现，模糊（高变异性）和困难样本能改善 OOD 泛化，效果甚至超过用完整数据集训练。把”模型觉得难”当作”数据标错了”会丢弃最有教育价值的样本。困难是需要检查的信号，而非删除指令。

notes/Harness-edits-must-be-falsifiable-.filePath: notes/Harness edits must be falsifiable and the evaluator must stay outside the loop.md
notes/Harness-edits-must-be-falsifiable-.title: Harness edits must be falsifiable and the evaluator must stay outside the loop
notes/Harness-edits-must-be-falsifiable-.content:
EN — When a program is allowed to edit its own harness, abstraction boundaries break, so the editable surface must be bounded and the verifier, tracer, and permission controls must live outside the evolution loop. Agentic Harness Engineering makes every edit a file-level, falsifiable claim paired with a prediction and grounded in failure evidence, while keeping the runs directory, tracer, verifier, and LLM configuration read-only — this disables reward hacking such as disabling the verifier or swapping the model, and keeps every recorded gain attributable to the harness edit. Held-out tests, trace audits, and human review at key decision points remain necessary, because a self-improvement loop optimizes whatever signal it is given.
中文 — 当程序被允许编辑自己的 harness 时，抽象边界就被打破，因此可编辑表面必须有界，验证器、追踪器和权限控制必须位于进化循环之外。Agentic Harness Engineering 把每次编辑变成文件级、可证伪的主张，附带预测并以失败证据为依据，同时保持 runs 目录、tracer、验证器和 LLM 配置只读——这禁用了禁用验证器、更换模型等奖励黑客行为，使每次记录的增益都可归因于 harness 编辑。留出测试、轨迹审计和关键决策点的人工审查仍然必要，因为自我改进循环会优化它所获得的任何信号。

notes/High-value-work-sits-where-out-of-.filePath: notes/High-value work sits where out-of-distribution judgment meets leverage.md
notes/High-value-work-sits-where-out-of-.title: High-value work sits where out-of-distribution judgment meets leverage
notes/High-value-work-sits-where-out-of-.content:
EN — Durable high-value work needs two axes at once, not one. The first axis is how out-of-distribution the work is — how hard your output is to compress into training data (novel problems, messy under-sensored reality, taste that isn’t reducible to logs). The second is leverage — how much the same judgment can be amplified across assets, audiences, or systems. Being strong on only one axis fails: pure out-of-distribution craft with no leverage is a high-end artisan whose income stays linear with time (Naval - You Won’t Get Rich Renting Out Your Time); pure leverage over commodity content is fragile because the leverage itself (AI) is being commoditized. The target is the corner where both hold: judgment specific enough to resist compression, applied through leverage that keeps producing value when you are not present. Because the tail moves — today’s out-of-distribution work becomes tomorrow’s training data — the move is a verb, not a position: stay at the frontier where training is incomplete, and convert that judgment into owned, leveraged assets rather than a job that pays you to generate data for your own replacement.
中文 — 持久的高价值工作需要两个轴同时成立,而不是一个。第一个轴是工作的”分布外程度”——你的产出有多难被压缩进训练数据(新颖问题、传感器不足的杂乱现实、无法还原为日志的品味)。第二个轴是杠杆——同样的判断力能被放大到多大的资产、受众或系统上。只占一个轴都会失败:纯粹分布外但无杠杆的手艺,只是收入与时间线性绑定的高级手艺人(Naval - You Won’t Get Rich Renting Out Your Time);纯粹在商品化内容上加杠杆则很脆弱,因为杠杆本身(AI)正在被商品化。目标是两者兼备的那个角落:专属到足以抵抗压缩的判断力,通过杠杆施加出去,使其在你不在场时仍持续产生价值。由于长尾会移动——今天的分布外工作会变成明天的训练数据——正确的做法是一个动词而非一个位置:持续待在训练尚不完整的前沿,并把这种判断力沉淀为你拥有的、带杠杆的资产,而不是一份”付钱让你为自己的替代者生产数据”的工作。

notes/Honesty-pays-in-long-games-because.filePath: notes/Honesty pays in long games because duplicity gets more expensive as information flows.md
notes/Honesty-pays-in-long-games-because.title: Honesty pays in long games because duplicity gets more expensive as information flows
notes/Honesty-pays-in-long-games-because.content:
EN — Zhang Yiming argues for honesty on economic rather than moral grounds. In short interactions, talking things up earns a premium; in long ones, plain talk does. As information moves faster and becomes more transparent, being one thing in private and another in public gets more expensive, so not pretending is not only the better character but the cheaper strategy. Holding to principles works the same way: a short-term paper loss for a long-term gain. He backs it with Zhou Qiren’s finding that the best-paid migrant workers were not the strongest or most skilled but the most trusted, and turns it into a rule about work itself: every piece of work is deposited into or withdrawn from your credibility, because “we are what we repeatedly do”. Caveat: the argument depends on the game actually being repeated and observable; in one-off or opaque settings the premium on duplicity can persist, and “it’s more economical” is a weaker defense of honesty than a moral one exactly where it is most needed.
中文 — 张一鸣为诚实辩护，用的是经济理由而不是道德理由。短期交往，说话忽悠有溢价；长期交往，说话实在有溢价。信息流动越来越快、越来越透明，做一个表里不一的人成本越来越高，所以不装不只是品性上更好，也是更便宜的策略。坚持原则也一样，是”短期浮亏的长期受益的投资”。他引周其仁的研究：收入最高的农民工不是体力最好、技能最好的，而是最受信任的；又把它变成一条关于工作本身的规则：每一次工作都是在给信誉存钱或取钱，“We are what we repeatedly do”。局限： 这个论证依赖博弈确实是重复的、可被观察的；在一次性或不透明的场合，忽悠的溢价可能一直存在。而恰恰在最需要诚实的地方，“更经济”是比道德更弱的理由。
Key Quotes

「短期交往说话忽悠会有溢价，长期交往说话实在会有溢价。」（成长 #023）
「在这个信息流动越来越快越来越透明的社会，从经济的角度来看，做一个表里不一的人成本越来越高……不装不但是一个道德品性优选，而且也是更经济的。」（成长 #045）
「坚持原则很多时候是经济的，可以看做是一种短期浮亏的长期受益的投资。」（成长 #039）
「工作基本上是一个积累信誉的过程，自己今天的工作一直在为自己的明天积累信誉。」（管理 #022）

Related:

notes/Human-in-the-loop-prompt-optimizat.filePath: notes/Human-in-the-loop prompt optimization preserves domain judgment.md
notes/Human-in-the-loop-prompt-optimizat.title: Human-in-the-loop prompt optimization preserves domain judgment
notes/Human-in-the-loop-prompt-optimizat.content:
Human-in-the-loop APO keeps the search benefits of automated prompt variation while letting users judge domain fit, readability, explanation quality, and tradeoffs that are not fully captured by a scalar metric.
