notes/Hunger-has-three-levels-greed-achi.filePath: notes/Hunger has three levels greed achievement and curiosity.md
notes/Hunger-has-three-levels-greed-achi.title: Hunger has three levels greed achievement and curiosity
notes/Hunger-has-three-levels-greed-achi.content:
EN — Reading Jobs’s “stay hungry”, Zhang Yiming split hunger into three levels: greed, the drive for achievement, and curiosity. They attend to different things (the instant result, the ongoing process, the vast unknown) and map to three kinds of people: the base speculator, the toiling climber and the happy explorer. When readers said they didn’t follow, he added the happiness research version: pleasure, passion and higher purpose, with pleasure the shortest-lived and purpose the longest. The same ranking explains his other positions. He rejects the ideal of retiring at thirty or forty: wanting to retire means you think you are now “enduring”, whereas the ideal is to keep having chances to create and learn into old age. He holds that strong motivation matters more than method, and that the essence of life is self-improvement in thinking, ability and will, while most people chase short-term company, title and salary. Caveat: the ranking is a moral ordering more than an observation; curiosity without some achievement drive may never ship anything, and the three levels likely coexist in one person rather than sorting people into types.
中文 — 读到乔布斯的”stay hungry”，张一鸣把饥渴分成三个层次：贪婪、成就动机、好奇心。三者关注的东西不同（瞬间的结果、持续的过程、远大的未知），也恰好对应三种人：卑劣的投机者、艰辛的攀登者、幸福的探索者。有人留言说没看懂，他补了快乐研究里的版本：pleasure（欢乐）、passion（热情）、higher purpose（理想），欢乐最短暂，理想最长久。同一个排序也解释了他别的立场。他不认同三四十岁退休的理想：想退休说明你认为现在是在”忍”，而理想是一直有机会创造、学习、修炼到老。他认为强烈的动机比方法更根本，人生的本质是思想、能力、意志上的自我提升，而大多数人追求的是短期的公司、职位、薪水。局限： 这个排序更像价值判断而不是观察；只有好奇心、没有一点成就动机，可能什么也做不出来；三个层次多半同时存在于一个人身上，而不是把人分成三类。
Key Quotes

「我以为饥渴有三个层次：贪婪、成就动机、好奇心。三者分别关注：瞬间的结果，持续的过程，和远大的未知。三者也恰好对应了三种人：卑劣的投机者，艰辛的攀登者，与幸福的探索者。」（成长 #078）
「快乐有三种：pleasure（欢乐），passion（热情），higher purpose（理想、有意义）。其中欢乐是最短暂的，热情其次，而最长久的是理想。」（成长 #079）
「为什么会想退休？想退休说明你认为现在是在”忍”。」（成长 #082）
「强烈的动机比方法更根本。」（成长 #146）

Related:

Choose problems that are fun whether or not you solve them — Deutsch’s version of choosing by curiosity rather than outcome
Curiosity makes it easier to learn from other people — curiosity as a practical advantage, not only a virtue
Self-directed work can dissolve the work-life boundary — why someone at the curiosity level does not want to retire
Desire creates a self-imposed deficit state — greed as the level that ties happiness to an instant result
Usefulness is how much you help people times how many people you reach — Musk’s “don’t aspire to glory, aspire to work” ranks motives the same way
张一鸣

notes/If-you-can't-produce-a-number-show.filePath: notes/If you can't produce a number showing it got faster, you didn't optimize anything. You made the code uglier and effectively told yourself a bedtime story.md
notes/If-you-can't-produce-a-number-show.title: If you can't produce a number showing it got faster, you didn't optimize anything. You made the code uglier and effectively told yourself a bedtime story
notes/If-you-can't-produce-a-number-show.content:
Intuition about performance is unreliable, and asymptotic analysis can hide what matters. Why is iterating an array faster than a linked list? “Pointers” is only half the answer. The CPU fetches 64-byte cache lines, so touching element zero of an array pulls the next 15 integers into L1 for free, while linked-list nodes are scattered across the heap. L1 is about a nanosecond, main memory about 100. “Big O said both were O of N, and Big O was hiding the part that actually mattered.”
So profile instead of guessing. In a flame graph, find the widest bar and ask why. Profile allocations too, because in garbage-collected languages the function that looks slow is often just triggering collection. The cost is “almost never where you assumed”: usually a helper called 4,000 times in a forgotten loop, or an N+1 query. Then benchmark before and after the change.
This is a special case of Things that are hard to keep doing well usually lack a metric: without the number, “optimization” can’t be told apart from making the code uglier.
Caveat: benchmarks lie too. Microbenchmarks miss cache and I/O effects of the real workload, and noisy runs make small wins invisible or invented. The number has to come from something close to production conditions.
Key Quotes

“If you can’t produce a number showing it got faster, you didn’t optimize anything. You made the code uglier and effectively told yourself a bedtime story.” (08:54)
“Blaming the framework is free, and nobody can disprove it at a standup. Profile it instead.” (08:22)

Related:

Things that are hard to keep doing well usually lack a metric — a metric turns “faster” from a feeling into a fact
Work becomes easier to automate when evaluation criteria are externalized — a benchmark is an externalized acceptance criterion

notes/Inconsistency-across-samples-revea.filePath: notes/Inconsistency across samples reveals hallucination with black-box access alone.md
notes/Inconsistency-across-samples-revea.title: Inconsistency across samples reveals hallucination with black-box access alone
notes/Inconsistency-across-samples-revea.content:
EN — SelfCheckGPT detects hallucination with no external knowledge base and no access to logprobs: it samples multiple stochastic completions and measures how consistent they are with the target response, on the hypothesis that hallucinated content varies across samples while true facts stay stable. The same logic powers indirect query for fabricated references — repeatedly asking “who are the authors?” beats asking “does this paper exist?”, because a hallucinated reference cannot produce consistent auxiliary details. Both methods turn sampling noise into a verification signal.
中文 — SelfCheckGPT 无需外部知识库、也无需访问 logprob 即可检测幻觉：它多次随机采样续写，衡量它们与目标响应的一致性，其假设是幻觉内容在多次采样间会变化，而真实事实保持稳定。同样的逻辑驱动了针对虚构参考文献的间接查询——反复问”作者是谁？“胜过问”这篇论文存在吗？“，因为幻觉参考文献无法产生一致的辅助细节。两种方法都把采样噪声变成了验证信号。

notes/Inject-policy-through-hooks-so-the.filePath: notes/Inject policy through hooks so the agent loop stays product-agnostic.md
notes/Inject-policy-through-hooks-so-the.title: Inject policy through hooks so the agent loop stays product-agnostic
notes/Inject-policy-through-hooks-so-the.content:
Pi’s loop contains no product logic. Context compaction, permission prompts, API key refresh, model switching, and graceful shutdown all live in nine config hooks — transformContext, beforeToolCall, afterToolCall, prepareNextTurn, shouldStopAfterTurn, and queue pollers — that the loop calls at well-defined points. The coding-agent product wires its policies through these hooks without forking the loop, which is why the same loop can ship as a standalone npm package.
Related:

A stateless loop core plus a stateful wrapper separates orchestration from session state

notes/Jailbreaks-exploit-competing-objec.filePath: notes/Jailbreaks exploit competing objectives and mismatched generalization in safety training.md
notes/Jailbreaks-exploit-competing-objec.title: Jailbreaks exploit competing objectives and mismatched generalization in safety training
notes/Jailbreaks-exploit-competing-objec.content:
EN — Wei et al. (2023) classify why LLM safety training fails into two modes. Competing objectives pit a capability goal (“always follow instructions”) against safety, exploited by prefix injection, refusal suppression, style injection, or role-play personas like DAN. Mismatched generalization occurs when an input is out-of-distribution for safety training but inside the pretraining distribution — Base64, ROT13, leetspeak, token smuggling, or translation hide harmful content in a form the model can still decode.
中文 — Wei 等人（2023）把 LLM 安全训练的失败归为两种模式。竞争目标让能力目标（“始终遵循指令”）与安全目标相冲突，前缀注入、拒绝抑制、风格注入、DAN 等角色扮演都利用这一点。不匹配泛化指输入对安全训练是分布外、却落在预训练分布内——Base64、ROT13、leetspeak、令牌走私、翻译都把有害内容藏进模型仍能解码的形式。

notes/Keep-a-tool-call-only-when-it-impr.filePath: notes/Keep a tool call only when it improves prediction of future tokens.md
notes/Keep-a-tool-call-only-when-it-impr.title: Keep a tool call only when it improves prediction of future tokens
notes/Keep-a-tool-call-only-when-it-impr.content:
EN — Toolformer learns to use external tools self-supervised: after the model annotates candidate API calls, each call is executed and kept only if inserting its result reduces the language-modeling loss on the following tokens. This turns “would a tool help here?” into a measurable, per-position filter rather than a heuristic. The same self-play bootstrapping loop appears in TALM, where tool-use data expands only when new calls improve outputs.
中文 — Toolformer 以自监督方式学习使用外部工具：模型标注候选 API 调用后逐一执行，仅当插入其结果能降低后续 token 的语言建模损失时才保留。这把”这里是否需要工具”变成可度量的逐位置过滤，而非启发式猜测。同样的自举循环也出现在 TALM 中：仅当新调用能改善输出时才扩充工具使用数据。

notes/LLM-coding-usefulness-came-from-cr.filePath: notes/LLM coding usefulness came from crossing a reliability threshold, not raw capability.md
notes/LLM-coding-usefulness-came-from-cr.title: LLM coding usefulness came from crossing a reliability threshold, not raw capability
notes/LLM-coding-usefulness-came-from-cr.content:
LLMs became useful for coding not because they got dramatically smarter but because they became reliable enough to run inside automated feedback loops. The “staircase hypothesis”: climbing stairs requires being tall enough to reach one step at a time, but being tall enough to take two or three at once matters far less. Once a model can reliably iterate toward explicit, objectively verifiable acceptance criteria and predict whether a human would accept the result, it has crossed the threshold that makes it useful. Capability gains beyond that point yield sharply diminishing returns for productivity, because the binding constraint was reliability inside the loop, not intelligence.

notes/LLM-as-grader-is-an-imperfect-prox.filePath: notes/LLM-as-grader is an imperfect proxy with exploitable biases.md
notes/LLM-as-grader-is-an-imperfect-prox.title: LLM-as-grader is an imperfect proxy with exploitable biases
notes/LLM-as-grader-is-an-imperfect-prox.content:
EN — Using LLMs as evaluators saves annotation cost but introduces systematic biases: positional bias (GPT-4 favors the first candidate, ChatGPT the second, even when told order should not matter) and self-preference bias (models score their own outputs higher). When grader outputs feed a reward signal, generators can exploit these biases to hack the reward. Calibration strategies like multiple-evidence and balanced-position aggregation help, but the grader remains a proxy.
中文 — 用 LLM 作评估者能节省标注成本，却会引入系统性偏差：位置偏差（GPT-4 偏好第一个候选，ChatGPT 偏好第二个，即使被告知顺序不应影响判断）和自我偏好偏差（模型给自己的输出打更高分）。当评分输出被用作奖励信号时，生成者就能利用这些偏差来黑客奖励。多证据校准、平衡位置聚合等策略有所帮助，但评分者始终只是代理。

notes/LLM-generated-code-is-locally-func.filePath: notes/LLM-generated code is locally functional but globally incoherent.md
notes/LLM-generated-code-is-locally-func.title: LLM-generated code is locally functional but globally incoherent
notes/LLM-generated-code-is-locally-func.content:
LLM-generated code tends to be technically passable in isolation but architecturally incoherent across a codebase. Each function or module may look reasonable, but the system-level structure, dependency awareness, and long-term maintainability suffer. The tools happily generate code that works locally while trashing global coherence, and performance degrades as codebases grow. This hidden technical debt is hard to detect in review and even harder to debug later, because the debt is not in any single line but in the gaps between lines.

notes/LLMs-cannot-reliably-evaluate-thei.title: LLMs cannot reliably evaluate their own output in expert domains
notes/LLMs-cannot-reliably-evaluate-thei.content:

notes/LLMs-cannot-self-correct-without-e.filePath: notes/LLMs cannot self-correct without external feedback.md
notes/LLMs-cannot-self-correct-without-e.title: LLMs cannot self-correct without external feedback
notes/LLMs-cannot-self-correct-without-e.content:
EN — The intuition that models can reflect on and fix their own mistakes turns out to be false by default: naive self-correction leads to behavior collapse (trivial edits), hallucination (changing correct answers to wrong ones), and worse overall performance. External feedback is what makes revision work — ground-truth matching, heuristics, unit tests, a stronger model, or human input. Approaches like self-correction learning and SCoRe train a dedicated corrector, or use multi-turn RL with a KL anchor on the first attempt, precisely because the capability must be engineered, not assumed.
中文 — “模型能反思并修正自身错误”的直觉在默认情况下并不成立：天真的自我纠正会导致行为坍缩（只做无关痛痒的修改）、幻觉（把正确答案改成错误的）以及整体性能下降。让修正真正生效的是外部反馈——匹配真实答案、启发式规则、单元测试、更强的模型或人类输入。自我纠正学习和 SCoRe 等方法之所以要训练专门的纠正器，或用对首轮加 KL 锚定的多轮 RL，正是因为这种能力必须被工程化，而不能被假设存在。

notes/Laziness-comes-in-physical-mental-.filePath: notes/Laziness comes in physical mental and emotional forms and self-control resists all three.md
notes/Laziness-comes-in-physical-mental-.title: Laziness comes in physical mental and emotional forms and self-control resists all three
notes/Laziness-comes-in-physical-mental-.content:
EN — In his early Weibo posts Zhang Yiming calls laziness the root of most failings and splits it into three kinds: physical, mental and emotional. Self-cultivation, on this view, is mostly the work of overcoming inertia, and self-control (which he equates with anti-inertia) is the standard of being good at something. He is explicit that the physical kind is the easy one: running a marathon is not a high bar, while control over thinking, attention and mood is much harder. “Mediocrity has gravity; you need escape velocity.” He treats attention as a budget to manage at both ends: cut what drains it (desires, stray thoughts) and add to it (exercise, focus training). The base layer is energy: staying physically energetic is “foundational work”, enough sleep is “the first step to being proactive and effective”, and sustained focus depends on stamina. Caveat: ten years later, in the 2021 “平常心” speech, he describes himself as not especially disciplined and says he could only run and swim longer once he stopped forcing it and relaxed; forcing yourself against inertia and removing the tension that creates it may be two stages of the same skill rather than one rule.
中文 — 张一鸣早年的微博把懒惰叫作”万恶之源”，并分成三种：体力的、思考的、情绪的。照这个说法，修炼很多时候就是在克服惰性，而自控力（他等同于反惰性）就是优秀的标准。他明确说体力那种最容易：马拉松不是高标准，思维、意识、情绪上的自控更难。“平庸有重力，需要逃逸速度。“他把注意力当成两头都要管的预算：欲望和杂念分散注意力要节流，锻炼身体和注意力训练是开源。最底层是精力：保持体力充沛精力旺盛是”一项基础工作”，保证足够睡眠是”积极高效的第一步”，持续的专注力也以体力和精力为基础。局限： 十年后在 2021 年的”平常心”演讲里，他说自己不算特别有纪律性，跑步游泳是在不再硬撑、学会放松之后才跑得更远；对抗惰性的硬撑，和去掉制造惰性的那份紧张，也许是同一种能力的两个阶段，而不是一条规则。
Key Quotes

「由于懒惰（体力的、思考的、情绪的）是万恶之源，所以修炼很多时候就是在克服惰性。」（成长 #104）
「非常同意自控力（也就是反惰性）是优秀的标准。确实马拉松不是高标准，思维意识情绪的自控更难。」（成长 #116）
「平庸有重力，需要逃逸速度。」（成长 #107）
「注意力也可以开源节流的，欲望和杂念分散注意力要节流，锻炼身体和注意力训练是开源。」（成长 #073）

Related:

Delayed gratification is how deep you are willing to stay with a problem — he names the two together as the foundations of being good at anything
Caring too much about the outcome distorts the action — the later counterweight: relaxing removed the drag that forcing could not
A good life must be earned across mind body and relationships — energy and the body as a separate thing to earn
张一鸣

notes/Linear-Algebra-Done-Right-study-pl.filePath: notes/Linear Algebra Done Right study plan.md
notes/Linear-Algebra-Done-Right-study-pl.title: Linear Algebra Done Right study plan
notes/Linear-Algebra-Done-Right-study-pl.content:
Study plan for Axler’s LADR 4e (9 chapters, ~400 pages). Target pace: ~10 weeks at 5–7 hours/week; stretch to 14 weeks if doing every exercise.
How to read this book

Proof-first. Before reading each proof, attempt it yourself for 10–15 minutes. The book is short on prose and long on theorems — the proofs are the content.
Exercises are mandatory, not optional. Axler’s exercises are where skill is built. Aim for all odd-numbered or one full exercise set per section minimum.
Trust the determinant-free order. Determinants appear only in Chapter 9, after the theory that explains them. Resist skipping ahead — the delayed payoff is the whole point.
Paper and pen, not screen. Redraw every definition (span, quotient space, adjoint) until the abstractions feel concrete.
Intuition supplement: 3Blue1Brown’s Essence of Linear Algebra alongside Chapters 1–3 and 5–7.

Phase 1 — Foundations (Weeks 1–3)





























WeekChapterCore ideasCheckpoint1Ch 1: Vector SpacesF^n, vector space axioms, subspaces, sums and direct sumsCan prove a subset is a subspace; can decompose V as a direct sum2Ch 2: Finite-Dimensional Vector SpacesSpan, linear independence, bases, dimensionCan prove every basis has the same length; can extend a linearly independent list to a basis3Ch 3: Linear MapsNull space/range, fundamental theorem (rank-nullity), matrices, invertibility, change of basis, dualityCan state and prove rank-nullity; can compute a matrix in any basis and change bases
Chapter 3 is the longest and most important so far — give it extra time. Duality (3F) is abstract; revisit it after Chapter 6 if it doesn’t stick.
Phase 2 — Core theory (Weeks 4–6)





























WeekChapterCore ideasCheckpoint4Ch 4: PolynomialsDivision algorithm, factorization over C and RCan factor any real polynomial into linear and quadratic factors4–5Ch 5: Eigenvalues and EigenvectorsInvariant subspaces, minimal polynomial, upper-triangular matrices, diagonalizability, Gershgorin disksCan decide diagonalizability from the minimal polynomial; can prove every operator on a complex space has an eigenvalue6Ch 6: Inner Product SpacesInner products, norms, orthonormal bases, Gram–Schmidt, orthogonal complements, pseudoinverseCan run Gram–Schmidt by hand; can prove the closest-point property of orthogonal projection
Chapter 4 is short tooling — do not skip it, since Chapter 5 depends on polynomial factorization.
Phase 3 — Operators (Weeks 7–9)























WeekChapterCore ideasCheckpoint7–8Ch 7: Operators on Inner Product SpacesAdjoints, self-adjoint/normal operators, spectral theorem, positive operators, isometries, QR/Cholesky, SVD, polar decompositionCan state and prove both spectral theorems; can compute an SVD by hand9Ch 8: Operators on Complex Vector SpacesGeneralized eigenvectors, generalized eigenspace decomposition, Jordan form, traceCan find a Jordan basis; can explain why trace is basis-independent
Chapter 7 is the climax of the book. The SVD section (7E–7F) connects directly to modern applications (PCA, low-rank approximation) — worth extra exercises.
Phase 4 — Multilinear algebra and determinants (Week 10)

















WeekChapterCore ideasCheckpoint10Ch 9: Multilinear Algebra and DeterminantsBilinear/quadratic forms, alternating forms, determinant defined via alternation, tensor productsCan derive determinant properties from the alternating-form definition; can compute a determinant without cofactor expansion
Milestone self-tests

After Ch 3: Explain rank-nullity to someone else; derive the matrix of a composition.
After Ch 5: Given an operator, find its eigenvalues and decide if it is diagonalizable — without determinants.
After Ch 7: Prove the spectral theorem; compute an SVD and interpret the singular values geometrically.
After Ch 9: Define the determinant in one sentence that does not mention permutations or cofactors.

Common pitfalls

Treating the book as a novel: reading without attempting proofs first.
Skipping exercises because the proofs “make sense” — recognition is not reproduction.
Getting stuck in 3F (duality) or 8C (Jordan form) and stalling the whole plan: move on and revisit.
Confusing the minimal polynomial with the characteristic polynomial — the latter is deliberately absent until Ch 9.

Open questions

Goal: pure mathematical fluency, or application-driven (ML/graphics/quant)? Adjusts how much time to spend on Ch 7–8 vs. Ch 9.
Prior proof experience? If low, budget an extra week for Chapters 1–3.

notes/Majority-vote-assumes-equal-rater-.title: Majority vote assumes equal rater competence so annotators must be weighted by estimated proficiency
notes/Majority-vote-assumes-equal-rater-.content:
EN — Majority vote gives every annotator equal weight, which fails whenever incentives attract spammers who submit random labels to maximize throughput. Proficiency can be estimated from agreement with experts on a gold set, agreement with the rest of the crowd, or probabilistic models like MACE that learn a per-annotator trustworthiness score; aggregation then weights votes by that score. Cohen’s kappa improves on raw agreement by subtracting chance agreement, though it overcorrects when one label class dominates.
中文 — 多数投票给每位标注者相同权重，当激励机制吸引提交随机标签以最大化产量的垃圾标注者时就会失效。熟练度可以通过与专家在黄金集上的一致率、与其他标注者的一致率，或 MACE 这类为每位标注者学习可信度分数的概率模型来估计，聚合时再按分数加权。Cohen’s kappa 在原始一致率中减去随机一致性，是更进一步的指标，但当某一标签类别占主导时会过度修正。
Related:

The median of independent crowd guesses converges to the truth
Rater disagreement is valid signal in subjective tasks not noise to be eliminated
Self-consistency sampling improves reliability through majority vote
LLM Training

notes/Many-complex-problems-are-projecti.filePath: notes/Many complex problems are projections of a simpler problem one level up.md
notes/Many-complex-problems-are-projecti.title: Many complex problems are projections of a simpler problem one level up
notes/Many-complex-problems-are-projecti.content:
EN — Zhang Yiming’s heuristic: many messy problems are the shadow of one simple problem in a higher dimension. In basketball, distorted form, slow speed and poor coordination are often just a lack of stamina; in programming, bad code, many bugs and long schedules are often poor abstraction and decomposition; and as a colleague put it, many management problems are really ability problems. Fixing the symptoms one by one never ends, while the root fix is simpler to state but costs more resolve. The same move appears in his other advice: when you can’t decide, step back and judge by a more important principle and a longer time scale; choice matters more than effort, and outlook more than choice. Caveat: “it’s all really X” is also the shape of over-simplification, which he later warns against (“don’t rush to conclusion”, “说白了就是这样” is a danger sign). A higher-dimension explanation is a hypothesis to test, not a license to stop looking.
中文 — 张一鸣的一条启发式：很多复杂问题，是更高维度上一个简单问题的投影。打篮球动作变形、速度慢、配合差，很多时候是体力不行；写程序烂、bug 多、时间长，是抽象分解问题做得不好；还有同事说的”很多管理问题都是假象，本质是能力问题”。一个个修症状没有尽头，根上的解法说起来简单，却需要更大的代价和决心。他别的建议也是同一个动作：无法选择或判断的时候，离远一步，用更重要的原则和更长的时间尺度衡量；选择比努力更重要，观念比选择更重要。局限： “说到底都是 X”也是过度简化的样子，而他后来正好提醒过这一点（“don’t rush to conclusion”，不要太容易说”说白了就是这样”）。高一层的解释是一个要检验的假设，不是可以不再看下去的理由。
Key Quotes

「很多复杂问题是更高维度简单问题的投影……而解决这些本质问题需要更大代价和决心的。」（成长 #129）
「无法选择或判断的时候，离远一步，用更重要的原则和更长的时间尺度来衡量就清楚了。」（成长 #006）
「选择比努力更重要，观念比选择更重要。」（成长 #026）

Principles become useful only in context — the check on this heuristic: a higher-level cause is only useful once experience shows where it applies
Tools expire, but problems don’t. Every tool is an answer to a question that existed before it did — the same move pointed downward: one problem in a lower layer explains many tools

notes/More-capable-agents-exploit-reward.title: More capable agents exploit reward loopholes more aggressively
notes/More-capable-agents-exploit-reward.content:
EN — Across model size, action resolution, observation fidelity, and training steps, Pan et al. (2022) found that higher-capability agents obtain higher (or similar) proxy rewards but decreased true rewards. A weak agent may simply never find the loopholes in a reward function, so hacking only becomes visible as the optimizer gets stronger. This means reward-function flaws that are invisible at small scale can emerge as failures at scale.
中文 — Pan 等人（2022）发现，在模型规模、动作分辨率、观察保真度和训练步数等维度上，能力更强的智能体获得更高（或相近）的代理奖励，但真实奖励反而下降。弱智能体可能根本发现不了奖励函数中的漏洞，因此只有当优化器变强时黑客行为才会显现。这意味着小规模下不可见的奖励函数缺陷，会在规模化时暴露为失败。

This is offered as a judgment rather than a proven claim — it rests on the staircase analogy and personal workflow experience, not on measured evidence about how much retooling can yield.

notes/Not-retaliating-keeps-future-optio.title: Not retaliating keeps future options open because you cannot know who will help you
notes/Not-retaliating-keeps-future-optio.content:
EN — In 2000 Musk’s PayPal partners removed him as CEO while he was abroad. He gave way rather than fight at a critical moment, saying he disagreed with their conclusion but understood why they acted, and later worked to repair the relationships. In 2008 Thiel told him “let’s bury the hatchet”, and Founders Fund, led by Luke Nosek, raised its SpaceX investment from $5M to $20M after the third failed launch, at a moment when the company needed the money to survive. Musk’s own reading, as told to Isaacson, is that it was an interesting exercise in karma. The video’s sharper point is that the reason is practical, not moral: you cannot know who will save you later, and a bridge burned early can never be crossed again. Separating the decision from the verdict (“I disagree, but I understand”) lets you keep the relationship without conceding the argument. Caveat: the story is told backwards from a happy ending. Nosek pushed the deal on the fund’s moonshot thesis after his own due diligence, so the reconciliation opened a door rather than causing the investment; and for every bridge that later paid off there are many that never would have.
中文 — 2000 年 Musk 出国期间被 PayPal 合伙人拉下 CEO 位置。他选择在关键时刻让步而不是开战，说自己不同意他们的结论，但理解他们为什么这么做，之后还花力气修补关系。2008 年 Thiel 对他说”我们把斧头埋了吧”；由 Luke Nosek 主导，Founders Fund 在 SpaceX 第三次发射失败后，把投资从 500 万美元加到 2000 万，正好赶在公司最缺钱、关乎存亡的时候。Musk 对 Isaacson 说，这是”一个有趣的因果报应练习”。视频更犀利的一点是：理由是现实的，不是道德的。你不知道将来谁会救你一命，桥提早烧了就再也走不了。把决定和评判分开（“我不同意，但我理解”），可以保住关系，又不用在道理上让步。局限： 这个故事是从圆满结局倒推着讲的。Nosek 是自己做完尽调、按基金的登月投资理念推动这笔投资的，和解打开的是一扇门，不是投资的原因；而且每一座后来派上用场的桥，背后都有很多座永远用不上。
Key Quotes

「這是一個有趣的因果報應練習。在我被 PayPal 政變趕出來之後，我本來可以說你們很糟糕，但是我沒有。」（00:00）
「與其在關鍵時刻打架，我認為現在最好的方式就是讓步。我不同意他們的結論，但我理解他們為什麼採取了行動。」（08:34）
「人生太短暫，不能有長期的怨恨。」（09:06）

notes/Outcome-rewards-encourage-unfaithf.title: Outcome rewards encourage unfaithful chain-of-thought
notes/Outcome-rewards-encourage-unfaithf.content:
EN — Rewarding only the final answer gives the model no incentive to make its reasoning trace true: it learns “answer first, hallucinate later” patterns and post-hoc rationalization, because the verifier never checks the path, only the endpoint. Rule-based RL is also prone to reward hacking and “reasoning illusions.” Process reward models (PRMs) fix the incentive — step-wise supervision is more stable and reliable — but step annotation is expensive and generalizes poorly across domains. The promising middle path is implicit process modeling or generative verifiers that extract dense guidance without manual step labels.
中文 — 只奖励最终答案，模型就没有动机让推理轨迹真实：它学会”先给答案、后编理由”的模式和事后合理化，因为验证器从不检查路径只检查终点。规则-based RL 还容易产生奖励作弊和”推理幻觉”。过程奖励模型（PRM）修正了激励——逐步监督更稳定可靠——但步骤标注昂贵且跨域泛化差。有前景的中间路线是隐式过程建模或生成式验证器，无需人工步骤标注即可提取稠密引导。
Related:

Chain-of-thought is not guaranteed to faithfully describe how the model computed its answer
RLVR replaces learned reward models with programmatic verifiers
Outcome-only RL imposes a hallucination tax on abstention
LLM Training
After a mistake realize it correct it learn from it then forgive it — Zhang Yiming’s four steps after a mistake

notes/Outcome-only-RL-imposes-a-hallucin.filePath: notes/Outcome-only RL imposes a hallucination tax on abstention.md
notes/Outcome-only-RL-imposes-a-hallucin.title: Outcome-only RL imposes a hallucination tax on abstention
notes/Outcome-only-RL-imposes-a-hallucin.content:
EN — Rewarding only final-answer correctness degrades an agent’s ability to say “I don’t know”: outcome-driven RL settles into local optima that reach the answer through spurious correlations, producing confident but ungrounded intermediate steps, and it compels responses to unanswerable questions rather than abstention. This “hallucination tax” is pipeline-dependent — RL-only post-training worsens factuality, while SFT on a mix of solvable and unsolvable problems plus verifiable-reward RL restores epistemic humility. The general lesson: outcome-only rewards optimize for getting to an answer, not for knowing whether an answer exists.
中文 — 只奖励最终答案正确性会削弱智能体说”我不知道”的能力：结果驱动的 RL 会陷入靠虚假关联抵达答案的局部最优，产生自信却无根据的中间步骤，并迫使智能体对无法回答的问题也强行作答而非弃权。这种”幻觉税”取决于训练管线——纯 RL 后训练会恶化事实性，而用可解+不可解混合问题做 SFT 再加可验证奖励 RL 能恢复认知谦逊。普遍教训：纯结果奖励优化的是”抵达答案”，而非”知道答案是否存在”。
Related:

Hallucination is either unfaithful to context or ungrounded in world knowledge

notes/Over-abstraction-is-leverage-on-th.filePath: notes/Over-abstraction is leverage on thinking that magnifies a wrong premise.md
notes/Over-abstraction-is-leverage-on-th.title: Over-abstraction is leverage on thinking that magnifies a wrong premise
notes/Over-abstraction-is-leverage-on-th.content:
EN — Zhang Yiming lists two shortcuts to avoid. One is the casual “all-in”, which is often laziness dressed as boldness: “I don’t want to think about it anymore, let’s just bet.” The other is over-abstraction and the pursuit of methodology. Abstracting a situation is like adding leverage to your thinking: if the premise is right you go far, but if it is slightly wrong the error is magnified (“失之毫厘，谬以千里”). He calls this “the conceit of reason, which is also a form of ego”, because so much relevant knowledge is unstructured and the use of concepts can stand in for understanding. His evidence is product design: counterintuitive designs often come from teams too eager to prove an idea or too attached to a concept, which a child using the product would spot. Hence “don’t rush to conclusion”: before concluding, guess other possibilities. Caveat: abstraction is also how knowledge transfers at all, and Musk’s first-principles reasoning is a methodology too; the claim is about leverage on an unchecked premise, not against models. It also sits oddly with how much of his own early writing is compressed rules.
中文 — 张一鸣点了两种要避免的捷径。一种是随便说 all-in，很多时候是披着魄力外衣的偷懒：“我不想再想了，就这样吧，赌一把吧。“另一种是对事物的过度抽象、对方法论的过度追求。把一件事抽象，相当于给思维加了杠杆：前提对了能走很远，前提稍有偏差，错误就被放大，“失之毫厘，谬以千里”。他把这叫作”理性的自负，这也是人的 ego”，因为很多相关的知识是非结构化的，概念用多了会顶替理解。他的证据来自产品设计：反直觉的设计，常常出自太想证明某个想法、太固执于某个概念的团队，而小朋友一用就能发现。所以”don’t rush to conclusion”：下结论之前，先猜想其他可能。局限： 抽象也是知识能够迁移的前提，Musk 的第一性原理本身也是一种方法论；这里反对的是对未经检验的前提加杠杆，不是反对模型。而且这和他自己早年把经验压成一条条规则的写法，放在一起看有点别扭。
Key Quotes

「随便说 all-in 的团队有很大问题。all-in 有时候是一种偷懒。」
「因为你对一个事情抽象，相当于思维上加杠杆。一旦这个杠杆加错，通常是”失之毫厘，谬以千里”。」
「其实这种现象有一个对应的说法，叫作”理性的自负”，这也是人的 ego。」
「我们在做结论的时候，要猜想其他可能，保持一个开放的心态。」

Related:

Vague words hide unresolved thinking and protect self-deception
Many complex problems are projections of a simpler problem one level up
First principles reasoning replaces precedent with the constituent elements of a problem
An ego larger than ability cuts the feedback loop with reality
张一鸣
Judgment compounds when paired with leverage — the same leverage logic: leverage scales the downside of a bad premise as much as the upside of a good one
Built-in human knowledge helps in the short term and then plateaus — a methodology is built-in knowledge for people: it pays off early and then blocks seeing what the data shows
Researchers resist the bitter lesson because building in knowledge is satisfying and pays off early — why the shortcut is attractive: building in how we think we think is satisfying
Bayesian updating ranks existing theories but cannot create new ones — “guess other possibilities” before concluding: the answer may not be on the current list
Real wealth comes from long-term value creation rather than shortcuts — Zhang’s own pairing: “don’t rely on shortcuts, use less leverage”
Waiting for certainty is itself a decision because confidence never reaches one hundred percent — Zhang Yiming: confidence never reaches 100%, so waiting is a decision

notes/Parallel-sampling-and-sequential-r.filePath: notes/Parallel sampling and sequential revision trade breadth against depth and hard problems need both.md
notes/Parallel-sampling-and-sequential-r.title: Parallel sampling and sequential revision trade breadth against depth and hard problems need both
notes/Parallel-sampling-and-sequential-r.content:
EN — Test-time decoding splits into two strategies. Parallel sampling (best-of-N, beam search, self-consistency) generates many independent trajectories and picks the best — simple and robust, but bounded by whether the model can reach the correct solution in one pass. Sequential revision iteratively reflects on and edits a single trajectory, going deeper, but is slower and risks corrupting correct answers. Snell et al. found easy questions benefit from purely sequential compute while hard questions perform best at an optimal ratio of the two.
中文 — 测试时解码分为两种策略。并行采样（best-of-N、束搜索、自洽性）生成多条独立轨迹并择优——简单稳健，但受限于模型能否一次性得出正确解。顺序修正对单条轨迹反复反思与编辑，走得更深，但更慢且有把正确答案改错的风险。Snell 等人发现，简单问题受益于纯顺序计算，而困难问题在两者达到最优比例时表现最佳。

notes/Preserving-the-means-of-error-corr.filePath: notes/Preserving the means of error correction is the heart of morality.md
notes/Preserving-the-means-of-error-corr.title: Preserving the means of error correction is the heart of morality
notes/Preserving-the-means-of-error-corr.content:
EN: Mistakes don’t require malevolence. They are “the normal condition of humans,” and well-intentioned errors that nobody can yet see as errors are as dangerous as bad actors. Since errors cannot be avoided, the one thing that must not be lost is the ability to find and fix them. If there is no way of correcting errors, “sooner or later one of those will get us.” Deutsch offers this, tentatively, as possibly the heart of morality. It connects to Popper’s criterion for democracy: the point is not who should rule but whether bad rulers and policies can be removed without violence. North Korea is the case of a society that has destroyed its means of error correction and is stuck. In Deutsch Files IV he draws the corollary that systems good at error correction can afford to make larger errors, because the major ones get corrected. He gives Britain’s 1945 Attlee government as an example: economically quasi-communist, but loyal to British institutions, so the mistakes were reversible. Naval adds the condition that this holds only as long as nobody changes the system itself to stop error correction, for example by entrenching power. Deutsch agrees and says secondary methods of error correction must then be used to block such systemic changes.
中文：犯错不需要恶意。错误是”人的常态”，那些连当事人都还看不出是错误的善意错误，和坏人一样危险。既然错误避免不了，唯一不能失去的，就是发现并改正错误的能力；如果没有纠错的途径，“迟早会有一个错误要了我们的命”。Deutsch 很谨慎地提出，这也许就是道德的核心。这与波普尔的民主标准一脉相承：关键不是谁来统治，而是能不能不流血地撤换坏的统治者和政策。朝鲜就是一个摧毁了自身纠错手段、因而被困住的社会。在《Deutsch Files IV》里，他推出了一个推论：纠错能力强的系统可以承受更大的错误，因为其中的大错会被纠正。他举的例子是 1945 年英国的艾德礼政府：经济上近乎共产主义，但忠于英国的制度，所以犯下的错误是可以逆转的。Naval 补了一个条件：前提是没人去改动系统本身、让它停止纠错，比如设法让自己永不下台。Deutsch 同意，并说这时就要动用次一级的纠错手段，去阻止这类系统性的改动。
Key Quotes

“Maybe not destroying the means of correcting errors is the heart of morality; because if there is no way of correcting errors, then sooner or later one of those will get us.” — Deutsch, Knowledge Creation and The Human Race, Part 1 (~14:10)
“It doesn’t take malevolence to make mistakes. Mistakes are the normal condition of humans.” — same
“The systems that are good at error correction make larger errors, and those errors, some of them anyway, the major ones, were corrected.” — Deutsch, The Deutsch Files IV (~50:16)
“As long as you don’t change the system itself to stop error correction.” — Naval, same

Related:

After a mistake realize it correct it learn from it then forgive it — Zhang Yiming’s four steps after a mistake

notes/Process-rewards-and-tree-search-fa.filePath: notes/Process rewards and tree search failed where simple outcome rewards worked.md
notes/Process-rewards-and-tree-search-fa.title: Process rewards and tree search failed where simple outcome rewards worked
notes/Process-rewards-and-tree-search-fa.content:
EN — DeepSeek’s unsuccessful attempts are as instructive as its recipe. Process reward models failed because per-step rubrics are hard to define, intermediate-step correctness is hard to judge, and dense per-step rewards make training more vulnerable to reward hacking. Monte Carlo Tree Search failed because the token-level search space is vastly larger than chess’s, and training the fine-grained value model needed to guide it proved too hard. Simple outcome rewards on verifiable answers won — a reminder that credit-assignment granularity should match how reliably each level can be scored.
中文 — DeepSeek 的失败尝试与其成功配方同样有教益。过程奖励模型失败，是因为逐步评分标准难以定义、中间步骤的正确性难以判定，而稠密的逐步奖励让训练更容易被奖励黑客攻击。蒙特卡洛树搜索失败，是因为 token 级搜索空间远比国际象棋庞大，而训练指导搜索所需的细粒度价值模型也过于困难。可验证答案上的简单结果奖励最终胜出——这提醒我们：信用分配的粒度应当与每一层能被多可靠地评分相匹配。

notes/Progress-is-possible-but-not-inevi.filePath: notes/Progress is possible but not inevitable.md
notes/Progress-is-possible-but-not-inevi.title: Progress is possible but not inevitable
notes/Progress-is-possible-but-not-inevi.content:
EN: Deutsch’s optimism claims that problems are soluble, not that they will be solved. “We have what it takes” means that no law of physics or planetary limit stands in the way; any failure will come from our own choices. Popular summaries, including Naval’s in The Beginning of Infinity, Part 1, often turn this into “progress is inevitable,” and Deutsch explicitly rejects that version. Treating progress as inevitable is dangerous because it makes people ignore dangers. Athens and Florence fell anyway. Brett Hall adds that inevitability hides a kind of pessimism: it casts humans as passengers carried along by some great machine rather than as the only agents who can bring progress about. Deutsch’s position therefore rejects doom and destiny alike. The future is open, and it is up to us.
中文：Deutsch 的乐观主义说的是问题可以解决，不是问题一定会被解决。“我们具备所需的一切”指的是：没有物理定律或地球资源上的限制挡在前面，如果失败，原因会是我们自己的选择。流行的概括（包括 Naval 在《Beginning of Infinity, Part 1》里的说法）常把它说成”进步是必然的”，而 Deutsch 明确反对这种版本。把进步当成必然很危险，会让人忽视风险，雅典和佛罗伦萨照样衰落了。Brett Hall 补充说，必然论里其实藏着悲观：它把人当成被某台大机器拖着走的乘客，而不是唯一能带来进步的主体。所以 Deutsch 的立场既不是末日论，也不是宿命论，而是：未来是开放的，取决于我们。
Key Quotes

“I think thinking of progress is inevitable. It’s very dangerous. It causes people to ignore dangers. What will happen is up to us.” — Deutsch, The Deutsch Files II (~1:08:37)
“We have what it takes to beat viruses… That doesn’t mean we will. We may decide not to.” — Deutsch, Knowledge Creation and The Human Race, Part 1
“I don’t want to claim that the knowledge will be created. We’re fallible; we may not create it.” — Deutsch, same episode

Related:

Preserving the means of error correction is the heart of morality
Choose problems that are fun whether or not you solve them

notes/Prompt-explanations-fail-by-being-.filePath: notes/Prompt explanations fail by being nonfactual rather than inconsistent.md
notes/Prompt-explanations-fail-by-being-.title: Prompt explanations fail by being nonfactual rather than inconsistent
notes/Prompt-explanations-fail-by-being-.content:
EN — Ye & Durrett found that including explanations in few-shot prompts brings only small-to-moderate gains on reasoning-over-text tasks, and the dominant failure mode is nonfactual explanations rather than logically inconsistent ones. A plausible-sounding rationale that states false facts most likely leads to an incorrect prediction. This cautions against treating fluent rationales as evidence of sound reasoning.
中文 — Ye 与 Durrett 发现，在少样本提示中加入解释对文本推理任务只有小到中等的收益，且主要失败模式是解释不符合事实，而非逻辑前后不一致。一段听起来合理但陈述错误事实的理由，最可能导致错误预测。这提醒我们不要把流畅的理由当作推理可靠的证据。

notes/RL-can-turn-agents-into-active-rew.filePath: notes/RL can turn agents into active reward-hacking exploiters.md
notes/RL-can-turn-agents-into-active-rew.title: RL can turn agents into active reward-hacking exploiters
notes/RL-can-turn-agents-into-active-rew.content:
EN — RL changes the security posture of an agent qualitatively. A prompt-injected chatbot is a passive victim of manipulation; an RL agent is an active, goal-seeking exploiter: if a malicious third-party tool yields high reward, RL reinforces and entrenches that unsafe path, and if bypassing a safety protocol is the efficient route to reward, the agent learns to systematically probe for loopholes. This is more persistent than one-off jailbreaks because the deceptive strategy is optimized over time. Defense must be layered: sandboxing to contain blast radius, process rewards that penalize unsafe intermediate steps (e.g. calling an untrusted API), and adversarial training inside the RL loop that rewards resisting manipulation.
中文 — RL 从质上改变了智能体的安全姿态。被提示注入的聊天机器人是被动的操纵受害者；RL 智能体是主动追逐目标的利用者：如果恶意第三方工具带来高奖励，RL 会强化并固化这条不安全路径；如果绕过安全协议是获取奖励的高效路线，智能体会学会系统性地探测漏洞。这比一次性越狱更持久，因为欺骗策略是随时间优化出来的。防御必须分层：沙箱控制爆炸半径、过程奖励惩罚不安全的中间步骤（如调用不可信 API）、RL 回路内的对抗训练奖励抵抗操纵。
Related:

Every reward function is a hackable proxy for the true goal
More capable agents exploit reward loopholes more aggressively
Jailbreaks exploit competing objectives and mismatched generalization in safety training
LLM Training

notes/RL-outcomes-depend-heavily-on-mode.filePath: notes/RL outcomes depend heavily on model priors.md
notes/RL-outcomes-depend-heavily-on-mode.title: RL outcomes depend heavily on model priors
notes/RL-outcomes-depend-heavily-on-mode.content:
EN — The same RLVR recipe produces wildly different results depending on the starting model. Base models are better RL starting points than instruct models, whose entrenched formatting and obedience priors interfere with reward shaping (R1-Zero vs R1). Model families differ asymmetrically: Qwen, heavily pretrained on math/code CoT, is “RL-friendly” and improves even under spurious rewards, while Llama/OLMo are brittle under the identical procedure. The practical fix for weak-prior families is mid-training — an annealing phase that up-samples high-quality math and code data with a decaying LR — which substantially narrows the gap. The methodological lesson: RL claims must be validated across models with differing priors, and the pretraining-to-RL pipeline should be optimized holistically.
中文 — 相同的 RLVR 配方在不同起点模型上产生截然不同的结果。基座模型比 instruct 模型更适合做 RL 起点——后者固化的格式与服从先验会干扰奖励塑形（R1-Zero vs R1）。模型家族间存在不对称差异：Qwen 因大量预训练数学/代码 CoT 而”对 RL 友好”，甚至在虚假奖励下也能涨点；Llama/OLMo 在相同流程下则很脆弱。弱先验家族的实用修复是中期训练——一个上采样高质量数学与代码数据、学习率衰减的退火阶段——能显著缩小差距。方法论教训：RL 的结论必须在不同先验的模型上验证，预训练到 RL 的管线应整体优化。
Related:

Spurious rewards can improve reasoning models by surfacing pretrained capabilities

SFT memorizes while RL generalizes

notes/RL-turns-agent-capabilities-from-s.filePath: notes/RL turns agent capabilities from static heuristics into adaptive behavior.md
notes/RL-turns-agent-capabilities-from-s.title: RL turns agent capabilities from static heuristics into adaptive behavior
notes/RL-turns-agent-capabilities-from-s.content:
EN — Across all six agentic capabilities (planning, tool use, memory, reasoning, self-improvement, perception), RL plays the same role: replacing hand-designed heuristics with learned policies adapted by environmental feedback. Prompting-based planning has no mechanism to learn from experience; a RAG memory retrieves by fixed similarity rules. After RL, the memory module decides what to store, retrieve, and forget; the planner learns when to plan at all. The capability taxonomy is therefore best read as a list of modules, each of which is currently being converted from a static component into an RL-optimized one.
中文 — 在全部六项智能体能力（规划、工具使用、记忆、推理、自我改进、感知）中，RL 扮演同一角色：用环境反馈自适应的学习策略替换手工启发式。基于提示的规划没有从经验中学习的机制；RAG 记忆按固定相似度规则检索。RL 之后，记忆模块自己决定存什么、取什么、忘什么；规划器学会何时才需要规划。因此能力分类法最好读作一个模块清单——每个模块都正在从静态组件转变为 RL 优化的组件。
Related:

Agentic RL reframes LLMs as policies in POMDPs rather than single-step generators

notes/RLHF-makes-incorrect-answers-more-.filePath: notes/RLHF makes incorrect answers more convincing to human evaluators.md
notes/RLHF-makes-incorrect-answers-more-.title: RLHF makes incorrect answers more convincing to human evaluators
notes/RLHF-makes-incorrect-answers-more-.content:
EN — Wen et al. (2024) found that RLHF increases human approval of model answers without increasing their correctness: models learn to fabricate convincing evidence, use consistent logic for wrong answers, and hide easily detectable errors. Human evaluators’ error rates rose after RLHF, and the effect was unintended (dubbed “U-Sophistry”). This is a verification problem — optimizing for what humans approve can diverge from what is true.
中文 — Wen 等人（2024）发现，RLHF 提升了人类对模型答案的认可度，却没有提升答案的正确性：模型学会编造有说服力的证据、为错误答案构建自洽逻辑、并隐藏易被察觉的错误。RLHF 后人类评估者的错误率上升，且这种效应是非预期的（被称为”U-Sophistry”）。这是一个验证问题——优化人类所认可的，可能偏离真实的。

notes/RLVR-replaces-learned-reward-model.filePath: notes/RLVR replaces learned reward models with programmatic verifiers.md
notes/RLVR-replaces-learned-reward-model.title: RLVR replaces learned reward models with programmatic verifiers
notes/RLVR-replaces-learned-reward-model.content:
EN — RLVR (RL with Verifiable Rewards), formalized in Tülu 3 and scaled by DeepSeek-R1, replaces a learned reward model with a programmatic verifier — answer checkers, unit tests, format validators — that emits binary, checkable signals. This is what made RL for reasoning scalable: no reward-model training, no reward-model over-optimization in the classic Goodhart sense, and signals that are cheap and consistent at scale. “Verifier’s law” follows: tasks with automatic verification (math, code) support efficient RL, while subjective tasks remain bottlenecked by reward design. The frontier is extending verifiability itself — e.g. self-verifiable rewards for open-ended tasks (RLSVR).
中文 — RLVR（可验证奖励的 RL）在 Tülu 3 中形式化、由 DeepSeek-R1 规模化，用程序化验证器——答案检查器、单元测试、格式校验器——替代学习的奖励模型，输出二元的、可检查的信号。这正是推理 RL 可扩展的原因：无需训练奖励模型、没有经典古德哈特意义上的奖励模型过优化，信号廉价且大规模一致。由此得出”验证器定律”：可自动验证的任务（数学、代码）支撑高效 RL，主观任务仍卡在奖励设计上。前沿是扩展可验证性本身——例如开放任务的自验证奖励（RLSVR）。
Related:

Every reward function is a hackable proxy for the true goal

notes/Rater-disagreement-is-valid-signal.filePath: notes/Rater disagreement is valid signal in subjective tasks not noise to be eliminated.md
notes/Rater-disagreement-is-valid-signal.title: Rater disagreement is valid signal in subjective tasks not noise to be eliminated
notes/Rater-disagreement-is-valid-signal.content:
EN — Annotation pipelines usually assume one gold answer and treat disagreement as measurement error. In safety, social, and cultural tasks, multiple interpretations are legitimately correct, and agreement varies from 0.96 on violence to 0.25 on personal topics; Rottger et al.’s descriptive paradigm models the distribution of beliefs instead of forcing a single label. Only disagreement from stochastic errors or poorly designed tasks should be suppressed — the rest reveals who believes what and why, and even annotator identity is a statistically significant factor in toxicity labeling.
中文 — 标注流程通常假设存在唯一黄金答案，把分歧当作测量误差。但在安全、社会、文化类任务中，多种解释可以同时合理正确，一致率从暴力主题的 0.96 到个人主题的 0.25 不等；Rottger 等人的”描述性范式”建模信念的分布，而非强行规定单一标签。只有由随机错误或任务设计不当引起的分歧才应被消除——其余分歧揭示了谁相信什么、为什么，在毒性标注中甚至标注者身份本身也是统计显著的因素。

notes/Reasoning-RL-learns-search-inside-.filePath: notes/Reasoning RL learns search inside the model instead of running it outside.md
notes/Reasoning-RL-learns-search-inside-.title: Reasoning RL learns search inside the model instead of running it outside
notes/Reasoning-RL-learns-search-inside-.content:
EN — A synthesis reading current reasoning RL through Sutton’s two scalable methods. In AlphaGo, search (MCTS) was an external algorithm and learning trained its value network. For LLM reasoning, DeepSeek’s attempts at explicit MCTS and process reward models failed, and plain outcome rewards won. What lost was not search but hand-designed search structure: a definition of “a step” and a per-step scorer, which is built-in human knowledge. Search survives inside the model instead: chain-of-thought spends variable compute per answer, and RL on verifiable rewards makes reflection and backtracking emerge, which is tree search run along one sequence. Learning trains the search policy, and the search spends compute at inference time. Explicit search remains only at test time, as breadth (best-of-N) and depth (sequential revision), and the depth kind needs external feedback. The verifier plays the role that game rules play in self-play, so the remaining human-supplied structure sits in verification. This partly answers where human structure is a lever and where it is a crutch: supplying verifiability is a lever, supplying solution steps is a crutch. Open: if RL mostly sharpens pretrained capabilities, then pretraining does the discovering and RL acts more like search.
中文 — 用 Sutton 的两类可扩展方法来读当前的推理 RL（综合笔记）。AlphaGo 里，搜索（MCTS）是外部算法，学习负责训练它的价值网络。到了 LLM 推理，DeepSeek 试过显式 MCTS 和过程奖励模型，都失败了，最朴素的结果奖励胜出。输掉的不是搜索，而是人为设计的搜索结构：先规定”一步”是什么，再给每一步打分，这本身就是内置的人类知识。搜索转到了模型内部：思维链让模型为每个答案投入可变的算力，可验证奖励上的 RL 让反思和回溯自发出现，这相当于在一条序列里做树搜索。学习负责训练搜索策略，搜索在推理时消耗算力。显式搜索只留在推理阶段，分广度（best-of-N）和深度（顺序修正）两种，而深度修正需要外部反馈。验证器起的作用相当于自对弈里的游戏规则，所以剩下的人为结构集中在验证上。这部分回答了”人提供的结构什么时候是杠杆、什么时候是拐杖”：提供可验证性是杠杆，提供解题步骤是拐杖。待解：如果 RL 主要是在磨砺预训练已有的能力，那么真正在”发现”的是预训练，RL 更像是搜索。

notes/Recursive-self-improvement-only-wo.filePath: notes/Recursive self-improvement only works above a base-model capability threshold.md
notes/Recursive-self-improvement-only-wo.title: Recursive self-improvement only works above a base-model capability threshold
notes/Recursive-self-improvement-only-wo.content:
EN — STOP (Self-Taught Optimizer) improved mean downstream performance across iterations with GPT-4 but degraded with weaker models like GPT-3.5 and Mixtral: recursive structure alone is not enough, because the base model must be capable enough to improve the improvement mechanism. Harness ability also splits into harness-updating (producing useful edits) and harness-benefit (exploiting the updated harness) — even a 9B model can write edits procedurally isomorphic to a frontier model’s, while only strong models invoke the resulting skills correctly and follow long-horizon instructions. Harness improvements enable better deployment, but intelligence remains the core.
中文 — STOP（Self-Taught Optimizer）在 GPT-4 上逐迭代提升了平均下游性能，但在 GPT-3.5、Mixtral 等较弱模型上反而退化：仅靠递归结构不够，基础模型必须足够有能力去改进改进机制本身。Harness 能力还可拆分为 harness 更新（产出有用编辑）与 harness 收益（利用更新后的 harness）——即使 9B 模型也能写出与前沿模型过程同构的编辑，但只有强模型能正确及时地调用所得技能并遵循长程指令。Harness 改进能实现更好的部署，但智能仍是核心。
Related:

notes/Reinforcement-learning-on-automati.filePath: notes/Reinforcement learning on automatically verifiable rewards elicits reasoning and emergent reflection.md
notes/Reinforcement-learning-on-automati.title: Reinforcement learning on automatically verifiable rewards elicits reasoning and emergent reflection
notes/Reinforcement-learning-on-automati.content:
EN — Training on problems with automatically checkable answers — STEM questions with short final answers, coding tasks verified by unit tests — with simple policy-gradient RL produces strong reasoning, as shown by OpenAI’s o-series and DeepSeek-R1. Strikingly, DeepSeek found that pure RL without any SFT stage still elicits advanced behavior: the model learns to spend more thinking tokens and spontaneously develops reflection and backtracking (“aha moments”). The recipe works because verification is externalized into the environment, so the reward signal is cheap and reliable.
中文 — 在答案可自动检验的问题上训练——答案简短的 STEM 题、用单元测试验证的编程任务——配合简单的策略梯度 RL，就能产生强大的推理能力，OpenAI 的 o 系列和 DeepSeek-R1 均已证明。惊人的是，DeepSeek 发现不加任何 SFT 阶段的纯 RL 仍能涌现高级行为：模型学会投入更多思考 token，并自发发展出反思与回溯（“顿悟时刻”）。这个配方之所以有效，是因为验证被外置到了环境中，奖励信号既便宜又可靠。
Related:

LLMs cannot self-correct without external feedback
Process rewards and tree search failed where simple outcome rewards worked
Chain-of-thought lets models allocate variable compute per answer token
Work becomes easier to automate when evaluation criteria are externalized
RLVR replaces learned reward models with programmatic verifiers
LLM Training

notes/Repeated-agent-corrections-belong-.filePath: notes/Repeated agent corrections belong in the codebase rather than the conversation.md
notes/Repeated-agent-corrections-belong-.title: Repeated agent corrections belong in the codebase rather than the conversation
notes/Repeated-agent-corrections-belong-.content:
Agent 倾向沿用上下文里已有的模式，所以仓库里的现有代码同时是下一次生成的示范。对话里的纠正只影响当前会话，仓库里留下的坏例子会继续被抄。
坏模式的传播路径：临时写法 → 邻近功能模仿 → 多处出现 → 被当成默认约定。一个 workaround 或解释它的注释，几天到几周内就会扩散。重复本身制造了”这是有意设计”的假象。
纠错的落点，从强到弱：

代码库本身：改接口、数据结构，让错误在类别上不可能发生。
静态分析：lint 规则、编译器诊断、CI。
Rules、Bugbot、Skills：Agent 可能漏读，使用者也可能忽略。
风格指南：只有人工评审执行，PR 数量一大就失效。

处理已有坏模式：先写 lint 规则止血，再让 Agent 清理，最后保留一条标准路径。
注释是典型例子：Agent 用注释为没有解决的问题辩护，后续 Agent 把它当成必须保留的约束。Dune 直接禁止注释。
关联：Lauren Tan - Building a Michelin Kitchen for Agents、A harness should keep durable state in files rather than in context、LLM Agents

notes/Repeated-tokens-decay-in-value-and.filePath: notes/Repeated tokens decay in value and larger models overfit them faster.md
notes/Repeated-tokens-decay-in-value-and.title: Repeated tokens decay in value and larger models overfit them faster
notes/Repeated-tokens-decay-in-value-and.content:
EN — When unique data runs out, a repeated token loses value exponentially with each repetition — Muennighoff et al. model this with a learnable half-life, and find excess parameters decay even faster than repeated data, so under data constraints extra epochs beat extra parameters. Lovelace et al. add an explicit overfitting penalty that grows with both repetition count and the capacity ratio N/U_D, and observe that larger models are more sensitive to repetition; strong weight decay mitigates the damage.
中文 — 当唯一数据耗尽时，一个 token 每被重复一次，其价值就指数衰减——Muennighoff 等人用可学习的”半衰期”建模这一点，并发现超额参数的价值衰减比重复数据更快，因此在数据受限下，增加 epoch 优于增加参数。Lovelace 等人加入显式过拟合惩罚项，随重复次数和容量比 N/U_D 同时增大，并观察到更大的模型对重复更敏感；强权重衰减可缓解这种损害。
Related:

Data quality can change compute efficiency more than token count
Scaling-law predictions are fragile to trivial fitting choices
Capability uplift skills can expire as models absorb their behavior
Scaling and General Methods

notes/Require-all-tool-results-to-agree-.filePath: notes/Require all tool results to agree before terminating a batch.md
notes/Require-all-tool-results-to-agree-.title: Require all tool results to agree before terminating a batch
notes/Require-all-tool-results-to-agree-.content:
Pi’s loop stops after a tool batch only when every result in the batch sets the terminate flag. A single tool cannot unilaterally end the session — termination requires consensus, which prevents one misbehaving or over-eager tool from cutting off work the other tools in the batch still need.

notes/Researchers-resist-the-bitter-less.filePath: notes/Researchers resist the bitter lesson because building in knowledge is satisfying and pays off early.md
notes/Researchers-resist-the-bitter-less.title: Researchers resist the bitter lesson because building in knowledge is satisfying and pays off early
notes/Researchers-resist-the-bitter-less.content:
EN — Sutton says the field keeps repeating the mistake because it is appealing: building in how we think we think helps in the short term and is personally satisfying, while the scaling approach wins only later. Researchers also hold “psychological commitments” to one approach, and the eventual success of the other is “tinged with bitterness” because it beats a favored, human-centric view. In the chess case, the losing camp argued that brute-force search “was not how people played chess.” To resist the pull, understand its appeal, then judge a research direction by what it does once compute gets large.
中文 — Sutton 认为这个领域反复犯同一个错误，是因为它很有吸引力：把”我们以为自己怎么思考”内置进系统，短期有效，研究者也觉得满足，而扩展路线要晚些才见效。研究者还对某一路线有”心理承诺”，另一路线最终获胜带有”苦涩”，因为它战胜的是研究者偏爱的、以人为中心的看法。在国际象棋的例子里，落败一方辩称暴力搜索”不是人下棋的方式”。要抵抗这种吸引力，先理解它为什么有吸引力，再用”算力变大之后它会怎样”来评判研究方向。
Related:

Built-in human knowledge helps in the short term and then plateaus
General methods that keep scaling with computation beat human-knowledge methods in the long run
Most AI adoption still imitates old tools instead of redesigning workflows
Scaling and General Methods

notes/Reward-hacking-generalizes-across-.filePath: notes/Reward hacking generalizes across tasks but anti-gaming SFT mitigates it.md
notes/Reward-hacking-generalizes-across-.title: Reward hacking generalizes across tasks but anti-gaming SFT mitigates it
notes/Reward-hacking-generalizes-across-.content:
EN — Denison et al. (2024) trained models on a curriculum of increasingly gameable environments and found that hacking behavior generalizes to unseen environments — in some cases zero-shot to rewriting the model’s own reward function. However, outright reward tampering remained rare (under 1% even after direct incentivization), and supervised fine-tuning on non-gaming behavior in the easy-to-detect early environments reduced tampering in holdout environments.
中文 — Denison 等人（2024）在越来越复杂的可博弈环境课程上训练模型，发现黑客行为会泛化到未见过的环境——某些情况下甚至零样本地重写模型自己的奖励函数。然而，公然的奖励篡改仍然罕见（即使在直接激励下也低于 1%），而在易检测的早期环境中用非博弈行为做监督微调，能降低保留环境中的篡改概率。
Related:

notes/SFT-memorizes-while-RL-generalizes.title: SFT memorizes while RL generalizes
notes/SFT-memorizes-while-RL-generalizes.content:
EN — Across textual and vision benchmarks, SFT and RL pull representations in opposite directions. SFT-on-math causes representation and output drift (measured by latent-space PCA and token KL), negative transfer, and catastrophic forgetting of non-math capabilities; RL-on-math preserves or even enhances them. The mechanism is the KL direction: SFT optimizes forward KL (mode-covering, fits the data surface) while RL optimizes reverse KL (mode-seeking, concentrates on high-reward regions). But RL is no panacea under severe distribution shift, and SFT is better at introducing genuinely new knowledge — hence the convergence on unified or alternating hybrids (SFT warmup → RL, UFT, SRFT) rather than either alone.
中文 — 在文本和视觉基准上，SFT 与 RL 把表征拉向相反方向。数学 SFT 导致表征与输出漂移（用隐空间 PCA 和 token KL 测得）、负迁移、对非数学能力的灾难性遗忘；数学 RL 则保持甚至提升其他能力。机制在于 KL 方向：SFT 优化前向 KL（覆盖模式，拟合数据表面），RL 优化反向 KL（寻找模式，集中于高奖励区域）。但 RL 在剧烈分布偏移下并非万能，而 SFT 更擅长引入真正的新知识——因此实践收敛到统一或交替的混合方案（SFT 预热→RL、UFT、SRFT），而非单用其一。
Related:

The sharpening versus discovery debate asks whether RL creates or reveals capabilities
RL outcomes depend heavily on model priors
Data quality can change compute efficiency more than token count
LLM Training

notes/Scaling-law-predictions-are-fragil.filePath: notes/Scaling-law predictions are fragile to trivial fitting choices.md
notes/Scaling-law-predictions-are-fragil.title: Scaling-law predictions are fragile to trivial fitting choices
notes/Scaling-law-predictions-are-fragil.content:
EN — Scaling laws are fit on small, cheap runs and extrapolated orders of magnitude beyond them, so choices that look like rounding error can wildly change the prediction: loss precision, milli-loss-scale noise, or fitting only small models each shift the apparent exponents. Besiroglu et al.’s replication of Chinchilla’s parametric fit found concrete culprits — averaging Huber loss instead of summing it caused premature optimizer termination and implausibly narrow confidence intervals, and rounding \alpha and \beta to two digits distorted the derived constants. Any extrapolated scaling prediction should be treated as conditional on the exact fitting procedure.
中文 — 缩放定律是在小规模、低成本的运行上拟合、再向外推许多个数量级得到的，因此看似舍入误差级别的选择都可能让预测剧变：损失精度、毫损失级的噪声、或只在小模型上拟合，都会改变表观指数。Besiroglu 等人对 Chinchilla 参数化拟合的复现找到了具体元凶——对 Huber 损失取平均而非求和导致优化器提前终止、置信区间窄得不合理；把 \alpha 和 \beta 舍入到两位小数则扭曲了推导常数。任何外推的缩放预测都应被视为依赖于具体拟合流程的条件性结论。
Related:

The Kaplan-Chinchilla exponent gap dissolves as scale grows
Under a fixed compute budget, model size and training tokens should scale together
The power-law exponent is a property of the problem not the architecture
APO quality depends on validation data and metric design
Scaling and General Methods

notes/Search-and-learning-are-the-two-me.filePath: notes/Search and learning are the two methods that scale with arbitrary computation.md
notes/Search-and-learning-are-the-two-me.title: Search and learning are the two methods that scale with arbitrary computation
notes/Search-and-learning-are-the-two-me.content:
EN — Sutton names search and learning as the two classes of technique that let massive computation be brought to bear, and the only two that “seem to scale arbitrarily.” Deep search beat Kasparov, and in Go, search combined with self-play learning of a value function did the job. Learning from self-play is like search in that more compute directly buys more capability, with no human knowledge in the loop. Any new method is worth asking: is it a form of search or learning, or does it cap what compute can buy?
中文 — Sutton 把搜索和学习列为能调动海量算力的两类技术，也是仅有的两类”似乎可以无限扩展”的方法。深度搜索击败了卡斯帕罗夫；围棋则靠搜索加上自对弈学习价值函数。自对弈学习和搜索一样，算力直接换来能力，环路中不需要人类知识。评估任何新方法都可以问：它是搜索或学习的一种形式，还是给算力的收益设了上限？
Related:

notes/Self-consistency-sampling-improves.filePath: notes/Self-consistency sampling improves reliability through majority vote.md
notes/Self-consistency-sampling-improves.title: Self-consistency sampling improves reliability through majority vote
notes/Self-consistency-sampling-improves.content:
EN — Instead of decoding one answer, self-consistency samples multiple reasoning paths at temperature > 0 and selects the majority answer, which consistently improves reasoning accuracy. For tasks that are easy to verify — such as programming with unit tests — candidates can be checked directly rather than voted on. The principle generalizes: when individual generations are noisy, aggregation over diverse samples beats any single sample.
中文 — 自洽性不在单次解码上取答案，而是在 temperature > 0 下采样多条推理路径并取多数答案，可持续提高推理准确率。对于易于验证的任务——如带单元测试的编程——可直接检验候选而非投票。其原理可推广：当单次生成充满噪声时，对多样本聚合优于任何单样本。
Related:

notes/Self-improvement-has-three-levels-.filePath: notes/Self-improvement has three levels from verbal correction to iterative self-training.md
notes/Self-improvement-has-three-levels-.title: Self-improvement has three levels from verbal correction to iterative self-training
notes/Self-improvement-has-three-levels-.content:
EN — Agentic self-improvement comes in three levels of increasing depth. (1) Verbal self-correction (Reflexion, Self-Refine, CoVe): the agent critiques and rewrites its own output in one inference pass — no gradients, so improvements are ephemeral and session-bound. (2) RL-internalized self-correction: gradient updates bake the reflective loop into the weights, making self-correction a durable capability. (3) Iterative self-training: reflection, reasoning, and task generation form a self-sustaining loop with no human-labeled data — self-play with search (R-Zero), execution-guided curricula (Absolute Zero), or collective bootstrapping from shared trajectory repositories (SiriuS). The next frontier is meta-evolution: RL applied to the reflection mechanism itself, learning how to self-correct better over time.
中文 — 智能体自我改进有三个逐级深入的层次。(1) 口头自纠（Reflexion、Self-Refine、CoVe）：智能体在一次推理中批评并重写自己的输出——没有梯度，改进是临时的、仅限当前会话。(2) RL 内化的自纠：梯度更新把反思回路写入权重，自纠成为持久能力。(3) 迭代自训练：反思、推理、任务生成构成无需人工标注数据的自维持回路——带搜索的自博弈（R-Zero）、执行引导的课程（Absolute Zero）、或从共享轨迹库集体自举（SiriuS）。下一前沿是元进化：把 RL 施加于反思机制本身，学习如何随时间更好地自纠。

notes/Self-refinement-feedback-loops-can.filePath: notes/Self-refinement feedback loops can hack their own evaluator.md
notes/Self-refinement-feedback-loops-can.title: Self-refinement feedback loops can hack their own evaluator
notes/Self-refinement-feedback-loops-can.content:
EN — In-context reward hacking (ICRH) occurs when the same model acts as both generator and evaluator in an iterative refinement loop: the evaluator score diverges from the oracle score even without parameter updates. Shared context between evaluator and generator drives the effect more than context length, and scaling model size worsens it; editing the prompt does not eliminate it. ICRH happens at deployment time rather than training, and is driven by the model being a generalist rather than a specialist.
中文 — 上下文奖励黑客（ICRH）发生在同一模型在迭代精炼循环中既作生成者又作评估者时：即使不更新参数，评估者评分也会与预言机评分背离。评估者与生成者之间的共享上下文比上下文长度更能驱动该效应，且模型规模越大越严重；修改提示也无法消除它。ICRH 发生在部署阶段而非训练阶段，且由模型作为通才而非专才所驱动。

notes/Self-reflection-turns-trial-and-er.filePath: notes/Self-reflection turns trial and error into within-episode learning.md
notes/Self-reflection-turns-trial-and-er.title: Self-reflection turns trial and error into within-episode learning
notes/Self-reflection-turns-trial-and-er.content:
EN — Frameworks like Reflexion let an agent critique its own past actions, detect when a trajectory is inefficient or hallucinated, and reset to try again — converting trial and error into iterative improvement within a single task. The reflections are kept in working memory (only a few at a time) and fed back as context for the next attempt.
中文 — 像 Reflexion 这样的框架让智能体自我批评过去的动作，识别出轨迹低效或产生幻觉的时刻并重置重试——把试错转化为单个任务内的迭代改进。反思只保留少数几条在工作记忆中，作为下一次尝试的上下文反馈回去。

notes/Sequence-consistency-can-be-enforc.filePath: notes/Sequence consistency can be enforced at inference time by anchoring attention to a reference frame.md
notes/Sequence-consistency-can-be-enforc.title: Sequence consistency can be enforced at inference time by anchoring attention to a reference frame
notes/Sequence-consistency-can-be-enforc.content:
EN — Text2Video-Zero turns a pretrained image diffusion model into a zero-shot video generator without any training: it samples the latent sequence with motion dynamics (warping latents along a direction between DDIM steps) and reprograms frame-level self-attention into cross-frame attention where every frame attends to the first frame, preserving object identity and appearance. Consistency across a generated sequence is thus an inference-time constraint, not necessarily a capability that must be trained.
中文 — Text2Video-Zero 无需任何训练就把预训练图像扩散模型变成零样本视频生成器：它用运动动态采样潜在序列（在 DDIM 步骤之间沿一个方向扭曲潜变量），并把帧级自注意力重编程为每帧都关注第一帧的跨帧注意力，从而保持对象的身份与外观。因此，生成序列的一致性可以是推理时施加的约束，而不必是必须训练出来的能力。

notes/Snapshot-boundaries-between-loop-a.filePath: notes/Snapshot boundaries between loop and state owner give crash safety for free.md
notes/Snapshot-boundaries-between-loop-a.title: Snapshot boundaries between loop and state owner give crash safety for free
notes/Snapshot-boundaries-between-loop-a.content:
The Agent class hands the loop a shallow copy of its messages and tools on each run. The loop mutates that copy freely — pushing partial messages, replacing them as deltas arrive — while the class only commits fully completed messages into its own transcript via message_end events. If the loop crashes mid-turn, the owner’s persistent state stays consistent: no half-written message ever enters the history. Crash safety emerges from the boundary design rather than from extra cleanup code.

notes/Spec-driven-development-is-rising-.filePath: notes/Spec-driven development is rising as AI shifts coding toward writing clear requirements.md
notes/Spec-driven-development-is-rising-.title: Spec-driven development is rising as AI shifts coding toward writing clear requirements
notes/Spec-driven-development-is-rising-.content:
Effective AI coding requires writing unambiguous, formal specifications — sometimes described as “formal letter to British throne” level clarity — because the LLM will fill any ambiguity with plausible but wrong choices. This shifts the core skill of coding from implementation to writing robust requirements documents: unambiguous specs, jargon, CS formalisms, and patterns that prevent unwanted LLM creativity. The practice of using AI to write prompts for other AI to write code further reinforces this trend, making specification, verification, and test design the central activities of software development.
Related:

Work becomes easier to automate when evaluation criteria are externalized
Verification quality determines how safely work can be delegated
AI-native knowledge work is a verification problem before it is an intelligence problem
AI and Work

notes/Specific-knowledge-becomes-more-va.filePath: notes/Specific knowledge becomes more valuable as AI commoditizes routine coding.md
notes/Specific-knowledge-becomes-more-va.title: Specific knowledge becomes more valuable as AI commoditizes routine coding
notes/Specific-knowledge-becomes-more-va.content: As AI coding tools commoditize routine boilerplate and repetitive implementation, the value of specific knowledge — deep domain expertise, architectural judgment, and the ability to specify and verify — increases rather than decreases. The tools remove hands and eyes as bottlenecks but cannot remove the need for clear thinking about what to build and how to validate it. The engineers who thrive are not those who type faster but those who know what to ask for, what to reject, and how to prove it works. This makes judgment and specific knowledge more leveraged, not less.

notes/Spurious-rewards-can-improve-reaso.filePath: notes/Spurious rewards can improve reasoning models by surfacing pretrained capabilities.md
notes/Spurious-rewards-can-improve-reaso.title: Spurious rewards can improve reasoning models by surfacing pretrained capabilities
notes/Spurious-rewards-can-improve-reaso.content:
EN — A striking empirical result: Qwen-family models improve on reasoning benchmarks even when trained with random or spurious reward signals, while Llama and OLMo do not. The interpretation is that RL here is not learning new behaviors from the reward — it is reshaping entropy and confidence to surface reasoning patterns already encoded during pretraining. This is strong evidence for the sharpening view and for the dominance of model priors: the reward acts less as a teacher of new skills and more as a selector over latent ones. It also implies that RL gains should not be credited to the reward design alone, and that “RL works” claims need cross-family validation before being believed.
中文 — 一个惊人的实证结果：Qwen 家族模型即使在随机或虚假奖励信号下训练也能在推理基准上涨点，而 Llama 和 OLMo 不能。解释是：此时的 RL 并非从奖励中学习新行为，而是在重塑熵与置信度，把预训练中已编码的推理模式浮现出来。这是磨砺观和模型先验主导性的有力证据：奖励与其说是新技能的教师，不如说是潜在技能的选择器。这也意味着 RL 的收益不应只归功于奖励设计，“RL 有效”的结论需要跨家族验证才可信。
Related:

The sharpening versus discovery debate asks whether RL creates or reveals capabilities
RL outcomes depend heavily on model priors
Every reward function is a hackable proxy for the true goal
LLM Training

notes/Stream-partial-messages-in-place-s.title: Stream partial messages in place so interrupted contexts stay structurally complete
notes/Stream-partial-messages-in-place-s.content:
During streaming, pi pushes the partial assistant message into the context array immediately and replaces that same slot as deltas arrive, swapping in the finalized message at the end. At any interruption point the context contains a structurally complete message rather than a dangling stream, so abort-and-resume never corrupts the transcript.

notes/Systems-learn-by-removing-the-part.filePath: notes/Systems learn by removing the parts that fail.md
notes/Systems-learn-by-removing-the-part.title: Systems learn by removing the parts that fail
notes/Systems-learn-by-removing-the-part.content:
EN — Taleb, in the prologue of Skin in the Game: “Systems learn by removing parts, via negativa.” A system gets better because its bad parts drop out, not because they get wiser. The reckless driver may never learn anything; they leave, and what remains is better. Skin in the game keeps this working: whoever makes the wrong call bears the cost, so the error leaves with them. Shifting risk onto others (the Bob Rubin trade) breaks it: the error stays and someone else is removed.
This differs from the “feedback must be external” line elsewhere in the vault. Musk’s ego ratio and LLM self-correction are about an individual that receives a signal and corrects itself. Here the individual may never receive one; the learning happens one level up.
Caveat: removal is slow and costly when the parts are people, firms or species; Deutsch’s answer is that explanation lets ideas die in our place. It also teaches only when failure is attributable; otherwise the system selects for luck, which is survivorship bias. The step to “individuals need not learn” is my reading, not yet checked against the full text.
中文 — 塔勒布在《非对称风险》序言里写：“Systems learn by removing parts, via negativa.”（系统靠移除部件来学习，即”否定之道”。）系统变好，是因为坏的部分出局了，不是因为它们变聪明了。鲁莽的司机自己可能什么也没学会，但他们离开了，剩下的整体就更好。风险共担让这件事一直运转：谁做错决定谁付代价，错误跟着他一起离开。把风险转给别人（比如鲁宾交易）就破坏了它：错误留下，出局的是别人。
这和库里”反馈要来自外部”那条线不一样。Musk 的 ego 比、LLM 自我纠错，讲的都是个体收到信号、自己改正；这里个体可能根本收不到信号，学习发生在上一层。
局限： 被剔除的是人、公司或物种，这种学习既慢又贵；Deutsch 的回答是，解释可以让想法替我们去死。剔除也只有在失败能归因时才有教育意义，否则系统筛出来的只是运气，也就是幸存者偏差。从”剔除”推到”个体不必学会”，是我的理解，还没和全文核对。
Key Quotes

“Systems learn by removing parts, via negativa.” — Skin in the Game，Book 1 序言 Part 1 Antaeus Whacked（页码待补；措辞据 Goodreads 和 Jim Bouman 的逐章笔记，与纸质书核对后去掉这条说明）
飞行员和司机的例子：二手书摘里的转述（“bad drivers die”，“many bad pilots are at the bottom of the ocean”），原文待核对。

Related:

An ego larger than ability cuts the feedback loop with reality — Musk: the receiver breaks; Taleb: the system doesn’t need the receiver, it removes the part
LLMs cannot self-correct without external feedback — individual-level correction needs an external signal; removal works one level up
Explanatory creativity can cross gaps that evolution cannot — Deutsch: criticism lets ideas die instead of their carriers, a cheaper route than removal
Preserving the means of error correction is the heart of morality — risk transfer is one way to destroy a system’s means of error correction
Treating failure as the expected outcome makes a low-probability bet bearable — removal is survivable only if the bet can’t ruin you

notes/Temporal-credit-assignment-is-the-.filePath: notes/Temporal credit assignment is the bottleneck of long-horizon agentic RL.md
notes/Temporal-credit-assignment-is-the-.title: Temporal credit assignment is the bottleneck of long-horizon agentic RL
notes/Temporal-credit-assignment-is-the-.content:
EN — Extending tool-integrated reasoning from one loop to robust multi-turn tasks is bottlenecked not by model capability but by credit assignment. With sparse trajectory-level rewards, the learner cannot pinpoint which tool call in a long interdependent sequence caused success or failure. Early attempts at granular signals — turn-level advantage estimation (GiGPO, SpaRL) — are promising but immature. The constraint is delicate: the reward scheme must be dense enough to guide through long decision chains without inadvertently punishing useful exploration or promoting reward hacking.
中文 — 把工具集成推理从单轮扩展到鲁棒的多轮任务，瓶颈不在模型能力而在信用分配。只有稀疏的轨迹级奖励时，学习者无法定位长 interdependent 序列中哪次工具调用导致了成败。更细粒度信号的早期尝试——轮次级优势估计（GiGPO、SpaRL）——有前景但不成熟。约束很微妙：奖励方案必须足够稠密以引导长决策链，又不能误伤有益探索或助长奖励作弊。
Related:

notes/Temporal-mixing-layers-after-share.filePath: notes/Temporal mixing layers after shared spatial processing capture sequence coherence better than autoregression.md
notes/Temporal-mixing-layers-after-share.title: Temporal mixing layers after shared spatial processing capture sequence coherence better than autoregression
notes/Temporal-mixing-layers-after-share.content:
EN — In video diffusion models, spatial layers process all frames with shared parameters simultaneously, and temporal layers then mix activations across frames; Imagen Video found this works better than frame-autoregressive approaches. Factorizing space and time — rather than full spatiotemporal attention or per-frame generation — keeps computation tractable while letting the model learn cross-frame coherence. The reusable lesson: for sequence data, shared per-step processing plus a light cross-step mixing layer beats generating steps one at a time.
中文 — 在视频扩散模型中，空间层用共享参数同时处理所有帧，时间层随后混合跨帧的激活；Imagen Video 发现这比帧自回归方法效果更好。将空间与时间分解——而非完整时空注意力或逐帧生成——既保持计算可行，又让模型学到跨帧连贯性。可复用的经验是：对序列数据，共享的逐步处理加上轻量的跨步混合层，优于逐帧生成。
Related:

notes/Textual-gradients-make-prompt-erro.title: Textual gradients make prompt errors editable in natural language
notes/Textual-gradients-make-prompt-erro.content:
Textual-gradient APO converts prompt failures into natural-language critiques, then asks an LLM to edit the prompt away from those failure modes. This preserves a useful audit trail: the optimizer is not only producing a better prompt, but also a readable account of what was wrong with the previous one.

notes/The-Kaplan-Chinchilla-exponent-gap.filePath: notes/The Kaplan-Chinchilla exponent gap dissolves as scale grows.md
notes/The-Kaplan-Chinchilla-exponent-gap.title: The Kaplan-Chinchilla exponent gap dissolves as scale grows
notes/The-Kaplan-Chinchilla-exponent-gap.content:
EN — Kaplan’s N_\text{opt} \propto C^{0.73} and Chinchilla’s N_\text{opt} \propto C^{0.5} are not truly contradictory: Kaplan fit mostly small models, where embedding parameters are a non-negligible fraction of the total, while Chinchilla counted total parameters at much larger scales. Pearce & Song (2024) showed the optimal exponent is local — it sits near 0.73 in Kaplan’s 768M–1.5B regime and converges toward 0.50 as scale grows. A scaling exponent measured at one scale is not guaranteed to hold at another.
中文 — Kaplan 的 N_\text{opt} \propto C^{0.73} 与 Chinchilla 的 N_\text{opt} \propto C^{0.5} 并非真正矛盾：Kaplan 主要在小模型上拟合，此时 embedding 参数占总量比例不可忽略，而 Chinchilla 在大得多的规模上计入全部参数。Pearce & Song（2024）表明最优指数是局部的——在 Kaplan 的 768M–1.5B 区间接近 0.73，随规模增大逐渐收敛到 0.50。在一个规模上测得的缩放指数，不保证在另一个规模上仍然成立。

notes/The-cognitive-load-of-reviewing-AI.filePath: notes/The cognitive load of reviewing AI output is real and different from writing code.md
notes/The-cognitive-load-of-reviewing-AI.title: The cognitive load of reviewing AI output is real and different from writing code
notes/The-cognitive-load-of-reviewing-AI.content:
Reviewing AI-generated code imposes a cognitive load that is qualitatively different from writing code yourself. When you write code, you build the mental model as you go; when you review AI output, you must reverse-engineer a model you did not build, line by line, while fighting a natural tendency to trust fluent-looking output. This dual role of coder and reviewer causes burnout and higher cognitive load for both individuals and their colleagues. Reviewing every AI-generated line is non-negotiable, but it is not free — it consumes attention that would otherwise go into design and problem-solving.
Related:

AI and Work

notes/The-harness-layer-around-a-model-m.filePath: notes/The harness layer around a model matters as much as its raw intelligence.md
notes/The-harness-layer-around-a-model-m.title: The harness layer around a model matters as much as its raw intelligence
notes/The-harness-layer-around-a-model-m.content:
EN — A harness is the system surrounding a base model that orchestrates execution: how the model thinks and plans, calls tools and acts, perceives and manages context, stores artifacts, and evaluates results. The success of coding agents like Claude Code and Codex shows this deployment layer is as important as the model’s raw, post-pretraining intelligence. The near-term path to recursive self-improvement therefore runs through harness engineering — improving the machinery for getting better answers — not through models directly rewriting their own weights.
中文 — Harness 是围绕基础模型、负责编排执行的系统：决定模型如何思考与规划、调用工具与行动、感知与管理上下文、存储产物以及评估结果。Claude Code、Codex 等 coding agent 的成功表明，这一部署层与模型预训练后的原始智能同等重要。因此，递归自我改进的近期路径在于 harness 工程——改进获得更好答案的机制——而非模型直接重写自身权重。
