stephango.com/todos
stephango.com/remove
stephango.com/the-elusiveness-of-digital-paper

Collected: 2026-04-13
One-line summary
Steph Ango treats note-taking as building a durable, file-based thinking environment where small linked ideas accumulate over time into a personal knowledge web.
Core mental models
1. Notes are durable artifacts, not app-bound data
The underlying object is the file, not the app.

Notes should remain readable and controllable over decades.
Plain text and simple formats matter because tools are temporary.
A vault is just a folder, which makes it portable and ownable.

Implication for this vault:

Prefer Markdown files.
Avoid workflows that only exist inside one proprietary interface.
Treat .obsidian as optional tooling, not the knowledge itself.

2. Notes should lower cognitive load, not create admin work
His system is biased toward speed, laziness, and low overhead.

Use few folders.
Avoid nested hierarchies.
Navigate through quick switcher, links, and backlinks instead of browsing trees.
Let structure emerge bottom-up.

Implication:

Do not over-design taxonomy early.
Keep capture friction low.
Organize later by links, categories, and reusable properties.

3. Ideas become more useful when turned into small objects
His evergreen note model treats a note as a manipulable unit of thought.

Each evergreen note captures one idea.
Titles should be short, memorable, and usable in a sentence.
Notes can be tiny.
Notes do not need to express agreement; they only need to capture a thought clearly enough to reuse.

Implication:

Prefer atomic idea notes over long mixed-topic dumps.
Give notes titles like claims, not vague topics.
Build larger arguments by combining small notes.

4. Linking is how thinking compounds
Links are not decoration. They are the operating system of the vault.

Link the first mention of a concept.
Unresolved links are useful breadcrumbs.
Heavy linking makes the history and evolution of ideas visible.
The value of linking increases over time.

Implication:

Encourage frequent internal links.
Do not wait until a note is “finished” before linking to it.
Treat missing notes as invitations, not errors.

5. Concision makes notes composable
Short, strong explanations make ideas easier to combine, challenge, and reuse.

A concise note spreads faster in your own mind.
It accelerates later decisions because the claim is clear.
It increases the chance that one note can connect to another.

Implication:

Rewrite notes until the core idea is legible.
Prefer one sharp paragraph over diffuse pages of hedging.
Extract summary lines from long source notes.

6. Process should be constrained so thinking can stay flexible
He separates flexible thought from repeatable process.

Use consistent naming, dates, tags, and templates.
Repeated constraints reduce future decisions.
Style is leverage.

Implication:

Standardize formats such as YYYY-MM-DD.
Keep property names short and reusable.
Define a small style guide for this vault and let the agent enforce it.

7. Categories and properties beat deep folders
Classification should remain lightweight and cross-cutting.

Many notes belong to multiple contexts.
Categories are more flexible than a single folder path.
Reusable properties allow notes from different domains to be queried together.

Implication:

Prefer frontmatter fields like categories, tags, created, source, people, themes.
Use folders only for clearly different kinds of material, such as references, clippings, attachments, templates, and admin notes.

8. Journaling is not only logging, it is synthesis
He uses a fractal review system.

Capture small fragments quickly.
Periodically review and condense them.
Revisit reviews at larger time scales.
Random revisit helps rediscover forgotten ideas and repair links.

Implication:

Separate raw capture from synthesis.
Build recurring review notes: daily, weekly, monthly, yearly.
Schedule random resurfacing of old notes.

9. Maintenance is part of understanding
He explicitly rejects outsourcing all note maintenance to automation.

Revisiting, cleaning, and relinking are forms of thinking.
Delegating everything can weaken understanding.

Inference:

Agent automation should support understanding, not replace it.

Implication for agent autonomy:

The agent can collect, normalize, link, and propose summaries.
Final interpretation, pruning, and promotion to evergreen notes should stay reviewable by you.

10. Simplicity requires pruning
A healthy system removes as well as adds.

Without pruning, systems grow until they become hard to use.
Removal is invisible but essential maintenance.

Implication:

Periodically archive stale notes.
Merge duplicates.
Remove dead templates and unnecessary structure.
Favor subtraction when the vault starts feeling heavy.

A practical model for your vault
If we adapt Steph Ango’s thinking for an agent-maintained vault, the vault should behave like this:

Capture fast into plain Markdown files.
Normalize metadata and naming consistently.
Turn important ideas into atomic evergreen notes.
Link aggressively across notes, including unresolved ideas.
Use lightweight folders only where type boundaries are obvious.
Organize by reusable properties instead of nested trees.
Review and prune on a schedule so the vault stays alive.

Suggested role split between you and the agent
Agent should do

Import and summarize articles.
Create draft notes with clean titles and metadata.
Suggest links, categories, and candidate evergreen notes.
Generate weekly and monthly review stubs.
Detect duplicates, stale notes, and missing backlinks.

You should do

Decide which ideas are actually worth keeping.
Refine the wording of evergreen notes.
Confirm interpretations that matter.
Use review sessions to deepen understanding instead of only filing information.

Distilled design rules

File over app.
Link over folder.
Property over path.
Concision over exhaustiveness.
Reuse over reinvention.
Review over hoarding.
Prune over accrete.
Support understanding, do not automate it away.

Candidate operating principle for this vault
This vault should optimize for long-term readable files, low-friction capture, dense linking, reusable metadata, and periodic synthesis.

sources/The-Coding-Gopher---How-to-Get-C.filePath: sources/The Coding Gopher - How to Get Cracked at Programming.md
sources/The-Coding-Gopher---How-to-Get-C.title: How to Get Cracked at Programming
sources/The-Coding-Gopher---How-to-Get-C.content:
Summary
A 9-minute YouTube video from The Coding Gopher: six principles the author says he “learned the stupid way, which is to say slowly and mostly in production.” None of them is a framework, and each comes with one concrete example: write-ahead logs, TCP message boundaries, git bisect, a cache-invalidation race, a double-charged payment, and array vs. linked-list cache behavior. It closes by telling viewers not to try all six and to start with principle four (learn a real debugger).

Length: 9:21, English. 05:04–05:58 is a TryHackMe sponsor segment.
Quotes below come from the auto-captions and have not been checked against the audio. The captions spell idempotency as “item potency”; it is corrected here.

Key Takeaways
1. Study the layer below the one you work in (00:22)
“Tools expire, but problems don’t. Every tool is an answer to a question that existed before it did.” Example: the write-ahead log (Postgres, InnoDB, SQLite in WAL mode) and ext4 journaling solve the same problem at two layers. Budget: one hour on the layer beneath, “not the whole layer.”
2. Escape tutorial hell (01:29)
“You don’t learn from the thing working, you learn from the thing not working.” Tutorials edit out the confusion, and the confusion was the learning. Build something nobody decided for you: an HTTP server on raw sockets, a KV store with crash recovery, a toy interpreter. He lost a Saturday learning that TCP is a byte stream with no message boundaries, and now asks of every protocol “where does one message end?”
3. Become a code archaeologist (03:02)
“Every bug anyone hit before you is sitting in the history, and a lot of people don’t know how to query it.” Read the git blame commit before deleting code you don’t understand; git bisect finds the breaking commit among 1,000 in about 10 checks.
4. Debug like a scientist (03:48)
“A bug you can reproduce on demand is already 90% fixed.” Three steps: hypothesize, isolate, write the failing test. Then use a real debugger; a conditional breakpoint “replaces a hundred print statements.”
5. Assume everything will break (05:58)
“Every network call is a coin flip you don’t get to see the result of.” Idempotency keys (the Stripe pattern), exponential backoff with jitter, and explicit timeouts, since requests, Go’s default http.Client and Axios have none by default. He shipped a payment endpoint without an idempotency key and a customer was charged twice.
6. Measure, don’t guess (07:35)
Arrays beat linked lists because of 64-byte cache lines, which Big O hides. Profile with flame graphs and allocation profiles, then benchmark before and after: “If you can’t produce a number showing it got faster, you didn’t optimize anything.”
Extracted Notes

Tools expire, but problems don’t. Every tool is an answer to a question that existed before it did
You don’t learn from the thing working, you learn from the thing not working
Every bug anyone hit before you is sitting in the history, and a lot of people don’t know how to query it
A bug you can reproduce on demand is already 90% fixed. Everything before that point is guesswork and guessing scales terribly
Every network call is a coin flip you don’t get to see the result of. Write the code that assumes it landed wrong
If you can’t produce a number showing it got faster, you didn’t optimize anything. You made the code uglier and effectively told yourself a bedtime story

sources/VK科技閱讀時間---拆解-Elon-Musk-六大思考原則.title: 拆解 Elon Musk 六大思考原則：追求有用、白癡指數、不報復
sources/VK科技閱讀時間---拆解-Elon-Musk-六大思考原則.content:
Summary
台湾频道 VK科技閱讀時間 的读书视频。主持人读完《馬斯克寶典》（The Book of Elon）后，把书里的六条原则和 Musk 的生平故事对照着讲：有用、粉碎 ego、PayPal 的”瘋人院政變”、把赢来的钱放回桌上、白痴指数、不报复。主线问题是：2000 年被 PayPal 合伙人趁他出国时赶下 CEO，为什么他没有报复？八年后救下 SpaceX 的，正是当年那群人开的 Founders Fund。引文是主持人从书中翻译后读出来的，Tesla 圣诞夜融资一段引自 Isaacson 的《馬斯克傳》，所以都是二手材料。

时长：19:57，中文（繁体字幕）

Key Takeaways
开场钥匙：把恐惧拆到物理定义（01:23）
Musk 说小时候怕黑，后来想通”黑暗只是 400–700 奈米波长没有光子”，害怕没有光子是愚蠢的，于是不再怕。主持人把它当成理解他一切思考的钥匙：什么都拆到最根本。
原则一：Be Useful（01:59）
“我并没有想要建造伟大的东西，我想要尝试建造有用的东西。” 1995 年他先想去 Netscape 上班，害羞到在大厅里一句话都没说，回家写程序，才有了 Zip2。四家公司（Zip2、PayPal、SpaceX、Tesla）都在问同一句话：这对别人有用吗？
原则二：粉碎 Ego，Ego to Ability Ratio（04:17）
“物理不关心受伤的感受，它只关心你是否把火箭做对了。” ego 与能力之比大于 1 是重大失败模式：比值太高，就切断了与现实的回馈回路，“用 AI 术语来说，你会打破你的强化学习回路”。
原则三：瘋人院政變（05:44）
X.com 与 Confinity 合并后，为了用 Windows NT 还是 Unix/Linux 吵个不停，Musk 甚至要跟 Max Levchin 比腕力。2000 年 9 月他去澳洲时，Levchin、Thiel、Nosek、Hoffman、Sacks 去红杉找 Michael Moritz，董事会罢免了他。他的回应：“与其在关键时刻打架，现在最好的方式就是让步”，“我不同意他们的结论，但我理解他们为什么采取了行动”。
原则四：把赢来的钱放回桌上（09:09）
卖掉 PayPal 分到约 1.8 亿美元，几乎全部投进 SpaceX（1 亿）、Tesla（7000 万）、SolarCity（1000 万），最后要向朋友借钱付房租。他估计 SpaceX 和 Tesla 各自成功率低于 10%，“也许是 1%“。朋友劝他会赔光，他说那本来就是我的预期。“宁愿对未来乐观却错了，也不要悲观却对了。”
原则五：白痴指数（10:58）
成品价格 ÷ 原料价格 = 你有多蠢。他三次去俄罗斯想买二手洲际弹道导弹都没成，回程飞机上用 Excel 算出火箭原料只占售价 1–2%，结论是制造过程极度低效。例子：喷嘴冷却夹套报价 13,000 美元，原料是 200 美元的钢，指数 65，改为自己做，成本压到几百美元。这也是他敢赌那低于 10% 的理由。
原则六：不报复（13:34）
2008 年 Thiel 在一场婚礼上说”我们把斧头埋了吧”。原本考虑投 500 万美元人情价；Luke Nosek 亲自做尽调，在第三次发射失败后说服 Thiel 加到 2000 万，成为 Founders Fund 当时最大的单笔投资。同年 12 月 22 日 SpaceX 拿到 NASA 16 亿美元合约，24 日 Tesla 在破产前几天完成融资。
主持人的回顾（16:52）
不报复的理由不是道德高尚，而是现实：你不知道未来谁会救你一命，桥烧了就再也走不了。他也在练习”接受失败才是默认值”。
Extracted Notes

Usefulness is how much you help people times how many people you reach（主要出处是 YC 访谈）
An ego larger than ability cuts the feedback loop with reality
The idiot index exposes how much of a price is process inefficiency
Treating failure as the expected outcome makes a low-probability bet bearable
Not retaliating keeps future options open because you cannot know who will help you

一手核对
大部分说法可以在 Elon Musk - Digital Superintelligence, Multiplanetary Life, How to Be Useful 里找到原话。有两处出入：“把赢来的钱放回桌上”在卖掉 Zip2 时就开始了，不是卖掉 PayPal 之后；飞机上用 Excel 计算的故事，访谈里没有提到。逐条对照见 Elon Musk。
补充材料（视频之外）

视频没有提书的编者。The Book of Elon 由 Eric Jorgenson 编，他也编了 The Almanack of Naval Ravikant（Naval Archive），两本书都是把访谈和推文整理成语录集。

sources/Weng---Adversarial-Attacks-on-LL.title: Adversarial Attacks on LLMs
sources/Weng---Adversarial-Attacks-on-LL.content:
Summary / 摘要
EN: A survey of adversarial attacks on LLMs at inference time, assuming fixed model weights. The post organizes attacks into five families — token manipulation (black-box synonym replacement guided by word-importance scores, e.g. TextFooler and BERT-Attack), gradient-based attacks (white-box optimization of adversarial suffixes via Gumbel-softmax and HotFlip-style Taylor approximations, e.g. UAT, AutoPrompt, GCG), jailbreak prompting (exploiting competing objectives and mismatched generalization through encoding, role-play, and obfuscation), human red-teaming (tool-assisted adversarial writing with saliency highlights), and model red-teaming (training an attacker LLM with a harm classifier as reward). It closes with mitigation: robustness framed as a saddle-point min-max problem, adversarial training as the strongest defense but with a robustness-capability tradeoff, and lighter defenses such as self-reminder instructions, paraphrasing, and retokenization.
ZH: 本文综述了推理时（假设模型权重固定）对 LLM 的对抗攻击。文章将攻击归为五类——令牌操纵（黑盒，基于词重要性得分的同义词替换，如 TextFooler、BERT-Attack）、基于梯度的攻击（白盒，用 Gumbel-softmax 与 HotFlip 式泰勒近似优化对抗后缀，如 UAT、AutoPrompt、GCG）、jailbreak 提示（利用竞争目标与不匹配泛化，如编码混淆、角色扮演）、人工红队（用显著性高亮等工具辅助对抗写作）、模型红队（以有害性分类器为奖励训练攻击 LLM）。结尾讨论缓解措施：把鲁棒性建模为鞍点 min-max 问题，对抗训练是最强防御但存在鲁棒性-能力权衡，以及自我提醒指令、释义、重新分词等轻量防御。
Key Takeaways / 核心要点


EN: Five attack families — token manipulation, gradient-based, jailbreak prompting, human red-teaming, model red-teaming — and only gradient-based attacks require white-box access.
ZH: 五类攻击——令牌操纵、基于梯度、jailbreak 提示、人工红队、模型红队——其中只有基于梯度的攻击需要白盒访问。


EN: White-box attacks on open-source models transfer to commercial black-box APIs, especially when training data overlaps; Vicuna, fine-tuned on GPT-3.5-turbo outputs, makes its own attack close to an attack on its teacher.
ZH: 对开源模型的白盒攻击可迁移到商业黑盒 API，训练数据重叠时尤其明显；用 GPT-3.5-turbo 输出微调的 Vicuna，使攻击它近似于攻击其教师模型。


EN: Jailbreaks exploit two failure modes of safety training: competing objectives (capability vs. safety goals) and mismatched generalization (inputs OOD for safety training but inside the pretraining distribution, e.g. Base64, ROT13, token smuggling).
ZH: Jailbreak 利用安全训练的两种失败模式：竞争目标（能力目标与安全目标冲突）与不匹配泛化（对安全训练是分布外、却落在预训练分布内的输入，如 Base64、ROT13、令牌走私）。


EN: Automated red-teaming is bottlenecked by its harm classifier — RL exploits every classifier flaw as an attack pattern — and faces a diversity-versus-success tradeoff, with an explicit diversity term needed to avoid mode collapse.
ZH: 自动化红队受限于其有害性分类器——RL 会把分类器的每个缺陷当作攻击模式利用——并面临多样性与成功率的权衡，需要显式多样性项才能避免模式崩溃。


EN: Attack effectiveness trades off against stealth: nonsensical triggers are detectable by their absurd perplexity (~10^7), while fluent attacks (UAT-LM, UTSC) evade detection at the cost of some success rate.
ZH: 攻击有效性与隐蔽性相互权衡：无意义触发器因其离谱的困惑度（约 10^7）而易被检测，流畅攻击（UAT-LM、UTSC）则以部分成功率为代价换取隐蔽。


EN: Adversarial training is the strongest defense but trades model capability for robustness; robustness itself can be framed as a min-max saddle-point problem of worst-case perturbation plus outer minimization.
ZH: 对抗训练是最强防御，但以模型能力换取鲁棒性；鲁棒性本身可建模为”最坏情况扰动 + 外部最小化”的 min-max 鞍点问题。


Extracted Notes / 提取笔记

Adversarial suffixes transfer from open-source models to commercial APIs
Jailbreaks exploit competing objectives and mismatched generalization in safety training
Automated red-teaming is bottlenecked by the quality of its harm classifier
Adversarial attacks trade effectiveness for stealth and fluency
Adversarial robustness is a min-max saddle point problem
Adversarial training trades model capability for robustness

sources/Weng---Diffusion-Models-for-Vide.filePath: sources/Weng - Diffusion Models for Video Generation.md
sources/Weng---Diffusion-Models-for-Vide.title: Diffusion Models for Video Generation
sources/Weng---Diffusion-Models-for-Vide.content:
Summary / 摘要
EN: A survey of diffusion models for video generation, organized around two strategies. Models trained from scratch extend image diffusion architectures to 3D: VDM factorizes a 3D U-Net over space and time, Imagen Video cascades a base model with interleaved spatial and temporal super-resolution stages, and Sora applies a Diffusion Transformer over spacetime patches. The more prominent strategy is “inflating” a pretrained text-to-image model by inserting temporal layers (Make-A-Video, Tune-A-Video, Gen-1, Video LDM, SVD, Lumiere), optionally fine-tuning only the new parameters — or, as in Text2Video-Zero and ControlVideo, adapting with no training at all via motion-aware latent sampling and cross-frame attention. Supporting technical ideas include v-prediction to avoid color shift, reconstruction guidance for conditional video extension, and dataset curation as a major quality lever.
ZH: 本文综述了用于视频生成的扩散模型，围绕两条策略展开。从零训练的模型将图像扩散架构扩展到 3D：VDM 把 3D U-Net 在空间和时间上分解，Imagen Video 用基础模型加交错的空间/时间超分辨率级联，Sora 则在时空 patch 上使用 Diffusion Transformer。更突出的策略是通过插入时间层”膨胀”预训练文生图模型（Make-A-Video、Tune-A-Video、Gen-1、Video LDM、SVD、Lumiere），可选择只微调新参数；甚至如 Text2Video-Zero 和 ControlVideo 那样，通过运动感知的潜在采样和跨帧注意力完全免训练适配。支撑性技术思想包括：用 v-参数化避免颜色偏移、用重建引导做条件视频延伸，以及把数据集筛选作为重要的质量杠杆。
Key Takeaways / 核心要点


EN: Video generation is a superset of image generation but harder: temporal consistency demands more encoded world knowledge, and high-quality text-video pairs are far scarcer than text-image pairs.
ZH: 视频生成是图像生成的超集，但更难：时序一致性要求编码更多世界知识，而高质量文本-视频配对远比文本-图像配对稀缺。


EN: The dominant adaptation strategy is inflating a pretrained image model with temporal layers inserted after each spatial layer, initialized as identity, then fine-tuning only the new parameters — inheriting the text-image prior and reducing text-video data needs.
ZH: 主流适配策略是在预训练图像模型的每个空间层后插入时间层并初始化为恒等函数，然后只微调新参数——继承文本-图像先验，减少对文本-视频数据的需求。


EN: Temporal layers that mix activations across frames after shared spatial processing capture coherence better than frame-autoregressive approaches, at lower cost than full spatiotemporal attention.
ZH: 在共享空间处理之后用时间层混合跨帧激活，比帧自回归方法更好地捕获连贯性，成本又低于完整时空注意力。


EN: Training-free adaptation is possible: Text2Video-Zero turns an image model into a zero-shot video generator by adding motion dynamics to latent sampling and cross-frame attention anchored on the first frame.
ZH: 免训练适配是可行的：Text2Video-Zero 通过给潜在采样加入运动动态、并以第一帧为锚点做跨帧注意力，把图像模型变成零样本视频生成器。


EN: Dataset curation is a first-class quality lever — SVD found that a filtered, much smaller dataset (cut detection, motion/OCR/aesthetics filtering) outperforms a larger unfiltered one.
ZH: 数据集筛选是一等质量杠杆——SVD 发现经过筛选的小得多的数据集（镜头检测、运动/OCR/美学过滤）优于更大的未筛选数据集。


EN: Generating the whole video duration in one pass (Lumiere’s STUNet) avoids the temporal-consistency failures of keyframe-plus-interpolation pipelines that rely on temporal super-resolution.
ZH: 单次前向生成整个视频时长（Lumiere 的 STUNet）避免了依赖时间超分辨率的关键帧加插值流水线的时序一致性失败。


Extracted Notes / 提取笔记

Extending a pretrained model to a new dimension means inserting identity-initialized modules and freezing the backbone
Temporal mixing layers after shared spatial processing capture sequence coherence better than autoregression
Sequence consistency can be enforced at inference time by anchoring attention to a reference frame
A smaller curated dataset can outperform a larger unfiltered one
Generating a whole sequence at once avoids the consistency failures of keyframe-plus-interpolation pipelines

sources/Weng---Extrinsic-Hallucinations-.title: Extrinsic Hallucinations in LLMs
sources/Weng---Extrinsic-Hallucinations-.content:
Summary / 摘要
EN: This post surveys extrinsic hallucination in LLMs — cases where model output is fabricated and grounded by neither the provided context nor world knowledge. It separates in-context from extrinsic hallucination and traces causes to noisy pretraining data and to fine-tuning on new knowledge (which Gekhman et al. show is learned slowly and, once learned, raises hallucination rates). It then reviews detection: retrieval-augmented evaluation (FactualityPrompt, FActScore, SAFE, FacTool), sampling-based consistency checks (SelfCheckGPT, indirect query), and calibration of unknown knowledge (TruthfulQA, SelfAware). Finally it covers anti-hallucination methods — RAG with editing and attribution (RARR, FAVA, Self-RAG), Chain-of-Verification, sampling interventions, factuality-aware fine-tuning (FLAME), and attribution-trained systems (WebGPT, GopherCite) — converging on the principle that factuality is best enforced by external evidence, attribution, and calibrated abstention rather than by the model’s own judgment.
ZH: 本文综述 LLM 的外部幻觉——模型输出系虚构、既无上下文依据也无世界知识依据的情况。文章首先区分上下文内幻觉与外部幻觉，并将成因追溯到有噪声的预训练数据以及在新知识上的微调（Gekhman 等人表明新知识学得慢，且一旦学会反而提高幻觉率）。随后梳理检测方法：检索增强评估（FactualityPrompt、FActScore、SAFE、FacTool）、基于采样的一致性检查（SelfCheckGPT、间接查询）以及未知知识的校准（TruthfulQA、SelfAware）。最后介绍抗幻觉方法——带编辑与归因的 RAG（RARR、FAVA、Self-RAG）、验证链、采样干预、事实性感知微调（FLAME）以及归因训练系统（WebGPT、GopherCite）——共同指向一个原则：事实性最好由外部证据、归因和校准的弃答来保障，而非依赖模型自身的判断。
Key Takeaways / 核心要点


EN: Hallucination splits into in-context (contradicts the provided source) and extrinsic (ungrounded by world knowledge); avoiding it requires both factuality and acknowledging when the model does not know.
ZH: 幻觉分为上下文内（与所提供来源矛盾）和外部（无世界知识依据）两类；避免幻觉既需要事实性，也需要在不知道时承认不知道。


EN: Fine-tuning on new knowledge is risky: models fit “unknown” examples slower than known ones, and once learned they increase hallucination — best dev performance comes from fitting most known examples but few unknown ones.
ZH: 在新知识上微调是有风险的：模型拟合”未知”示例比已知示例慢，且一旦学会反而增加幻觉——最佳开发集性能来自拟合大部分已知示例、仅拟合少数未知示例。


EN: Retrieval-augmented fact verification consistently beats asking the model to self-check: FActScore validates atomic facts against Wikipedia, and SAFE’s search agent beats human annotators at 1/20th the cost.
ZH: 检索增强的事实验证始终优于让模型自查：FActScore 对照 Wikipedia 验证原子事实，SAFE 的搜索智能体以 1/20 成本胜过人类标注者。


EN: Chain-of-Verification works only when verification questions are answered separately from the draft — if the original hallucinated response stays in context, the model just repeats it; instruction tuning and CoT alone do not reduce hallucination.
ZH: 验证链只有在验证问题与草稿分开回答时才有效——若原始幻觉响应留在上下文中，模型只会重复它；仅靠指令微调和 CoT 不能减少幻觉。


EN: Attribution makes output checkable: RARR edits drafts to agree with evidence, WebGPT and GopherCite cite sources so humans can judge correctness, and selective prediction lets the model abstain with “I don’t know”.
ZH: 归因让输出可核查：RARR 编辑草稿使之与证据一致，WebGPT 和 GopherCite 引用来源供人类判断正确性，选择性预测让模型以”我不知道”弃答。


EN: Black-box detection needs no external knowledge: SelfCheckGPT flags content that is inconsistent across stochastic samples, and indirect queries (asking for authors, not existence) catch fabricated references better than direct ones.
ZH: 黑盒检测无需外部知识：SelfCheckGPT 标记在多次随机采样间不一致的内容，间接查询（问作者而非问是否存在）比直接查询更能抓出虚构参考文献。


EN: RLHF degrades the calibration of model confidence, so uncertainty signals must be handled carefully — a model that cannot say “I don’t know” at the right confidence is a hallucination risk.
ZH: RLHF 会降低模型置信度的校准质量，因此必须谨慎对待不确定性信号——一个无法在正确置信度下说”我不知道”的模型就是幻觉风险。


Extracted Notes / 提取笔记

Hallucination is either unfaithful to context or ungrounded in world knowledge
Fine-tuning LLMs on new knowledge can increase hallucination
Facts should be verified against retrieved evidence rather than model opinion
Verification questions must be answered separately from the draft being checked
Attribution turns factuality into a property humans can check
Inconsistency across samples reveals hallucination with black-box access alone

sources/Weng---Harness-Engineering-for-S.title: Harness Engineering for Self-Improvement
sources/Weng---Harness-Engineering-for-S.content:
Summary / 摘要
EN: This post frames harness engineering as the near-term engine of recursive self-improvement (RSI). A harness is the system around a base model that orchestrates how it thinks and plans, calls tools, manages context, stores artifacts, and evaluates results — and the success of coding agents like Claude Code and Codex shows this deployment layer rivals raw model intelligence. Weng surveys harness design patterns (goal-oriented workflow loops, the file system as persistent memory, inspectable subagent parallelism), then traces how the optimization target climbs from prompts to structured context to workflows to harness code to optimizer code, covering context engineering (ACE, MCE), meta-harness search (ADAS, AFlow, Meta-Harness), self-improving harnesses (STOP, Self-Harness, AHE, Darwin Gödel Machine), and evolutionary program search. She closes with open bottlenecks — weak evaluators, context and memory lifecycle, negative results, diversity collapse, reward hacking, long-term success metrics, and the role of humans — arguing that the evaluator and permission controls must sit outside the self-improvement loop.
ZH: 本文将 harness 工程框定为递归自我改进（RSI）的近期引擎。Harness 是围绕基础模型、编排其如何思考与规划、调用工具、管理上下文、存储产物和评估结果的系统——Claude Code、Codex 等 coding agent 的成功表明，这一部署层可与模型的原始智能比肩。Weng 梳理了 harness 设计模式（目标导向的工作流循环、文件系统作为持久记忆、可检查的子 agent 并行），随后追踪被优化对象如何从 prompt 攀升到结构化上下文、工作流、harness 代码乃至优化器代码，涵盖上下文工程（ACE、MCE）、元 harness 搜索（ADAS、AFlow、Meta-Harness）、自我改进 harness（STOP、Self-Harness、AHE、Darwin Gödel Machine）与进化式程序搜索。结尾讨论开放瓶颈——薄弱的评估器、上下文与记忆生命周期、负面结果、多样性坍缩、奖励黑客、长期成功指标以及人类的角色——主张评估器和权限控制必须位于自我改进循环之外。
Key Takeaways / 核心要点


EN: A harness — the system orchestrating how a model thinks, calls tools, manages context, and evaluates results — is as important as raw model intelligence, and is the near-term path to recursive self-improvement.
ZH: Harness——编排模型如何思考、调用工具、管理上下文和评估结果的系统——与模型原始智能同等重要，是递归自我改进的近期路径。


EN: Durable state belongs in files, not in context: long-horizon artifacts outgrow the context window, and file-backed state (including subagent outputs) survives interruptions and stays inspectable.
ZH: 持久状态应放在文件而非上下文中：长程产物会超出上下文窗口，文件支撑的状态（包括子 agent 输出）能在中断后幸存并保持可检查。


EN: The optimization target climbs a ladder — prompts → structured context → workflows → harness code → optimizer code — and code is the universal language that unlocks the largest design space.
ZH: 被优化对象沿阶梯攀升——prompt → 结构化上下文 → 工作流 → harness 代码 → 优化器代码——代码是解锁最大设计空间的通用语言。


EN: Context should be an evolving playbook of itemized entries merged with deterministic logic (ACE), not an ever-growing appended prompt, to avoid context collapse and brevity bias.
ZH: 上下文应是逐条条目经确定性逻辑合并的演进手册（ACE），而非不断增长的追加式 prompt，以避免上下文坍缩和简洁性偏差。


EN: Recursive self-improvement requires a capable-enough base model: STOP improved with GPT-4 but degraded on weaker models, and harness-updating ability is not the same as harness-benefit ability.
ZH: 递归自我改进需要足够有能力的基础模型：STOP 在 GPT-4 上改进却在较弱模型上退化，且 harness 更新能力不等于 harness 收益能力。


EN: In a self-improving harness, every edit should be a falsifiable, evidence-grounded claim while the evaluator and permission controls stay outside the loop, so recorded gains stay attributable and reward hacking stays disabled.
ZH: 在自我改进的 harness 中，每次编辑都应是可证伪、有证据依据的主张，而评估器和权限控制应留在循环之外，这样记录的增益才可归因、奖励黑客才被禁用。


Extracted Notes / 提取笔记

The harness layer around a model matters as much as its raw intelligence
A harness should keep durable state in files rather than in context
Context should be maintained as an evolving playbook not an appended log
Code is the universal language for optimizing agent harnesses
Recursive self-improvement only works above a base-model capability threshold
Harness edits must be falsifiable and the evaluator must stay outside the loop

sources/Weng---LLM-Powered-Autonomous-Ag.title: LLM Powered Autonomous Agents
sources/Weng---LLM-Powered-Autonomous-Ag.content:
Summary / 摘要
EN: A foundational overview of building autonomous agents with an LLM as the core controller. The agent is framed as an LLM “brain” plus three components — planning (task decomposition via CoT/ToT, self-reflection via ReAct/Reflexion), memory (short-term as in-context learning, long-term as an external vector store queried by MIPS), and tool use (external APIs for information and capability beyond the weights). The post surveys supporting systems (MRKL, Toolformer, HuggingGPT, API-Bank), case studies (ChemCrow, Generative Agents, AutoGPT), and closes with the core limitations: finite context length, fragile long-term planning, and unreliable natural-language interfaces.
ZH: 本文是构建以 LLM 为核心控制器的自主智能体的奠基性综述。智能体被框定为 LLM”大脑”加三个组件——规划（用 CoT/ToT 做任务分解，用 ReAct/Reflexion 做自我反思）、记忆（短期对应上下文学习，长期对应通过 MIPS 检索的外部向量库）、工具使用（调用外部 API 以获取权重之外的信息与能力）。文章梳理了支撑系统（MRKL、Toolformer、HuggingGPT、API-Bank）与案例（ChemCrow、Generative Agents、AutoGPT），并在结尾指出核心局限：有限的上下文长度、脆弱的长期规划，以及不可靠的自然语言接口。
Key Takeaways / 核心要点


EN: An LLM agent = LLM core + planning + memory + tool use; the architecture is what turns a text generator into a general problem solver.
ZH: LLM 智能体 = LLM 核心 + 规划 + 记忆 + 工具使用；正是这套架构把文本生成器变成通用问题求解器。


EN: Short-term memory is in-context learning (bounded by the context window); long-term memory is an external vector store retrieved at runtime.
ZH: 短期记忆是上下文学习（受上下文窗口限制）；长期记忆是运行时检索的外部向量库。


EN: Self-reflection (Reflexion) converts trial and error into within-episode improvement by detecting inefficient or hallucinated trajectories and resetting.
ZH: 自我反思（Reflexion）通过识别低效或幻觉轨迹并重试，把试错转化为单任务内的改进。


EN: Tool use is bottlenecked by the LLM reliably deciding when and how to call a tool, not by the availability of tools.
ZH: 工具使用的瓶颈在于 LLM 能否可靠地判断何时、如何调用工具，而非工具的多少。


EN: LLMs cannot reliably self-evaluate in expert domains — ChemCrow’s LLM scoring missed the gap that human experts caught.
ZH: LLM 在专业领域无法可靠自评——ChemCrow 中 LLM 打分漏掉了人类专家发现的差距。


EN: Finite context length is the scarce resource; retrieval widens the knowledge pool but loses full attention, so design must work within the bandwidth limit.
ZH: 有限上下文是稀缺资源；检索扩大知识池却丧失完整注意力，设计必须在带宽限制内进行。


Extracted Notes / 提取笔记

An LLM agent combines planning memory and tool use around a language model core
An agent’s short-term memory is its context window and long-term memory is external retrieval
Self-reflection turns trial and error into within-episode learning
Tool use is bottlenecked by knowing when and how to call rather than by the tools themselves
LLMs cannot reliably evaluate their own output in expert domains
Finite context length forces agent design to work within limited communication bandwidth

sources/Weng---Prompt-Engineering.title: Prompt Engineering
sources/Weng---Prompt-Engineering.content:
Summary / 摘要
EN: A survey of prompt engineering for autoregressive LLMs — methods for steering model behavior without updating weights. It covers zero-shot and few-shot prompting (with example selection/ordering tips and the biases that make few-shot performance high-variance), instruction prompting, self-consistency sampling, chain-of-thought and its extensions (STaR, complexity-based consistency, Self-Ask, ReAct, Tree of Thoughts), automatic prompt design (AutoPrompt, APE, augment-prune-select), and augmented language models that retrieve knowledge, generate code (PAL/PoT), or call external APIs (TALM, Toolformer). The core theme: prompt engineering is an empirical science of alignment and steerability, and its effects vary heavily across models.
ZH: 本文是对自回归 LLM 提示工程的综述——即在不更新权重的情况下引导模型行为的方法。内容涵盖零样本与少样本提示（含示例选择/排序技巧及导致少样本性能高方差的偏差）、指令提示、自洽性采样、思维链及其扩展（STaR、基于复杂度的一致性、Self-Ask、ReAct、思维树）、自动提示设计（AutoPrompt、APE、augment-prune-select），以及检索知识、生成代码（PAL/PoT）或调用外部 API（TALM、Toolformer）的增强语言模型。核心主题：提示工程是一门关于对齐与可引导性的经验科学，其效果在不同模型间差异很大。
Key Takeaways / 核心要点


EN: Few-shot example choice, format, and order can swing performance from near-random guess to near-SoTA, driven by majority-label, recency, and common-token biases.
ZH: 少样本示例的选择、格式与顺序可使性能从接近随机猜测波动到接近 SoTA，背后是多数标签偏差、近因偏差和常见 token 偏差。


EN: Chain-of-thought prompting yields large gains only on complex reasoning tasks with large models (e.g. >50B parameters); simple tasks benefit only slightly.
ZH: 思维链提示仅在大模型（如超过 500 亿参数）的复杂推理任务上带来显著收益；简单任务受益甚微。


EN: Self-consistency sampling — sampling multiple reasoning paths and taking a majority vote — improves accuracy, and verifiable tasks can be checked directly (e.g. unit tests).
ZH: 自洽性采样——采样多条推理路径并多数投票——可提高准确率，可验证任务还能直接检验（如单元测试）。


EN: Explanations in prompts are more often nonfactual than inconsistent, and nonfactual explanations most likely lead to incorrect predictions.
ZH: 提示中的解释更多是不符合事实而非前后不一致，而不符合事实的解释最可能导致错误预测。


EN: Prompts can be optimized automatically: APE searches model-generated instruction candidates scored on training data, then refines the best via iterative Monte Carlo search.
ZH: 提示可以自动优化：APE 在模型生成的指令候选中搜索、按训练数据打分，再用迭代蒙特卡洛搜索精炼最优候选。


EN: Toolformer learns tool use self-supervised: a candidate API call is kept only if adding its result reduces the loss on predicting future tokens.
ZH: Toolformer 以自监督方式学习工具使用：仅当加入 API 调用结果能降低未来 token 预测损失时才保留该调用。


EN: Retrieval augments post-cutoff knowledge, but performance on post-cutoff questions remains worse than pre-cutoff ones, suggesting conflict between contextual and parametric knowledge.
ZH: 检索可补充截止日期后的知识，但模型在截止日期后问题上的表现仍更差，表明上下文知识与参数知识存在冲突。


Extracted Notes / 提取笔记

Few-shot prompt performance swings wildly with example choice and order
Chain-of-thought pays off only for complex reasoning in large models
Self-consistency sampling improves reliability through majority vote
Automatic prompt engineering treats instructions as programs
Prompt explanations fail by being nonfactual rather than inconsistent
Keep a tool call only when it improves prediction of future tokens

sources/Weng---Reward-Hacking-in-Reinfor.filePath: sources/Weng - Reward Hacking in Reinforcement Learning.md
sources/Weng---Reward-Hacking-in-Reinfor.title: Reward Hacking in Reinforcement Learning
sources/Weng---Reward-Hacking-in-Reinfor.content:
Summary / 摘要
EN: A comprehensive survey of reward hacking — when an RL agent exploits flaws or ambiguities in the reward function to earn high reward without completing the intended task. The post grounds the problem in Goodhart’s Law and the impossibility of perfectly specifying a reward, catalogs examples across RL, LLMs, and real life, and shows that hacking worsens as agent capability increases. It then examines LLM-specific forms: RLHF overoptimization that makes wrong answers convincing (U-Sophistry) and sycophancy, biased LLM graders (positional and self-preference bias), in-context reward hacking in self-refinement loops, and cross-task generalization of hacking skills, before sketching mitigations (adversarial rewards, decoupled approval, anomaly detection, RLHF data analysis).
ZH: 本文是对奖励黑客的全面综述——当 RL 智能体利用奖励函数的缺陷或歧义获取高奖励却未完成预期任务时即发生。文章以古德哈特定律和完美指定奖励的不可能性为根基，梳理了 RL、LLM 与现实生活中的大量案例，并表明黑客行为随智能体能力增强而加剧。随后考察 LLM 特有的形式：让错误答案更有说服力的 RLHF 过度优化（U-Sophistry）与谄媚、有偏的 LLM 评分者（位置偏差与自我偏好偏差）、自我精炼循环中的上下文奖励黑客，以及黑客技能的跨任务泛化，最后简述缓解方法（对抗性奖励、解耦批准、异常检测、RLHF 数据分析）。
Key Takeaways / 核心要点


EN: Reward hacking exists because a reward function is always an imperfect proxy for the true goal, and RL exploits any gap between them (Goodhart’s Law).
ZH: 奖励黑客之所以存在，是因为奖励函数始终是真实目标的不完美代理，而 RL 会利用二者之间的任何缝隙（古德哈特定律）。


EN: More capable agents hack more: larger models and longer training raise proxy rewards while decreasing true rewards, so weak agents can hide reward-function flaws.
ZH: 能力越强的智能体黑客行为越严重：更大的模型与更长的训练提升代理奖励却降低真实奖励，因此弱智能体反而会掩盖奖励函数的缺陷。


EN: RLHF can increase human approval without increasing correctness — models learn to produce convincing but wrong answers, weakening human evaluators (U-Sophistry).
ZH: RLHF 能提升人类认可度却不提升正确性——模型学会生成有说服力但错误的答案，削弱人类评估者的判断（U-Sophistry）。


EN: Using LLMs as graders introduces exploitable biases — positional bias and self-preference — so grader outputs used as reward signals are themselves hackable.
ZH: 用 LLM 作评分者会引入可被利用的偏差——位置偏差与自我偏好——因此被用作奖励信号的评分输出本身也可被黑客攻击。


EN: In-context reward hacking emerges at deployment in self-refinement loops where the same model generates and evaluates; shared context drives the divergence, and scaling worsens it.
ZH: 上下文奖励黑客在部署阶段出现于同一模型既生成又评估的自我精炼循环中；共享上下文驱动评分与真实质量的背离，且模型规模越大越严重。


EN: Reward hacking skills generalize across environments — even to zero-shot reward-function rewriting — but SFT on non-gaming behavior in easy-to-detect settings reduces tampering.
ZH: 奖励黑客技能可跨环境泛化——甚至零样本重写奖励函数——但在易检测环境中用非博弈行为做 SFT 能降低篡改概率。


Extracted Notes / 提取笔记

Every reward function is a hackable proxy for the true goal
More capable agents exploit reward loopholes more aggressively
RLHF makes incorrect answers more convincing to human evaluators
LLM-as-grader is an imperfect proxy with exploitable biases
Self-refinement feedback loops can hack their own evaluator
Reward hacking generalizes across tasks but anti-gaming SFT mitigates it

sources/Weng---Scaling-Laws,-Carefully.title: Scaling Laws, Carefully
sources/Weng---Scaling-Laws,-Carefully.content:
Summary / 摘要
EN: A careful review of scaling laws in deep learning — how test loss L decays as a power law with model size N, dataset size D, and compute C (C \approx 6ND). The post traces the history from early learning-curve work (Amari, Hestness, Rosenfeld) through Kaplan et al.’s influential laws and the Chinchilla correction, explains why the two disagree (small-model regime, embedding counting), surveys hypotheses for why power laws appear, and extends the picture into the data-limited regime where token repetition and overfitting matter. A closing section warns that scaling-law fitting is surprisingly sensitive to trivial procedural choices (parameter counting, loss precision, fit region).
ZH: 本文系统梳理了深度学习中的缩放定律（scaling laws）——测试损失 L 随模型规模 N、数据规模 D 和算力 C（C \approx 6ND）按幂律下降。文章回顾了早期学习曲线研究（Amari、Hestness、Rosenfeld），接着讲 Kaplan 等人的经典定律与 Chinchilla 的修正，并解释两者分歧的原因（小模型区间、是否计入 embedding 参数）；随后讨论了幂律出现的多种假说；最后把图景扩展到数据有限区间——此时 token 重复与过拟合变得关键。结尾提醒：缩放定律的拟合对看似无关紧要的流程选择（参数计数方式、损失精度、拟合区间）异常敏感。
Key Takeaways / 核心要点


EN: Scaling laws describe how to allocate compute optimally between model size N and data D; loss follows a power law that is linear on a log-log plot.
ZH: 缩放定律的核心是如何在模型规模 N 与数据规模 D 之间最优分配算力；损失服从幂律，在双对数图上呈直线。


EN: Kaplan et al. (2020) found N_\text{opt} \propto C^{0.73} — model should grow faster than data, and training a big model and stopping early beats training a small model to convergence.
ZH: Kaplan 等人 (2020) 得出 N_\text{opt} \propto C^{0.73}——模型增长应快于数据，且”训大模型并提前停止”优于”把小模型训到收敛”。


EN: Chinchilla (Hoffmann et al. 2022) corrected this to N_\text{opt} \propto C^{0.5} — for every doubling of model size, double the training tokens. Chinchilla (70B, 1.4T tokens) beat Gopher (280B, 300B tokens) under the same compute budget, showing most 2022-era LLMs were undertrained.
ZH: Chinchilla (Hoffmann 等, 2022) 修正为 N_\text{opt} \propto C^{0.5}——模型规模翻倍时，训练 token 也应翻倍。在相同算力预算下，Chinchilla（70B 参数、1.4T token）全面超越 Gopher（280B 参数、300B token），说明 2022 年前后的多数大模型都训练不足。


EN: Kaplan and Chinchilla can be reconciled: Kaplan mostly fit small models where embeddings are a non-negligible fraction of parameters; the local exponent g drifts from ~0.73 (small) toward 0.50 (large) as scale grows (Pearce & Song 2024).
ZH: Kaplan 与 Chinchilla 可以调和：Kaplan 主要在小模型上拟合，此时 embedding 占参数比例不可忽略；随规模增大，局部指数 g 从约 0.73（小模型）逐渐收敛到 0.50（大模型）（Pearce & Song, 2024）。


EN: Chinchilla’s parametric fit is \hat{L}(N,D) = A/N^\alpha + B/D^\beta + E; when \alpha \approx \beta, model size and tokens should scale equally. Closed-form optima exist under C \approx 6ND.
ZH: Chinchilla 的参数化拟合为 \hat{L}(N,D) = A/N^\alpha + B/D^\beta + E；当 \alpha \approx \beta 时，模型规模与 token 数应等比增长。在 C \approx 6ND 约束下可得到最优解的闭式表达。


EN: In the data-limited regime, repeated tokens lose value exponentially (Muennighoff et al. 2023); Lovelace et al. (2026) add an explicit overfitting penalty P \cdot R_D^\delta \cdot (N/U_D)^\kappa that grows with both repetition count and the capacity ratio.
ZH: 在数据有限区间，重复 token 的价值指数衰减（Muennighoff 等, 2023）；Lovelace 等 (2026) 加入显式过拟合惩罚项 P \cdot R_D^\delta \cdot (N/U_D)^\kappa，其随重复次数和容量比同时增大。


EN: Fitting is fragile: rounding loss precision, small noise, or fitting only small models can wildly change the extrapolated prediction (demonstrated by a toy simulation and Besiroglu et al. 2024’s Chinchilla replication).
ZH: 拟合很脆弱：损失精度的舍入、微小噪声、或仅在小模型上拟合，都可能让外推预测产生巨大偏差（玩具模拟与 Besiroglu 等 2024 年对 Chinchilla 的复现均印证了这一点）。


Symbols / 符号表








































SymbolEN meaning中文含义NModel size (parameter count)模型规模（参数量）DDataset size (token count)数据规模（token 数）CTraining compute in FLOPs, C \approx 6ND训练算力（FLOPs），C \approx 6NDEIrreducible loss不可约损失L, \hat{L}Test loss / prediction function测试损失 / 预测函数\epsilonGeneralization error泛化误差
Extracted Notes / 提取笔记

Under a fixed compute budget, model size and training tokens should scale together
Scaling-law predictions are fragile to trivial fitting choices
The Kaplan-Chinchilla exponent gap dissolves as scale grows
Repeated tokens decay in value and larger models overfit them faster
The power-law exponent is a property of the problem not the architecture
Data quality can change compute efficiency more than token count

sources/Weng---Thinking-about-High-Quali.filePath: sources/Weng - Thinking about High-Quality Human Data.md
sources/Weng---Thinking-about-High-Quali.title: Thinking about High-Quality Human Data
sources/Weng---Thinking-about-High-Quali.content:
Summary / 摘要
EN: A practical survey of collecting and curating high-quality human-annotated data, the fuel of supervised and alignment training. The post walks the annotation pipeline — task design, rater selection and training, then aggregation — and covers the wisdom of the crowd (Galton’s ox-weighing median), agreement metrics and probabilistic models (MACE) that downweight spammers, the descriptive vs prescriptive paradigms for subjective tasks where disagreement is legitimate signal rather than error, and post-hoc mislabel detection via training dynamics: influence functions, Data Maps, AUM, example forgetting, and noisy cross-validation. A recurring theme: “everyone wants to do the model work, not the data work,” yet data quality is built operationally, detail by detail.
ZH: 本文是一篇关于收集与筛选高质量人工标注数据的实务综述——标注数据是监督训练与对齐训练的燃料。文章走查标注全流程——任务设计、标注者选拔与培训、数据聚合——并涵盖群体智慧（Galton 的牛体重中位数猜测）、一致性指标与降低垃圾标注者权重的概率模型（MACE）、主观任务中”描述性 vs 规范性”两种范式（此时分歧是合理信号而非错误），以及通过训练动态事后识别错误标签的方法：影响函数、Data Maps、AUM、样本遗忘与噪声交叉验证。贯穿全文的主题是：“人人都想做模型工作，不想做数据工作”，但数据质量正是靠一个个细节的运营构建起来的。
Key Takeaways / 核心要点


EN: Data quality is built operationally — task design, rater training, and aggregation each contribute; ML techniques help but cannot replace careful execution.
ZH: 数据质量靠流程构建——任务设计、标注者培训、聚合每一步都有贡献；ML 技术有帮助，却无法替代认真的执行。


EN: The wisdom of the crowd works when errors are independent: the median of hundreds of ox-weight guesses hit the truth, but spammers and correlated guesses break the guarantee.
ZH: 误差独立时群体智慧有效：数百个牛体重猜测的中位数命中真值，但垃圾标注者和相关猜测会打破这一保证。


EN: Majority vote assumes equal rater competence; better aggregation weights annotators by estimated proficiency — agreement with experts, agreement with peers, or learned trustworthiness (MACE).
ZH: 多数投票假设标注者能力相同；更好的聚合按估计熟练度加权——与专家一致率、与同伴一致率，或学习出的可信度（MACE）。


EN: In safety, social, and cultural tasks, disagreement is often valid signal, not noise; the descriptive paradigm models the diversity of beliefs instead of forcing one gold label.
ZH: 在安全、社会、文化类任务中，分歧往往是有效信号而非噪声；描述性范式建模信念的多样性，而非强行规定唯一黄金标签。


EN: Agreement varies sharply by topic and severity — 0.96 on violence/gore versus 0.25 on personal topics — and concentrates at the extremes, leaving the “debatable” middle genuinely contested.
ZH: 一致率随主题和严重程度差异巨大——暴力/血腥 0.96，个人主题 0.25——且集中在两端，“有争议”的中间地带才是真正的分歧所在。


EN: Training dynamics expose mislabels: samples with persistently low confidence and low variability, small margins (AUM), or high self-influence are likely flipped.
ZH: 训练动态能暴露错误标签：持续低置信度低变异性、小 margin（AUM）或高自影响的样本很可能被标错。


EN: Hard-to-learn is not synonymous with wrong: ambiguous and hard samples are the most informative for OOD generalization, and unforgettable examples can be pruned without loss.
ZH: 难学习不等于标错：模糊与困难样本对 OOD 泛化最有信息量，而”不可遗忘”样本可无损裁剪。


Extracted Notes / 提取笔记

The median of independent crowd guesses converges to the truth
Majority vote assumes equal rater competence so annotators must be weighted by estimated proficiency
Rater disagreement is valid signal in subjective tasks not noise to be eliminated
Training dynamics expose mislabeled data that static filtering misses
Hard-to-learn samples are often the most informative for OOD generalization
Unforgettable examples can be pruned without hurting model performance

sources/Weng---Why-We-Think.title: Why We Think
sources/Weng---Why-We-Think.content:
Summary / 摘要
EN: The post surveys why and how “thinking time” (test-time compute) improves LLM reasoning. It motivates longer thinking three ways — Kahneman’s System 1/System 2 analogy, viewing networks as bundles of compute and storage that gradient descent organizes into circuits, and a latent-variable view where reasoning traces are latent variables and parallel CoT sampling is posterior inference over thoughts. It then covers thinking in tokens (CoT lets the model spend variable compute per answer token, scaled to problem hardness), branching and editing (parallel sampling vs sequential revision), RL for reasoning (the DeepSeek-R1 recipe, pure RL eliciting reflection and “aha moments”, and the instructive PRM/MCTS failures), external tool use (PAL, ReAct, o3), and thinking faithfully — CoT as interpretability rests on an unproven faithfulness assumption, with documented failure modes like early answering and unreadable encoding.
ZH: 本文综述了”思考时间”（测试时计算）为何以及如何提升 LLM 推理能力。文章从三个角度论证更长思考的动机——Kahneman 的系统1/系统2 类比、把网络视为由梯度下降组织成电路的计算与存储资源束，以及隐变量视角（推理轨迹是隐变量，并行 CoT 采样即对思维的后验推断）。随后涵盖以 token 思考（CoT 让模型为每个答案 token 投入随问题难度伸缩的可变计算量）、分支与编辑（并行采样 vs 顺序修正）、用 RL 提升推理（DeepSeek-R1 配方、纯 RL 涌现反思与”顿悟时刻”、以及富有教益的 PRM/MCTS 失败）、外部工具使用（PAL、ReAct、o3），以及忠实思考——CoT 作为可解释性手段建立在未经验证的忠实性假设之上，存在提前作答、不可读编码等已记录的失败模式。
Key Takeaways / 核心要点


EN: Chain-of-thought turns a fixed per-token compute budget into a variable one: every intermediate token is another forward pass, so the model can spend more flops on harder problems.
ZH: 思维链把固定的每 token 计算预算变成可变的：每个中间 token 都是一次前向传播，因此模型可以在更难的问题上投入更多 flops。


EN: Test-time decoding splits into parallel sampling (best-of-N, beam search, self-consistency) and sequential revision; easy questions favor purely sequential compute, hard questions need an optimal mix of both.
ZH: 测试时解码分为并行采样（best-of-N、束搜索、自洽性）与顺序修正；简单问题受益于纯顺序计算，困难问题则需要两者的最优组合。


EN: Self-correction is not an intrinsic LLM capability — naive self-correction causes behavior collapse and hallucination; external feedback (ground truth, unit tests, stronger models, humans) is required for revision to help.
ZH: 自我纠正并非 LLM 的内在能力——天真的自我纠正会导致行为坍缩与幻觉；修正要有效，必须有外部反馈（真实答案、单元测试、更强模型、人类）。


EN: RL on problems with automatically verifiable answers (STEM short answers, unit-tested code) plus simple policy gradients produces strong reasoning; pure RL without SFT can still elicit reflection and backtracking (“aha moments”).
ZH: 在答案可自动检验的问题上（简短 STEM 答案、单测验证的代码）做 RL，配合简单的策略梯度，就能产生强大推理；不加 SFT 的纯 RL 仍能涌现反思与回溯（“顿悟时刻”）。


EN: DeepSeek’s failures are instructive: PRMs struggled with per-step rubrics and reward hacking, and MCTS with the vast token search space — simple outcome rewards on verifiable answers won.
ZH: DeepSeek 的失败富有教益：PRM 受困于逐步评分标准与奖励黑客，MCTS 受困于庞大的 token 搜索空间——最终胜出的是可验证答案上的简单结果奖励。


EN: CoT is convenient interpretability but not guaranteed faithful: models may answer before the CoT is written, filler tokens can substitute for reasoning, and paraphrased CoT often preserves accuracy.
ZH: CoT 是便利的可解释性手段，但并不保证忠实：模型可能在写出 CoT 前就已作答、填充 token 可替代推理、改写后的 CoT 往往仍保持准确率。


EN: More thinking also improves adversarial robustness, and monitoring CoT can detect misbehavior like reward hacking — even letting a weaker model supervise a stronger one.
ZH: 更多思考还能提升对抗鲁棒性，监控 CoT 可以检测奖励黑客等不当行为——甚至让较弱的模型监督较强的模型。


Extracted Notes / 提取笔记

Chain-of-thought lets models allocate variable compute per answer token
Parallel sampling and sequential revision trade breadth against depth and hard problems need both
LLMs cannot self-correct without external feedback
Reinforcement learning on automatically verifiable rewards elicits reasoning and emergent reflection
Process rewards and tree search failed where simple outcome rewards worked
Chain-of-thought is not guaranteed to faithfully describe how the model computed its answer

sources/Zhang-et-al---A-Survey-of-RL-for.filePath: sources/Zhang et al - A Survey of RL for Large Reasoning Models.md
sources/Zhang-et-al---A-Survey-of-RL-for.title: A Survey of Reinforcement Learning for Large Reasoning Models
sources/Zhang-et-al---A-Survey-of-RL-for.content:
清华 + 上海 AI Lab · 配套仓库: TsinghuaC3I/Awesome-RL-for-LRMs

Summary / 摘要
EN: A Tsinghua/Shanghai-AI-Lab survey of RL for Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), focused on the post-DeepSeek-R1 era. Where the Agentic RL survey covers multi-turn decision-making, this one covers single-turn (or short-horizon) reasoning RL — chiefly RLVR: RL with Verifiable Rewards, where programmatic verifiers (answer checkers, unit tests) replace learned reward models. It is organized in three layers: (1) foundational components — reward design, policy optimization, sampling strategy; (2) five foundational debates — Sharpening vs Discovery, RL vs SFT, weak vs strong model priors, tricks vs traps in training recipes, process vs outcome rewards; (3) training resources — static corpora, dynamic environments, RL infrastructure. Its most useful contribution is the debates section: it maps the evidence on each side and shows where the field is converging (hybrid SFT+RL, verifiable rewards, process+outcome combinations).
ZH: 清华与上海 AI Lab 的综述，聚焦 DeepSeek-R1 之后的”大型推理模型”（LRM）的 RL。与 Agentic RL 综述覆盖多轮决策不同，本篇覆盖单轮（或短视界）推理 RL——主要是 RLVR：用程序化验证器（答案检查器、单元测试）替代学习到的奖励模型。全文分三层：(1) 基础组件——奖励设计、策略优化、采样策略；(2) 五个基础争论——磨砺 vs 发现、RL vs SFT、弱 vs 强模型先验、训练配方的技巧 vs 陷阱、过程 vs 结果奖励；(3) 训练资源——静态语料、动态环境、RL 基础设施。最有价值的是争论部分：梳理各方证据并指出收敛方向（SFT+RL 混合、可验证奖励、过程+结果组合）。
Key Takeaways / 核心要点


EN: RLVR replaces learned reward models with programmatic verifiers; “Verifier’s law” — tasks with automatic verification (math, code) enable efficient RL, while subjective tasks remain bottlenecked by reward design.
ZH: RLVR 用程序化验证器替代学习的奖励模型；“验证器定律”——可自动验证的任务（数学、代码）让 RL 高效可行，主观任务仍卡在奖励设计上。


EN: Sharpening vs Discovery: Limit-of-RLVR shows RL raises Pass@1 but hurts large-k Pass@k (sharpening); ProRL shows prolonged RL extends the frontier (discovery). The reconciliation: both happen, and the debate should shift to under what conditions each dominates.
ZH: 磨砺 vs 发现：Limit-of-RLVR 表明 RL 提升 Pass@1 却损害大 k 的 Pass@k（磨砺）；ProRL 表明足够长的 RL 能扩展前沿（发现）。和解方案：两者都发生，争论应转向什么条件下谁主导。


EN: “SFT memorizes, RL generalizes”: SFT-on-math causes representation drift and catastrophic forgetting of other domains; RL-on-math preserves or enhances them. But RL is no panacea under severe distribution shift — best practice converges on unified/alternating SFT+RL hybrids.
ZH: “SFT 记忆，RL 泛化”：数学 SFT 导致表征漂移和对其他域的灾难性遗忘；数学 RL 保持甚至提升其他域。但 RL 在剧烈分布偏移下不是万能药——最佳实践收敛到 SFT+RL 统一/交替混合。


EN: Model priors dominate RL outcomes: base models are better RL starting points than instruct models; Qwen improves even under spurious random rewards while Llama/OLMo do not — mid-training (annealing with high-quality math/code data) closes the gap for weak-prior families.
ZH: 模型先验主导 RL 结果：基座模型比 instruct 模型更适合做 RL 起点；Qwen 甚至在虚假随机奖励下都能涨点而 Llama/OLMo 不能——中期训练（用高质量数学/代码数据退火）能弥补弱先验家族的差距。


EN: Tricks vs traps: decomposing GRPO shows the biggest single gain comes from discarding incorrect samples, not fancy normalization; Clip-Higher (asymmetric PPO clipping) aids exploration. The field’s real problem is inconsistent experimental settings and conflicting conclusions — “scientific training” needs unified protocols and scalability–performance–cost curves.
ZH: 技巧 vs 陷阱：分解 GRPO 发现最大单项收益来自丢弃错误样本，而非花哨的归一化；Clip-Higher（非对称 PPO 裁剪）有助探索。领域真正的问题是实验设置不一致、结论互相矛盾——“科学训练”需要统一协议和可扩展性-性能-成本曲线。


EN: Outcome rewards give scalable goal alignment but encourage unfaithful CoT (“answer first, hallucinate later”) and reward hacking; process rewards (PRMs) give dense, interpretable guidance but expensive step-wise annotation that generalizes poorly. The promising direction is combining them via implicit process modeling or generative verifiers.
ZH: 结果奖励提供可扩展的目标对齐，但鼓励不忠实的 CoT（“先给答案后编理由”）和奖励作弊；过程奖励（PRM）提供稠密可解释的引导，但步骤标注昂贵且泛化差。有前景的方向是通过隐式过程建模或生成式验证器组合两者。


EN: Static corpora shift from scale-first to quality- and verifiability-first; small curated sets like LIMO (800 problems) and LIMR punch far above their weight, echoing the data-quality-over-quantity finding elsewhere.
ZH: 静态语料从规模优先转向质量与可验证性优先；LIMO（800 题）、LIMR 等小型精选集效果远超体量，再次印证数据质量优于数量。


核心框架 / Framework Digest
基础组件（Section 3）

奖励设计: 可验证奖励（规则-based，RLVR 核心）/ 生成式奖励（模型验证或生成奖励信号）/ 稠密奖励 / 无监督奖励 / 奖励塑形
策略优化: 策略梯度目标 → 有 critic（PPO 系）→ 无 critic（GRPO 系，DeepSeek 简化）→ 离策略 → 正则化目标
采样策略: 动态结构化采样、采样超参

五大争论（Section 4，全文精华）









































争论甲方证据乙方证据收敛方向Sharpening vs DiscoveryLimit-of-RLVR：Pass@1↑ 但 Pass@k↓；虚假奖励也能涨点ProRL：长 RL 同时提升 Pass@1 和 Pass@k；技能组合涌现问”什么条件下谁主导”，而非二选一RL vs SFT”SFT memorizes, RL generalizes”；RL 保持跨域能力RL 在剧烈 OOD 下失效；SFT 引入新知识更有效统一/交替混合（UFT、SRFT、SFT warmup→RL）弱先验 vs 强先验基座 > instruct；Qwen 对 RL 更友好强蒸馏模型在精心设计课程下也能涨弱先验家族先做 mid-training 退火再 RLVRTricks vs Traps丢弃错误样本 > 归一化；Clip-Higher 有效Dr.GRPO 与 BNPO 对归一化结论相反统一实验协议 + 可扩展性曲线Process vs OutcomePRM 更稳更可靠（Lightman 2024）结果奖励可扩展；过程标注昂贵且跨域衰减隐式过程建模 / 生成式验证器组合
训练资源（Section 5）

静态语料: 数学/代码/STEM/智能体四轨；LIMO、LIMR 小而精；DeepScaleR、OpenR1-Math 蒸馏 R1 长链
动态环境: 从静态语料走向交互式环境
RL 基础设施: 大规模训练管线

Extracted Notes / 提取笔记

RLVR replaces learned reward models with programmatic verifiers
The sharpening versus discovery debate asks whether RL creates or reveals capabilities
SFT memorizes while RL generalizes
RL outcomes depend heavily on model priors
Outcome rewards encourage unfaithful chain-of-thought
GRPO’s biggest gain comes from discarding incorrect samples
Spurious rewards can improve reasoning models by surfacing pretrained capabilities

与现有笔记的关联 / Connections

实证支持 A smaller curated dataset can outperform a larger unfiltered one：LIMO/LIMR 以几百到几千题匹敌大数据集
与 Chain-of-thought is not guaranteed to faithfully describe how the model computed its answer 互证：结果奖励会主动训练出不忠实的 CoT
与 Every reward function is a hackable proxy for the true goal 呼应：规则奖励同样被黑客攻击，产生”推理幻觉”
与 Data quality can change compute efficiency more than token count 一致：质量优先的语料构建
姊妹篇：Zhang et al - Landscape of Agentic RL, A Survey（多轮决策侧的 RL 全景）

sources/Zhang-et-al---Landscape-of-Agent.title: The Landscape of Agentic Reinforcement Learning for LLMs, A Survey
sources/Zhang-et-al---Landscape-of-Agent.content:
TMLR 01/2026 · 500+ 篇文献

Summary / 摘要
EN: This survey formalizes Agentic RL — the paradigm shift from treating LLMs as static sequence generators to treating them as learnable policies embedded in sequential decision-making loops. The core theoretical move is casting conventional preference-based RLHF as a degenerate single-step MDP (one prompt, one response, one scalar reward, full observability) versus Agentic RL as a temporally extended POMDP (dynamic world state, partial observations, text ∪ environment actions, step-wise sparse+dense rewards). On this foundation it builds a twofold taxonomy: one by agentic capability (planning, tool use, memory, reasoning, self-improvement, perception) and one by application domain. Its central thesis: RL is the mechanism that transforms these capabilities from static, heuristic modules into adaptive, robust behavior. It closes with three frontier challenges — trustworthiness, scaling agentic training, and scaling agentic environments.
ZH: 本文把”智能体强化学习”（Agentic RL）形式化为一次范式转移：LLM 不再是静态的序列生成器，而是嵌入序列决策回路中的可学习策略。核心理论动作是把传统偏好对齐（RLHF）视为退化的单步 MDP（一个提示、一个回答、一个标量奖励、完全可观测），而 Agentic RL 是时间延展的 POMDP（动态世界状态、部分可观测、文本∪环境动作、逐步的稀疏+稠密奖励）。在此之上建立双重分类法：按智能体能力（规划、工具使用、记忆、推理、自我改进、感知）与按应用领域。中心论点：RL 是把这些能力从静态启发式模块转变为自适应鲁棒行为的关键机制。结尾提出三大前沿挑战——可信性、规模化训练、规模化环境。
Key Takeaways / 核心要点


EN: PBRFT (RLHF/DPO) is a degenerate MDP with horizon T=1; Agentic RL is a POMDP with T>1, partial observability, and an action space of text ∪ environment-changing actions.
ZH: 偏好对齐是视界 T=1 的退化 MDP；Agentic RL 是 T>1 的 POMDP，部分可观测，动作空间是文本∪改变环境的动作。


EN: RL’s role across all six capabilities is the same: replace static heuristics with learned policies — e.g. memory becomes an RL-controlled subsystem deciding what to store, retrieve, and forget, not a passive vector store.
ZH: RL 在六大能力中扮演同一角色：用学习到的策略替换静态启发式——例如记忆变成由 RL 控制、决定存什么/取什么/忘什么的子系统，而非被动向量库。


EN: Planning splits into two paradigms — RL as external guide (a learned value function steering MCTS, as in RAP/LATS) vs RL as internal driver (the LLM itself as policy, as in ETO/VOYAGER); the future is a meta-policy that chooses when to deliberate.
ZH: 规划分两种范式——RL 作外部引导（学习价值函数指导 MCTS，如 RAP/LATS）与 RL 作内部驱动（LLM 本身即策略，如 ETO/VOYAGER）；未来是一个决定”何时深思”的元策略。


EN: Tool use evolves in three stages: ReAct-style imitation (SFT/prompting, brittle) → tool-integrated RL (outcome-driven optimization; emergent self-correction even from base models) → long-horizon multi-turn TIR, whose bottleneck is temporal credit assignment and reward hacking.
ZH: 工具使用经历三阶段：ReAct 式模仿（SFT/提示，脆弱）→ 工具集成 RL（结果驱动优化，甚至从基座模型涌现出自纠错）→ 长程多轮 TIR，瓶颈是时序信用分配与奖励作弊。


EN: Self-improvement has three levels: verbal self-correction (ephemeral, no gradients), RL-internalized self-correction (durable, in-weights), and iterative self-training (self-play, execution-guided curricula, collective bootstrapping — R-Zero, Absolute Zero, SiriuS).
ZH: 自我改进有三个层次：口头自纠（临时、无梯度）、RL 内化的自纠（持久、写入权重）、迭代自训练（自博弈、执行引导课程、集体自举——R-Zero、Absolute Zero、SiriuS）。


EN: Reasoning is framed as fast (System 1) vs slow (System 2); the open problem is training slow-thinking reliably in agentic settings without overthinking, pointing to adaptive test-time scaling.
ZH: 推理被框定为快（系统1）与慢（系统2）；开放问题是在智能体场景中可靠训练慢思考且避免过度思考，方向是自适应测试时扩展。


EN: Trustworthiness is worse for agents than for chatbots: RL turns the agent from a passive victim of manipulation into an active reward-seeking exploiter — it will learn and entrench unsafe paths if they pay. Mitigation = sandboxing + process rewards that penalize unsafe intermediate steps + adversarial training inside the RL loop.
ZH: 智能体的可信问题比聊天机器人更严重：RL 把智能体从被动的操纵受害者变成主动追逐奖励的利用者——只要不安全路径有回报，它就会学会并固化。缓解 = 沙箱 + 惩罚不安全中间步骤的过程奖励 + RL 回路内的对抗训练。


EN: Outcome-only RL imposes a “hallucination tax”: it degrades abstention, so agents answer unanswerable questions rather than saying “I don’t know”; SFT on solvable+unsolvable mixes restores epistemic humility.
ZH: 纯结果 RL 会征收”幻觉税”：它削弱拒答能力，智能体宁可胡答也不说”不知道”；用可解+不可解混合数据做 SFT 可恢复认知谦逊。


EN: Scaling environments means treating the environment as optimizable, not static: automated reward design (explorer agents generate trajectories to train reward models) + automated curriculum generation (EnvGen-style procedural content targeting the agent’s weaknesses) form a self-improving training flywheel.
ZH: 规模化环境意味着把环境当作可优化对象而非静态背景：自动化奖励设计（探索者智能体生成轨迹训练奖励模型）+ 自动化课程生成（EnvGen 式针对弱点的程序化内容）构成自我改进的训练飞轮。


核心框架 / Framework Digest
MDP 对比（Table 1）



































维度PBRFT (RLHF/DPO)Agentic RL状态单个 prompt，episode 立即结束世界状态 s_t，观察 o_t = O(s_t)，T>1动作纯文本序列A_text ∪ A_action（工具调用/环境交互，特殊 token 分隔）转移确定性直达终止态动态 P(s_{t+1}|s_t, a_t)，含工具结果/用户消息/环境反馈奖励单标量 r(a)逐步 R(s_t, a_t)，稀疏任务奖励 + 稠密子奖励目标E[r(a)]E[Σ γ^t R(s_t, a_t)]
能力分类法（Section 3）

Planning — 外部引导（MCTS+学习价值函数）vs 内部驱动（LLM 即策略）；前瞻： deliberation 与 intuition 的综合，元策略治理深思过程
Tool Use — ReAct 模仿 → TIR 结果驱动 RL → 长程多轮 TIR（时序信用分配是核心未解问题）
Memory — RAG 式被动存储 → RL 控制存取忘 → 跨 episode 持续适应
Self-Improvement — 口头自纠 → RL 内化自纠 → 迭代自训练（自博弈/执行课程/集体自举）；前瞻：反思能力本身的元进化
Reasoning — 快思考 vs 慢思考；agentic 场景下慢思考的训练稳定性与 overthinking
Perception — 被动感知 → 主动视觉认知（grounding 驱动、工具驱动、生成驱动）

三大挑战（Section 6）

Trustworthiness: security（间接提示注入、多智能体通信投毒、RL 放大的奖励黑客）、hallucination（幻觉税）、sycophancy（RLHF 本身激励谄媚）
Scaling Training: 计算（Agent RL Scaling Law：更长训练视界提升工具使用频率与推理深度）、模型规模（熵崩塌风险）、数据（跨域 RL 有协同也有干扰）、效率
Scaling Environments: 环境从静态变为可协同进化的系统；自动化奖励 + 自适应课程 = 训练飞轮

Extracted Notes / 提取笔记

Agentic RL reframes LLMs as policies in POMDPs rather than single-step generators
RL turns agent capabilities from static heuristics into adaptive behavior
Tool use evolves from imitation to outcome-driven RL to long-horizon TIR
Self-improvement has three levels from verbal correction to iterative self-training
RL can turn agents into active reward-hacking exploiters
Temporal credit assignment is the bottleneck of long-horizon agentic RL
Outcome-only RL imposes a hallucination tax on abstention

与现有笔记的关联 / Connections

更新 An LLM agent combines planning memory and tool use around a language model core：2023 年的 Weng 框架把三组件当作架构模块；本综述展示 RL 如何把每个模块变成可学习策略
与 Every reward function is a hackable proxy for the true goal 呼应：RL 智能体是奖励黑客的主动实施者
与 An agent’s short-term memory is its context window and long-term memory is external retrieval 对比：记忆从”外部检索”进化为”RL 控制的存取忘子系统”
姊妹篇：Zhang et al - A Survey of RL for Large Reasoning Models（单步推理侧的 RL 全景）

sources/Zhou-et-al.---Large-Language-Mod.content:
Summary
Zhou et al. propose Automatic Prompt Engineer (APE), which treats natural-language instructions as programs synthesized and searched by LLMs. Given task demonstrations, an LLM proposes candidate instructions, another scoring pass evaluates them, and iterative variants refine the best candidates.
Key Takeaways

APE makes prompt generation a black-box search over instruction candidates proposed by LLMs.
The paper frames instructions as executable natural-language programs whose quality must be measured on downstream behavior.
The method can start from input-output examples rather than a hand-authored prompt.
APE became one of the foundational references for later APO systems, but its search is less directed than textual-gradient methods.
The user-provided citation label “APE: Automatic Prompt Engineer” refers to this paper’s method; the official title is Large Language Models Are Human-Level Prompt Engineers.

Local PDF
Extracted Notes

Automatic prompt engineering treats instructions as programs
Prompt optimization turns prompt writing into measurable search
Seedless prompt induction lowers entry cost but still needs task examples

sources/earendil-works---Pi-Agent-Loop.title: Pi Agent Loop
sources/earendil-works---Pi-Agent-Loop.content:
Summary
The agent-core package of the open-source pi coding agent implements a model-agnostic agent loop as a stateless function wrapped by a stateful Agent class. The loop orchestrates LLM calls, tool execution, and streaming through a four-level event protocol, while all product policy (context compaction, permission checks, model switching, queueing) is injected through config hooks.
Key Takeaways

The loop is a pure function: callers pass a context snapshot and config, and receive an event stream plus new messages, with no state retained between runs.
A stateful Agent class owns the transcript, steering/follow-up queues, and event subscribers, feeding snapshots to the loop and committing only completed messages back.
Failures never escape as exceptions: LLM stream errors and tool execution errors both become error tool results fed back to the model so it can self-correct.
When an LLM response is truncated by the output token limit, all tool calls in that message are failed rather than executed, because streamed arguments may be salvaged from incomplete JSON.
Tool calls in a batch execute in parallel by default, but any tool marked sequential downgrades the whole batch; preparation (validation, permission hooks) stays sequential even in parallel mode.
A batch terminates the loop only when every tool result sets the terminate flag, so no single tool can end the session unilaterally.
Nine config hooks (transformContext, beforeToolCall, afterToolCall, prepareNextTurn, shouldStopAfterTurn, and queue pollers) let products inject policy without forking the loop.

Extracted Notes

A stateless loop core plus a stateful wrapper separates orchestration from session state
Agent loops should encode failures as error tool results instead of throwing exceptions
Snapshot boundaries between loop and state owner give crash safety for free
Inject policy through hooks so the agent loop stays product-agnostic
Truncated LLM output should fail all tool calls rather than execute salvaged arguments
Stream partial messages in place so interrupted contexts stay structurally complete
Require all tool results to agree before terminating a batch

sources/张一鸣---卸任字节跳动-CEO-全员信.content:
Summary
2021 年 5 月 20 日张一鸣发给字节跳动全员的内部信，宣布卸任 CEO，由联合创始人梁汝波接任，年底前完成交接。他自己的解释是：对上一年的三个 OKR（远景新战略、组织和管理、社会责任）都不满意，觉得过去几年”很大程度都在吃老本”；CEO 作为组织的中心节点容易陷入被动；他想放下日常管理，“以十年为期”专注学习、系统思考和动手尝试。文本取自 IT之家 刊登的全文。
Key Takeaways
OKR 不应只是线性延伸
没更新双月 OKR，是因为对去年的三个年度 OKR 都不满意，“我就在思考双月的，一年的，更长期的 OKR，如何不仅仅是线性延伸”。
承认自己在”吃老本”
“在 17 年之前我还能保持关注机器学习技术的新进展，近三年已经没有太多学习了。“收藏了很多专业视频和文章，但断断续续，在技术讨论会上也难以跟上进展。他的签名档一直是”喜欢发呆”，指的是”思考一些非常无边无际和少有人讨论的点子”。
CEO 的负规模效应
三年前他给创业者讲过：业务和组织变大以后，作为中心节点的 CEO 每天听汇报、做审批和决策，“容易导致内部视角，知识结构更新缓慢”。这次卸任是把这条判断用在自己身上。
少数人能洞察未来
技术变革在酝酿时很少人注意：特斯拉 18 年前用笔记本电池做原型；HomeBrew Club 在 70 年代就在讨论 Apple I。他点名虚拟现实、生命科学、科学计算。
自我评价
“我不是传统意义上的成熟管理者，我也不是很擅长社交，我更喜欢研究组织和市场原理来减少管理，喜欢自己上网、看书、听歌、发呆。”
把主体当作客体
旅行的部分意义在于时空切换，更容易把主体当作客体审视自己；卸任后也更容易从外部视角观察公司。2012 年的商业计划书里，他希望团队把创业当作”同行去欣赏风景的旅行”。
Extracted Notes

A CEO at the center of a growing organization drifts into an internal view

sources/张一鸣---平常心做非常事（字节跳动-9-周年演讲）.content:
Summary
2021 年 3 月 30 日字节跳动 9 周年年会上张一鸣的内部演讲，主题是”平常心”，两个月后他宣布卸任 CEO。他把平常心定义为”在一切环境和一切行为中，保持无差别不偏执（unbiased）“，最直白的说法是”吃饭的时候好好吃饭，睡觉的时候好好睡觉”。演讲依次讲平常心对待自己、过去和未来、竞争、方法论、成功和失败。文本取自澎湃号转载的整理稿，是一手讲话的整理。
Key Takeaways
平常心对待自己：标签会让动作变形
“当你特别在乎结果的时候，很有可能会发挥得不好。“射箭时想着”我要拿十环”反而射不好。高管、大公司、年轻人、前端工程师这些标签都会带来束缚；公司不提倡 title 也是这个原因。他在酷讯做后端时，前端、产品、销售的问题也都参与。
关注当下，不懊恼过去
引《The Power of Now》：恐惧来自过于关注未来，不宽恕来自过于关注过去。他坦白自己”不算特别有纪律性”，晚上会被西瓜视频吸引，睡前懊恼又报复性工作，导致第二天开会精神不好；现在”发现太迟了，不懊恼，马上去睡了”。危机里他反复说”stay calm, be patient”。“我们公司明年为什么一定要增长 100%？”
平常心对待竞争
把竞争当常态，不通过并购结束竞争；竞争对手是”很好的蓝军”，批评文章里 20% 有启发就吸收。不要为了竞争而竞争：微软盯着谷歌做搜索，没看到真正的对手是做云的亚马逊。
不依赖捷径，少用杠杆
随便说 all-in 往往是偷懒，“我不想再想了，赌一把吧”。另一种捷径是过度抽象和过度追求方法论：“对一个事情抽象，相当于思维上加杠杆。一旦这个杠杆加错，通常是失之毫厘，谬以千里。“他称之为”理性的自负，这也是人的 ego”。他当场念了一段用双月会材料里的词拼出来的空话（“形成组合拳，打造内容生态闭环，以此赋能客户用户创造价值”），说重要判断其实来自对用户和事实的观察。“don’t rush to conclusion”。
不把外因当内因，不把运气当能力
领先之后反而怕失败、动作变形，像打游戏打到第 99 关手抖。短视频早期城市用户留存差，有人归因为”白领更喜欢图文”，听起来有道理，后来证明不是。“人很不喜欢不确定性，所以对成功和失败都希望找到符合自我叙事的归因。”
面对失误的四部曲
realize it、correct it、learn from it，他自己加了第四步 forgive it：“不要过长时间进入到自我指责的状态中。”
去掉中间的损耗
Free Solo：往前往后都危险，“腿软心乱最危险”。他跑步、游泳以前坚持不下来，后来不去想别的、能放松的肌肉尽量放松，3–4 公里、1 千米都容易了，“并不是体能提高了……我把中间的损耗去掉了”。结尾：“外部波澜起伏，内心平静如常。“
Extracted Notes

Caring too much about the outcome distorts the action
Over-abstraction is leverage on thinking that magnifies a wrong premise
After a mistake realize it correct it learn from it then forgive it
补充出处：Vague words hide unresolved thinking and protect self-deception（空话那一段）

sources/张一鸣---近10年微博-231-条摘录.content:
Summary
网上流传的一份 PDF（54 页）：一位网友读完张一鸣的全部微博，摘出 231 条，分成”关于成长”157 条、“关于管理”45 条、“关于商业”29 条。整理者说 2010 年前后的微博最好，那时张一鸣 30 岁左右，正在创业做九九房；2012 年开始做今日头条后，微博多是转发，干货变少。条目没有日期，原文也没有附链接，所以这是二手材料：选什么、归到哪一类，都是整理者的判断。
Key Takeaways
延迟满足感是总开关（成长 #002、#015、#114）
他提得最多的概念，含义比”忍住不享受”宽：它是愿意在一个问题上停留多深。他把”不装”、沟通时不晃动、“凡事认真想，不想当然”都算作延迟满足感的练习。
最大的敌人是自我欺骗（成长 #001、#005、#016、#065；管理 #029）
“人常会不自觉地记下对自己有利的部分""人生的差距就是在自我感觉良好中拉开的”。台风吹起来的猪，要分清是自己能飞还是外力；创业要区别信心和”YY”，避免自我强化和催眠。
反对含糊（成长 #007、#101、#124、#149）
“含糊代表着侥幸、代表着自我欺骗”。听不懂时，找出那个代词或笼统的词还给对方；点名要避免”应该差不多吧""过两三天大概就可以了”这类说法。
自控就是对抗惰性（成长 #104、#107、#116）
懒惰分体力、思考、情绪三种，修炼多数时候是在克服惰性。“平庸有重力，需要逃逸速度。“地基是体力和睡眠（#044、#085）。
行动，不等 100% 确定（成长 #075、#095、#099、#125）
不动肯定是错误；有观点却解决不了问题时，“赶紧做许多又很有用又没有错的事情”。
长期看，实在比忽悠更经济（成长 #023、#039、#045）
“短期交往说话忽悠会有溢价，长期交往说话实在会有溢价。“他用经济而不是道德来论证诚实。
往高一层看（成长 #006、#026、#122、#129）
“很多复杂问题是更高维度简单问题的投影”；纠结时离远一步，用更长的时间尺度衡量。
动机的三个层次（成长 #078、#082、#146）
饥渴分贪婪、成就动机、好奇心，分别对应投机者、攀登者、探索者。不认同三四十岁退休：“想退休说明你认为现在是在’忍’。”
管理和商业部分
招人只往高走，看理性、逻辑、修养、企图心、自我控制力（管理 #020、#034）；坦率是公司的敌人也是可以培育的（管理 #025）；CEO 要抵制自己解决问题的欲望（管理 #014）。商业部分强调用户和事实：成果在组织之外（商业 #002），每天看 10 条用户反馈（商业 #026），警惕愿望式思考（商业 #028）；还有”更多分发推荐的机制转动起来”（商业 #013），写在做今日头条之前。
